articleTitle: Grouping Hydrogen Storage Materials Based on Their Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: In this research endeavour, we delve into the intricate realm of ensemble models, specifically focusing on the Bagging Tree algorithm, Random Forest, and Ensemble Extra Tree, to discern their effectiveness in the classification of hydrogen storage materials. The investigation relies on an extensive dataset, covering essential characteristics such as the weight percentage of hydrogen, the heat of formation (measured in kilojoules per mole of H2), temperature (in degrees Celsius), pressure (in absolute atmospheres), entropy of formation (expressed in joules per mole of H2 per Kelvin), equilibrium pressure at 25°C, natural logarithm of equilibrium pressure at 25°C, and hydrogen-to-metal ratio. The amalgamation of these features forms the basis for constructing robust classification models. By harnessing the collective predictive power of these ensemble techniques, the study endeavours to augment the precision and reliability of models, ultimately contributing to the forefront of materials science and advancing technologies in the realm of renewable energy.

articleTitle: An IoT Based Framework for Monitoring Power Consumption in Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The electrical power system grid in India, commonly referred to as the power grid, has been in operation for an extensive duration. During this time period, there were no significant advancements or alterations documented in the electricity grid infrastructure. The need for electrical power consumption is seeing a significant increase, but the current grid infrastructure is unable to meet these growing demands. In order to meet the demands of future power load, it is imperative to develop an enhanced system that possesses the qualities of reliability, security, intelligence, and efficiency. This study develops a power management system and explains its automation and functionality by utilising smart grid and IoT technologies. The research suggests a method for keeping an eye on consumer power use and controlling the use of electrical devices by putting in place a system that can identify voltage, current, and weather conditions in addition to alerting users in advance of possible problems with power usage. Future system improvements that are region-specific and intended to reduce loads and maximise system performance are made possible by the data collected.

articleTitle: Femur Osteoporosis Risk Assessment through Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: One common health problem, especially among older people, is osteoporosis. This condition is marked by decreased bone density and an increased risk of fractures. Effective intervention and treatment rely on early diagnosis and risk assessment. Using deep learning models called Faster R-CNN (Region-based Convolutional Neural Networks), we provide a new method for assessing the risk of femoral osteoporosis in this research. The approach requires amassing X-ray pictures of the femur from a varied group of people, including those with varied levels of bone health. Image quality and feature normalization are improved using preprocessing approaches. In order to precisely identify and pinpoint areas of interest pertaining to structural integrity and bone density, the Faster R-CNN model is trained using annotated datasets. The Faster R-CNN model successfully identifies osteoporotic characteristics in femur X-rays, as shown by our findings. The model is able to differentiate between normal and osteoporotic bone structures with a high degree of sensitivity and specificity. The approach is also well-suited for clinical uses and large-scale screening programmes because of how quickly it can examine data.

articleTitle: Neural Network Models for the Timely Identification of Parkinson's Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Everyday, we listen so many people who face parkinson's disease because of the absent and distracted mindfulness of the people [1,2]. Early signs of Parkinson's Disease (PD) frequent varies from person to person, slowly-slowly aggravate with prolonged time. Common indicators which tell include tremors, especially at rest, typically starting in one hand. Rigidity or stiffness in limbs and joints may also emerge, leading to decreased range of motion [3]. Bradykinesia, or slowed movement, becomes apparent, affecting daily tasks like walking or fine motor skills [4,5]. Postural instability may develop, causing balance problems and an increased risk of falls. Additionally, individuals may experience changes in handwriting, speech, or facial expressions [6]. Recognizing these early symptoms is crucial for timely intervention and management, enhancing quality of life for those affected by PD.

articleTitle: Using Machine Learning Towards Evaluation of Environmental Impacts and Mitigation in Sustainable Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The intersection of Predictive analyze machine learning (ML), and sustainable supply chain management (SSCM) creates a dynamic and inventive link in today's quickly changing business environment. Attaining this agility requires proactive risk mitigation. This investigation proposes a way to improve efficiency and improve risk mitigation by combining ML and predictive analytics methods.This study looks at a variety of predictive analytics techniques and demonstrates how supply chain hazards can be identified using them. These techniques include natural language processing, anomaly detection, and time series analysis. Furthermore, machine learning algorithms are used to continuously refine and optimise risk assessment models, guaranteeing their accuracy and flexibility in ever-changing circumstances. This study synthesizes theoretical discourse and empirical data to provide light on the mutually beneficial link between supply chain agility, machine learning, and predictive analytics.This investigation proposes a way to improve efficiency and improve risk mitigation by combining ML and predictive analytics methods. One of the key accomplishments is the creation of an extensive framework that integrates machine learning and predictive analytics into risk management practices, allowing for the identification and mitigation of risks.

articleTitle: Enhancing User Experience and Satisfaction in Robo-Advisor Platforms: A Multi-Dimensional Analysis of Usability Factors and Interface Design Elements
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This research aims to investigate the user experience of customers interacting with robo-advisors and assess their satisfaction levels. The study will identify key usability factors, interface design elements, and personalized features that influence customer satisfaction and loyalty in robo-advisor platforms. By conducting a multi-dimensional analysis, incorporating qualitative and quantitative research methods, this research seeks to provide actionable insights for improving the user experience and enhancing customer satisfaction in robo-advisor services. Robo-advisor is the initiative taken by the many banks to enhance the customer experience also reduce the cost of services. This can be done by using chat bots and there are many other AI enabled services that is provided by banks like face recognition, voice assistance, biometrics etc. Voice-assistance and chat bots are the mostly used robo-advisor services by customers of banks for mitigation of risk. This study conduct to explore the relationship between user experience, satisfaction levels and long term loyalty to robo-advisor platforms. This study used primary and secondary data and secondary data collected from research papers, journals and articles. The investigation synthesises and evaluates pertinent articles and research papers released between 2011 and 2023 using a comparative exploration pattern.

articleTitle: A Detailed Overview of Quantum Computing Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The computing sector has undergone radical changes in the last few decades. Conventional computers use binary (1s and 0s) numbers to perform tasks that are specified by the user. Using the concepts of quantum physics, a unique method known as “quantum computing” addresses problems that are too complicated for conventional computing devices. Two of the scientific fields with the fastest growth rates in today's time are machine learning and quantum computing. Researchers have recently initiated investigations into the ways in which conventional machine learning methods can be improved by quantum computing. Quantum machine learning comprises hybrid approaches that combine quantum and classical algorithms, using quantum methods to evaluate quantum states rather than traditional data. Current data science techniques could be significantly improved by quantum algorithms. In this work, we summarize the contributions made by different researchers in the domain of Quantum Learning and then look at some of the methods related to its real-world uses.

articleTitle: Enhanced Detection of Osteoporosis in Femur Bones with Improved VGG16
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: a major health concern, particularly for the aged, is osteoporosis, a common bone condition marked by decreased bone mineral density. Timely treatments and better patient outcomes can result from osteoporosis screening efforts that begin early. The use of deep learning algorithms to automate the diagnosis of osteoporosis using medical imaging data has shown encouraging results in recent years. For more precise diagnosis of osteoporosis in femur bones, this research suggests a new method based on an upgraded version of the VGG16 CNN architecture. In order to identify osteoporosis, the suggested model uses transfer learning that has already been trained on a large dataset of bone pictures. In order to make VGG16 work better for analysing femur bones, we add layers and optimize its design. A wide variety of femur bone scans, both healthy and with osteoporosis, annotated by seasoned radiologists, make up the dataset used for both training and assessment. When compared to baseline CNN models and more conventional approaches, our experimental findings show that our approach is far more sensitive and specific. Early intervention and improved disease management are made possible by the increased VGG16 model's resilience in identifying minor alterations in bone density that are symptomatic of early-stage osteoporosis. In addition, we evaluate the effectiveness and generalizability of our suggested strategy by rigorous comparative studies and validation.

articleTitle: Improving Breast Cancer Diagnosis: Insights From Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Data mining is a technique used in the healthcare industry to analyze vast amounts of information for early illness diagnosis and prognosis. When it comes to its early prediction stages of breast cancer, many different classification algorithms play an essential role. This study proposed a pragmatic method to evaluate the effectiveness of four different classification algorithms, namely Decision Tree, Naïve Bayes, K-nearest neighbor and Support Vector Machines, in accordance to forecast breast cancer. These algorithms were examined for their ability to diagnose and predict the early stages of illness. The classifier is strengthened by using exploratory data analysis and the boosting method in this study. Additionally, the problem of imbalanced classes is resolved during the classification phase. In this particular instance, cross-validation techniques were utilized to investigate the behavior of each classifier concerning the accuracy, true positive rate, and false positive rate. This study attempted for improvement of the accuracy level in the prediction of breast cancer employing through the aforementioned machine-learning methods.

articleTitle: Exploring the Effectiveness of Advanced Machine Learning Models in Speech Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The importance of recognizing emotion from voice stems from the basic human need to understand and communicate emotional states, which is vital in enhancing security, health care, etc. This study compares several advanced machine learning models to assess their effectiveness in recognizing emotions from speech, using the widely accepted RAVDESS, i.e. Ryerson Audiovisual Database of Emotional Speech Song. Our research focuses on the study of depth models of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Long Short-Term Memory networks (LSTMs) versus conventional machine learning algorithms, like Support Vector Machines (SVMs), Random Forests (RFs), and Long-Range Machines (GBM). Through careful preprocessing, feature extraction using Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCCs). The research concludes that LSTM performs better at 91% than the other implemented models. Thus, in future, voice-based emotion recognition can help with diagnosis with ongoing monitoring of mental health conditions like depression, anxiety and stress by detecting emotional distress or mood changes.

articleTitle: Enhancing Air Quality Long Short Term Memory Networks for Predictive Analysis: Insights and Visualization-driven Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: An important danger to both the environment and human health is air pollution, necessitating the need for reliable prediction models. This study introduces a novel approach to enhancing air quality prediction using LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) networks, distinguished for their capacity to extract temporal correlations from sequential data. By employing a large dataset encompassing air quality measurements from various Chinese cities between March 2013 and February 2017, our LSTM-based model demonstrates proficient forecasting of future air quality levels. Furthermore, our research utilizes visualization-driven analysis techniques to deepen understanding of the intricate interplay among air pollution levels, weather conditions, and overall air quality. Interactive visualizations facilitate comprehension and data interpretation, enabling a comprehensive grasp of the dynamics of air pollution. In our experiments, the LSTM-based technique surpasses established methods, showcasing its potential to support decision-making processes for policymakers and environmental stakeholders. By increasing the predictability of air quality and providing insights into pollution dynamics, our research contributes to the formulation of effective strategies for managing air pollution and safeguarding public health.

articleTitle: Powering the Future: Enhancing Decoder Efficiency through Energy and Thermal Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: To improve communication efficiency and minimize the energy issue affecting digital devices, this work offers an experimental FPGA-based digital circuit decoder. By using FPGA boards and putting clever resource allocation algorithms into practice, the decoder maximizes energy efficiency. The decoder saves a lot of power without compromising functionality by incorporating energy-saving techniques and looking into renewable energy sources to power digital gadgets. A more environmentally friendly method of powering digital gadgets is made possible by these green energy alternatives. This paper establishes the foundation for future sustainable developments in the realm of green communication and digital technology through an analysis of the potential of FPGA technology.

articleTitle: Performance Assessment of Data Centric and Model Centric Approach for Premature Detection of Leaf Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: After rice and maize, cassava is the third most common source of carbohydrates in the world. Recognizing the critical relationship between agricultural productivity and a country's economy, specialists have made significant investments in the early diagnosis of leaf diseases in order to protect the entire plant from degeneration. The abundance of data, improved resource availability, and improvements in learning algorithms are all credited with the recent achievements of Machine Learning (ML) models. In order to improve system efficiency, the traditional method for detecting leaf diseases uses a Model-Centric approach that optimizes hyperparameters. The emphasis has recently switched from model-entered to data-centered techniques, in which the model is kept constant, but dataset quality is increased by addressing issues like label consistency and systematic sampling of training data while choosing the right batches. The current paper comprises using confidence learning to locate and remove noisy labels from the Cassava Leaf Disease Classification dataset. The model is then fed with newly produced high-quality data, and the performance of the model-centric and data-centric approaches are contrasted. This paper intends to highlight the underappreciated potential for increasing system functionality using a data-centric approach rather than to minimize the significance of model-centric approaches. The findings indicate that the data-centric method leads to a performance enhancement of 7.84%.

articleTitle: Firearm Classification Based On CNN, Vision Transformer and Swin Transformer Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Most of the violence related incidents around the world involves the use of some kind of firearms such as gun, knife, pistol etc. There has always been a great need for an efficient system which can accurately identify these firearms and raise an alarm as quickly as possible. Very few studies have been done in past to create a model to classify these firearms using deep learning techniques. This study is aimed to investigate the potential of using deep learning (DL) techniques to identify firearms based on their visual features. It involves the use of convolutional neural network (CNN) and vision transformers (ViT) to classify firearms images into their respective categories. Both these types of models were trained on a dataset which was specifically created for this study and then these models were evaluated on performance metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. This study also conducted a comparative analysis of the Swin-ViT, a variant of Vision transformer, with ViT and CNN. After training, we find that the Swin-ViT model with the accuracy of 97.55% outperformed the other two models i.e., CNN and ViT which had accuracies of 93.63% and 95.60% respectively. Hence, this study concludes that the use of vision transformers and its variants can be an effective approach for firearms classification, providing a more reliable and accurate method.

articleTitle: A Terse Review of Heart Diseases Estimation Using Machine Learning Practices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Heart diseases, a primary cause of global fatalities, represent a growing social matter on a worldwide scale. The integration of machine learning with advancing technology has greatly benefited the medical field, resulting in the provision of seamless solutions characterized by high accuracy, consistency and toughness. These advancements help the patient society through early detection and reduced medical care costs. They also offer the medical fraternity capable, accessible, precise and consistent prediction systems. This paper provides a comprehensive enquiry of machine learning algorithms engaged for the prediction and classification of several cardiovascular diseases, we explore several modalities, including physiological signals, heart sounds and electronic health records, to achieve effective heart disease recognition. We also provide insights into popular machine learning systems, hybrid systems and fuzzy systems in this context. It is noted in this review that Support Vector Machines (SVM) have gained popularity and widespread usage, with neural networks and ensemble techniques following closely behind in terms of their application. All these approaches are compared based on accuracy metrics.

articleTitle: Enhancing Mental Disorder Diagnosis with Ensemble Bagging and Random Forest Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The field of mental health diagnostics is drastically transformed with the emergence of artificial intelligence especially deep learning. This article explores the use of deep learning in mental health diagnosis by providing an overview of the state-of-the-art techniques that use ensemble methods to analyse intricate patterns in data. Our examination covers a range of mental health conditions, such as sleep disorder, mood swings, bipolar disorder, and anorexia, to show how ensemble learning performs better than conventional diagnostic methods in terms of accuracy, efficiency, and the ability to detect early-stage stage of mental health issues. The performance of the proposed model is compared with the state-of-the-art Machine Learning techniques such as multi-layer perceptron, bayes net, bagging and random forest. The paper also highlights ongoing research efforts and future directions in integrating deep learning with clinical practices for mental health diagnosis. By harnessing the power of ensemble learning, we envision a future where mental health diagnostics are more accessible, precise, and personalized, ultimately improving outcomes for individuals with mental disorders.

articleTitle: Enhanced Data Security Framework Using Lightweight Cryptography and Multi-Level Encryption
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Network security is essential for individuals as well as organizations in the modern day, since the majority of enterprises and organizations store their data on clouds. Therefore, a way to guarantee data security during network transmission needs to be discovered. Data security also heavily depends on device level security. These days, it's necessary to protect data at the device, network, and application levels simultaneously. The developers of the suggested concept use multi-level encryption techniques and lightweight cryptography algorithms to attempt to safeguard data on all three levels. This paper proposes multi-level cryptography as a fix for the previously noted issue that compared to normal encryption, which uses different keys for each round of encryption, resulting in a complex or powerful algorithm, multi-level encryption protects data more thoroughly.

articleTitle: A WSN and IoT-Based Proposed Intrusion Recognition System at Farmland
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Various techniques, combining conventional and cutting-edge technology, have been developed throughout time to identify human and animal invaders on agricultural property. Traditional methods of protecting crops include erecting block barriers, growing plants that repel pests, and deploying electric fences or offensive-smelling plants. Deep learning algorithms, the internet of things, and portable monitoring systems are examples of cutting-edge technology employed in farm security. Several agricultural invasion detection systems proposed by several authors are thoroughly examined in this research. It involves the use of wireless sensors Web, Internet of Things (IoT), and electricity Obstacles to propose intrusion recognition system at farmland.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Energy Aware Routing Techniques in WSN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) proliferation has stimulated Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) research due to their ability to remotely monitor environments using distributed sensors. These sensors often deployed in large numbers in harsh conditions and have limited battery power. It takes a significant energy to transmit data directly from a sensor node to a central Base Station (BS). Energy consumption can be reduced through clustered WSNs. Selecting an energy-efficient Cluster Head (CH) is crucial, as this task is known to be computationally complex. Dynamic Cluster Head selection is a critical decision-making approach to optimize routing and minimize energy consumption. A novel optimization-based routing algorithm is proposed to decrease the energy consumption of nodes in network. This system incorporates the Improved Adaptive Remora Optimization Algorithm (IAROA) for Cluster Head selection, allowing for a multi-function optimization process. The performance of the proposed technique is evaluated with the help of energy consumption. The suggested method is compared with LEACH and ESMR Protocols.

articleTitle: Enhancing Presentation Dynamics with Real-time Hand Gesture Recognition: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Consider conducting talks where the presenter uses only hand gestures no buttons or mouse to interact with the audience and control the slides. An in-depth discussion of enhancing presentation dynamics through real-time hand gesture recognition will be covered in this research paper. A presentation's importance in the digital age is underscored by the need to make it more dynamic and engaging. The paper investigates how real-time hand gesture recognition technologies might significantly improve the quality of presentations. In this paper, the instruments and techniques that people are now using are examined closely. Consider cameras like the Microsoft Kinect that can detect hand movements. These enable presenters to transition between slides seamlessly, emphasise key points, and engage with images or videos without uncomfortable pauses. Furthermore, they examine wearable technology with unique sensors that enable presenters to control their presentations without bulky equipment. Presenters now have greater freedom to engage with their audience thanks to wearables that use tiny sensors to interpret hand movements and convert them into actions. Not only that, but this study will go even more deeply into the scientific aspect. This paper will focus on advanced artificial intelligence-based computer programs and devices that can detect hand movements in real time. Teaching a computer to recognize when a user points, swipes, or waves their hand to interact with an audience is analogous to teaching it to do the same. When users combine verbal and hand movements, it gets incredibly lively. This article explores the possibilities of integrating spoken words and hand gestures to provide highly interactive presentations. With the help of this fusion, presenters can more easily convey their message by using their hands to give instructions or add explanations.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning for Optimal Robotic Arm Control in Ball-Balancing Tasks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) stands out as a promising method for developing better control strategies in robotic systems, particularly in tasks involving complex dynamics such as ball-balancing in automated manufacturing. In automated manufacturing processes, efficient control of robotic arms is crucial for maintaining precision and productivity. This paper presents the implementation of the Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) algorithm for optimal control of a robotic arm in ball-balancing tasks. The efficacy of the proposed DDPG algorithm is demonstrated through comparison with the existing Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) algorithm. Through simulations, the results obtained from DDPG are analysed and contrasted with those from SAC. The smooth trajectory achieved with the DDPG algorithm showcases its ability to generate precise and consistent control commands, leading to stable and smooth motion of the robotic arm during ball balancing. This research contributes to advancing automation in manufacturing by presenting a robust RL framework for optimizing robotic arm control in complex tasks.

articleTitle: Ontological Knowledge-Based Representation System to Prevent Web Attacks in iMANET's
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This paper implies securing Internet-based Mobile Ad-hoc Networks (iMANETs) with semantic web techniques. To illustrate safety issues, ontologies will be utilised rather than taxonomies. These ontologies can be added to an intrusion detection system's (IDS) information repository. By employing inference based on semantic relations, intrusion detection systems can identify and incorporate upcoming attacks into their current knowledge base.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Techniques for Human Resource Management Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Because deep learning and machine learning (ML) techniques have the potential to totally change how firms manage their human capital, there has been a lot of interest in developing HRM procedures that use these techniques. Strong DSS (Decision Support System) technology must be incorporated into the HRM (Human Resource Management) profession in order to make judgements that are effective in today's competitive environment. This study focuses on the problem of prediction, decision making, prediction, and testing assistance in a HRM system. The paper discusses a creative decision support system for HR procedures. Machine learning and deep learning techniques have been offered as fundamental instruments for tracking various HR indicators in the systems developed and implemented analytical process. The description of the suggested methodology and a discussion of a outcomes from the experiments are included in the paper.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection in Cybersecurity: Leveraging Machine Learning for Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: An intrusion Detection system is a software that monitors the network traffic and alerts the administrators if any malicious request is found. The system is able to segregate between a malicious and non-malicious request using two methods one is signature-based and the other is by training a machine learning model which is also called the Anomaly-based method. In this paper, we have achieved the highest accuracy from all existing models i.e., 99.99%. We have been able to increase the accuracy of ML models as a result of our proposed model, which is an ensemble of Random Forest, Decision tree, and KNN. Along with this, we have also applied a deep learning model ANN which has led to the effect. Since we have used four different datasets, our model is trained with a large number of datasets which has also contributed to high accuracy.

articleTitle: Shifting From Syntactic to Semantics for Knowledge Exemplification Using Semantic Web (SW) Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Using Semantic Web technologies is critical to improving knowledge sharing and administrative efficiency and fostering semantic interoperability amongst healthcare information systems. This article offers a thorough evaluation of software technologies that takes into account both the technical and content elements. In-depth discussions of ontology, interoperability guidelines, ontology creation, types of ontologies, ontology editors, and real-world applications of ontologies in healthcare are provided in this study. The proprietor of the website wants to help visitors by giving them useful information that will help them achieve their goals. By examining user behaviour, page content, and the sequence in which URLs are viewed, web mining techniques are utilised to classify users and sites. In order to extract conceptual linkages and apply online structure mining procedures, which concentrate on fully structured forms, this study provides two web mining techniques: web use mining and web content mining. Web structure mining aids in the retrieval process and has been utilised in the development of ontologies.

articleTitle: Forest Scan: An Image Analytics for Tree Enumeration for the Diversion of Forest Land
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Forest Scan is an innovative Image Analytics model designed to address the critical need for accurate tree enumeration in regions designated for forest land diversion for the infrastructure development. Forest Scan uses advanced technology, including satellite imagery, aerial photographs, and drone inputs, to automate the tree enumeration process so that to make the ecological survey speedy. The model focuses on vital aspects like accurate counting and categorization of trees, rigorous validation procedures, scalability, efficiency, integration, and visualization. Forest Scan boasts the unique capability of employing two distinct models for tree counting and species classification. Using YOLO (You Only Look Once) model it accurately counts trees with accuracy of 85%, while the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model excels in classifying trees into six different species, including palm, spruces, oaks, pine, banayan and sandalwood with accuracy of 70%.

articleTitle: DigiSketch: Automating the Conversion of Hand-Drawn Diagrams to Digital
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Hand-drawn diagrams play a crucial role in various fields, from education to engineering, yet their integration into the digital realm remains a time consuming and error prone process. This research paper introduces an innovative approach to automatically digitize hand-drawn diagrams, leveraging advancements in computer vision, machine learning, and image processing techniques. Our approach begins with acquiring high-resolution scans or images of hand-drawn diagrams, performing a series of preprocessing steps, enhancing image quality, and correcting distortions to ensure the most accurate representation using annotation tools to annotate diagrams. Further, this work employed TrOCR for text recognition, ensuring precise transcription of handwritten labels. The extracted components are vectorized into scalable and editable digital formats. This approach not only saves time but also preserves the nuances of hand-drawn diagrams, making it understandable to educators and engineers. The automatic digitization of hand-drawn diagrams presented in this paper bridges the gap between analog and digital format, simplifying the transition and enhancing the usability of these valuable visual representations in modern age.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Real-Time Potholes Detection and Analysis by Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Road infrastructure maintenance is crucial for ensuring the safety and efficiency of transportation systems. Potholes pose significant risks to drivers and vehicles, highlighting the need for timely detection and repair. In this paper, we present a novel approach to pothole detection using computer vision techniques. Our solution employs the YOLOv4 Tiny object detection model to identify potholes in video feeds. Leveraging the power of deep learning, we achieve real-time detection of potholes, enabling proactive maintenance measures. Additionally, we integrate geocoding and GPS services to provide location information for detected potholes. This allows for precise identification and prioritization of maintenance efforts. Furthermore, our solution includes email notifications for timely alerts on pothole detections, facilitating efficient response mechanisms. Through this paper, we demonstrate the potential of technology in addressing road maintenance challenges and enhancing road safety.

articleTitle: Hybrid Machine Learning Algorithm for Intrusion Detection Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) rely heavily on accurate classification of network traffic to identify malicious activity. This paper explores an ensemble learning approach for IDS that prioritizes high recall to minimize false negatives (undetected malicious packets). The proposed method combines Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and Multi-Layer Perceptron classifiers, leveraging their strengths to achieve a robust and generalizable model. The ensemble demonstrates high overall accuracy (0.9998) with excellent precision and recall for both normal and potentially malicious traffic. We further discuss the tunability of the model for even higher recall through hyperparameter optimization and class weighting. This focus on high recall is crucial for IDS, where even a single missed malicious packet can have severe security consequences. The proposed ensemble approach offers a promising solution for enhancing IDS performance and mitigating cyber threats.

articleTitle: The Performance Analysis of Health Care Automation using Artificial Intelligence Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has shown great promise in healthcare, especially in healthcare automation. Without human input, AI systems are able to analyze vast volumes of data and make predictions and judgments based on that data. As a result, patient outcomes may be improved, and several healthcare systems may operate more accurately and efficiently. Processes in administration can be streamlined and optimized using AI. As a result, medical staff members are less burdened and can concentrate on giving patients high-quality treatment. AI's application in healthcare presents difficulties. A few issues to be concerned about are AI algorithms' lack of explainability and transparency, possible bias in the training data, and moral problems with patient privacy and data security. Medical diagnosis is a crucial area in which artificial intelligence has been used to automate healthcare. AI algorithms can produce diagnoses and treatment regimens by examining a patient's symptoms, medical history, and other pertinent information. This has demonstrated encouraging outcomes in raising the accuracy of diagnoses and lowering mistake rates.

articleTitle: Optimizing Energy Sustainability in Wireless Body Area Networks through Strategically Allocated Access Windows and Elaborate Delay Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Wireless body area networks (WBANs) could make training and tracking easy from afar. It's hard for WBANs to save energy while still improving network speed. Using delay analysis and entry window selection, this study creates a WBAN system that works well and uses little energy. The suggested method keeps the network stable while saving energy by using sleep timing and variable access window sharing. This technology is better and lasts longer because the communication power and window sizes can be changed in real time. Cross-layer optimization makes the system stronger, so even if something goes wrong, it will still work. We show that the suggested method can fix the main issues with WBANs, which are their unreliability, inefficiency, short-term performance issues, and energy waste. From what we've learned, WBAN needs improvements from the very beginning of the planning process. This page could be useful for both business owners and students. The suggested way not only lowers the amount of energy used by WBAN, but it also makes medical communication networks stronger.

articleTitle: Making Strategic Choices in the Financial Markets: Including Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The financial markets are highly competitive settings that are impacted by various factors and industries. Making the wrong choice can have a multiplicity of negative effects and set off a series of events that could destabilise the economy. Intelligent models have been employed as instruments to support financial market decision-making in recent years.The accessibility and availability of data has created new theoretical and computational hurdles as well as unseen changes in the finance systems. Financial markets have complex systems characteristics, making them hard to predict. While some recent research have attempted to predict financial markets using machine learning techniques, their performance in terms of financial returns has not been sufficient. We suggest using a 2 D- convolutional neural network (CNN) model to forecast the actions of financial markets. This strategy can eliminate biases induced by predetermined factors in technical indicators and the choosing of technical indications by constantly collecting features instead of utilising standard technical indicators that are predetermined. The results of the research show that CNN algorithm extracts more useful and flexible information than typical technical indicators and beats previous machine learning methods in regards to financial performance.

articleTitle: Enhancing Software Defect Prediction Through Root Cause Analysis: A Hybrid Approach Integrating Permutation Importance with XGBoost (PERMBoost)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Software Defect Prediction (SDP) plays an essential role in ensuring software quality and minimizing the costs associated with software failures. Conventional defect prediction approaches often focus on a singular means of defect assessment, neglecting the complex nature of the problem. This paper introduces a hybrid Perm-Boost model for SDP, using strengths of permutation importance and the XGBoost algorithm for root cause analysis (RCA). Evaluated on real-world datasets from NASA-MDP and AEEEM repositories, Perm-Boost outperformed traditional methods, achieving F-m scores of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$99.01,99.19$</tex>, and 79.91 on CM1, PC2, and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$EQ$</tex> datasets, respectively. It demonstrated high precision <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(98.00\%$</tex> for <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{CM}1,98.18\%$</tex> for PC 2) and recall <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(97.01\%$</tex> for CM1, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$99.00\%$</tex> for PC2), surpassing conventional approaches. Additionally, the incorporation of permutation importance facilitated the clarification of the interconnection between software defects and their root causes. This insight enables developers to prioritize tasks based on the severity of identified issues. This paper contributes a hybrid Perm-Boost model for SDP, an in-depth RCA utilizing influential features, a comprehensive case evaluation demonstrating superiority over alternative techniques, and practical guidance for implementing this approach in software projects.

articleTitle: Deep-Fake Finder: Uncovering Forgery Image Through Neural Network Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Digital images are a common form of media shared on social media, and their circulation can undermine news credibility and public trust. This research proposes a method for extracting image content, classifying it, verifying its authenticity, and identifying manipulations. With the exponential increase in social networking services, there has been a huge growth in the generation of image data, leading to the creation of fabricated images. These images are a major source of fake news, negatively impacting society. To verify the authenticity of these images, a method using a CNN deep learning model can be used. Pixel-based fake image detection can find tempering of an image up to a certain level. The raw image can be mangled in sections or as a whole, and it is necessary to recognize the type of image tampering and localize the tampered region. The image is converted into pixel format, and the RGB values are fed into the network's input layer. The output layer has two neurons for phony and genuine images, allowing us to infer if the image is phony and how likely it is to be tampered.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of 4 Bit Carry Generator Circuit Using Pass Transistor Logic with 2 × 1 Mux Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This study employs the pass transistor logic technique to design and implement Very Large-Scale Integration (VLSI) factors in the context of various adders. The area consumption, power consumption, and propagation latency of traditional adders, like Carry Lookahead Adders (CLA) and Ripple Carry Adders (RCA), are frequently problematic. The study investigates the use of the pass transistor logic technique in the design and construction of several adder circuits in order to overcome these issues. This method is well known for its ability to increase efficiency by providing lower power consumption and shorter signal propagation delays. Using 2 × 1 multiplexers in the adder circuits is a crucial part of this strategy. After that, the design stage entails creating modules that are especially suited for various adder configurations while taking into account the particular circumstances in which the carry input (Cin) is either 0 or 1. By selecting the right outputs according to the encoded state, 2 × 1 multiplexers-controlled bypass transistor logic simplify the total number of states the circuit has to handle. The project's goal is to improve adder circuit efficiency by in-depth research and testing, which will further VLSI design for digital circuits.

articleTitle: Crowdfunding Platform Using Decentralised Application (Blockchain)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Blockchain technology provides a safe, transparent, and effective platform that might completely transform public financing. Each transaction is tamper-proof since it is permanently stored with unique identities and timestamps. Furthermore, agreements are automated via smart contracts, which simplifies procedures and lowers errors usually related to human verification. This encourages accountability and confidence inside the system. For platforms that receive public financing, transparency is crucial. This need is met by this blockchain-based online service, which offers a safe and decentralized environment. Donors can simply monitor the initiatives they support and make sure their money is going to where it's supposed to. Should a project be cancelled, the program enables contributors to receive their money back right away. The application caters to two user groups: campaign creators and donors. Donors have access to other fundraising campaigns, project updates, and insightful information. The website gives campaign designers the ability to monitor the status of their initiative and compare their results to those of other campaigns. This blockchain-powered online application provides a stable, open, and safe environment for public fundraising. By empowering both creators and donors, it promotes an ecosystem that is more reliable and efficient.

articleTitle: Social Implications of Fintech for Building A Financially Inclusive Society
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The research work will talk about the influence of fintech on society.to understand how we manage our money and access financial services. As fintech has evolved, significant societal consequences must be carefully considered. The Introduction includes the topic background of fintech in society its impacts will be evaluated and explored. Under data analysis of unemployment rate across India in the financial year 2022” about digital payment growth driving the growth of the digital economy also the volume of transactions both “primary and secondary data” is included (mixed method of research).

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis of Congestion Control Techniques for WSNs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Since Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) have limited resources for data processing, data storage, transmission capacity, and most crucially energy supply, congestion is one of the pervasive problems for WSNs. Over the past fifteen years, numerous survey operations have been conducted to look into and remedy a variety of congestion-related concerns and challenges. The majority of review articles that were published in the literature focused on traditional methods of congestion area management, such as resource-based, traffic-based, and hybrid methods. In this survey article, an effort has been made to provide a systematic evaluation of recent initiatives that have helped to improve the congestion control methodology in WSNs by taking into consideration traditional procedures, machine learning based approaches and nature inspired techniques. A comparative analysis of these techniques with other approaches has also been done to provide a clarity regarding the performance of the algorithms. In this paper, we have tried to highlight the key areas of the application of the algorithms along with their advantages and limitations.

articleTitle: Management of Human Resources 2.0: Applying Machine Learning to the Recruitment and Retention of Talent
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The battle for human resources is getting fiercer as the social economy develops more quickly. As the main method used by businesses to hire new employees, hiring and retention are crucial factors in predicting how these companies will expand in the future. A company's most valuable asset is its workforce. It will always be more laborious and costly for recruiting new employees than retain the current ones. The objective of the paper is to identify the primary causes of voluntary employee turnover and discuss timely strategies for addressing them. The approach suggested in this work models and examines several machine learning classifiers successfully in order to estimate the likelihood of recruiting and retaining candidates prior to training, as well as to illustrate features that influence the decision of the target candidate. The data comes from Kaggle. The outcomes of the algorithms are expressed using traditional metrics; the RF classifier yielded the highest accuracy percentage.

articleTitle: Felis or Canis: Image Classification Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Deep learning, especially Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), have brought revolutions in various fields, by excelling in tasks like classification and object detection. This paper gives in view an approach, focused on grouping the images into two categories: cat (Felis) and dog (Canis). With the increase in the use of image classification in various domains such as object identification in satellite images, machine vision etc., this study aimed to explore varied neural layers in order to achieve accurate classification performance. This paper investigated the effectiveness of convolutional neural networks (an evolved version of artificial neural networks), and image augmentation in training models capable of distinguishing between cats and dogs accurately.

articleTitle: Enhanced Satellite Image Classification Using Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Satellite image classification techniques involve numerous approaches from segmentation to classification using nature inspired algorithms, swarm intelligence approaches and now using different supervised and unsupervised learnings algorithms. This classification involves complicated task as images contains different types of imagery, and different boundaries are overlapped to each other which must be separated so that the useful information must be extracted from the satellite images. In this paper we propose an innovative approach for satellite image classification by integrating Deep Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The CNN architecture offers a solution by combining the strengths of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) in feature extraction with Deep Neural Networks in capturing temporal dependencies. Through this fusion, the model gains enhanced capability in discerning complex patterns within satellite images. The proposed framework undergoes rigorous evaluation on the image set, achieving an remarkable accuracy of 98% in classifying satellite images, surpassing benchmarks set by conventional methods. Such high accuracy makes it a promising tool for various applications, including land use monitoring, disaster management, and urban planning. The findings underscore the potential of CNN-based approaches in advancing satellite image analysis, paving the way for more accurate and efficient remote sensing technologies.

articleTitle: Enhancing Vendor Selection in Supply Chains Using Machine Learning: A Comparative Study of Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Optimal supplier selection step is a vital feature of the supply chain, having a great effect on the company's financial and operating results. The standard methodologies that relied on the lowest rate acceptances have been changed for this purpose as they should be replaced with a more in-depth one that uses multidisciplinary sourcing teams and the most sophisticated analytics. This paper suggests a predictive model for building an appropriate tendering system with machine learning methods. The evaluation model is developed with pre-established criteria that measure the vendor performance on such aspects as the quality, cost, and availability. This generates a combined score useful for successful choices. Data of previous years and optimization algorithms like Nadam, Adam and RMSprop are used and their efficacy is assessed in terms of predicting the model. Neural network architecture developed is already showing the strength of data-driven methods and this is how the management can be better optimised and vendor selection practice improved. The results should have widened the scope of the optimization methods and should emphasized an appropriate selection of optimization algorithms for the high performance.

articleTitle: AI Explainable for Forecasting Crop Production Affected by Weather
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This paper explores the field of Crop prediction technology, looking at its uses and underlying principles. The work of crop prediction is recommending the best crops to cultivate depending on a number of variables, such as cost, upkeep, weather predictions, and available land space. The concept of ”Growing Tomorrow's Harvest Today” is presented as a way to help people and farmers maximize their approaches to crop growth. This method maximizes agricultural productivity while limiting resource use by providing customized crop suggestions via the use of sophisticated algorithms and real-time data analysis. Unpredictable weather patterns, environmental concerns, and the requirement for sustainable farming techniques define the modern agricultural landscape. In order to solve these issues, our project provides an approachable instrument for making knowledgeable decisions in agriculture. The paper is organized to give a thorough overview of the Crop Prediction System, its relevance, and its potential to transform the fields of agriculture and resource management. It explains the project's goals, tasks, and timeframe.

articleTitle: Distributed Image Classification on Big Data Platforms: A Gradient Boosted Trees Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This examination presents a thorough examination concerning the space of distributed picture grouping on tremendous data stages, with a specific focus on using gradient-boosted trees (GBT). The audit differentiates the proposed GBT approach and MapReduce, Apache Flash, and Hadoop Distributed Report Framework (HDFS), evaluating their sufficiency in dealing with tremendous degree picture datasets. The preliminary results show that GBT beats traditional MapReduce, showing overhauled precision (85%) and exactness (87%) while staying aware of vicious audit (84%) and F1 score (85%). Furthermore, when stood out from Apache Flash, GBT exhibits identical characterization execution, with an accuracy of 85% and an execution time of 320 seconds. The coordination of GBT with HDFS for distributed limit and recuperation shows useful data move (180 seconds) and download (150 seconds) times. The revelations highlight the capacity of GBT as a strong and successful response for distributed picture characterization, underlining its flexibility to various tremendous data organizes and showing its responsibility for genuine applications.

articleTitle: Improving Recommendation System Accuracy Augmenting User Profile with Matrix Factorization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Hybrid Recommendation System combines the benefit of content and collaborative filtering while parallelly eliminating their limitations. But this collaboration of content and collaborative filtering does not consider user features and their impact on recommendation. This paper investigates the application of Matrix Factorization (MF) with user profiles to address these limitations and improve recommendation accuracy. In this paper we experimentally test the performance of hybrid recommendation system with different user features. Movie Lens 1M dataset is used in the experiment and result show that performance of system is enhanced. Performance enhancement is check on different evaluation metrics like Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), Hit Rate, Precision and Area Under Curve (AUC). Result also show that sparsity problem of recommendation system is reduced.

articleTitle: Enhancing Advertising Initiatives: Using Machine Learning Algorithms to Engage Targeted Customer
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) systems are developing at a quick pace, which has brought about a major change for many organisations, including digital marketing. Machine learning is a tool used by marketers to identify trends in user behaviour on websites and mobile applications. This aids in their ability to promptly optimise advertising offerings and forecast users' future behaviour. In this paper, we present machine learning-based algorithms for information systems that can be used to optimise advertising services, draw in customers, increase sales, customise promotional offers based on user interests, and set up a spam filter for Facebook or email. Our theory shows that managing advertising campaigns to get better results is a feasible technique. Out of the four digital marketing strategies, advertising marketing offers the highest percentage of revenue to the company (75%) and the best amount of brand publicity (48%), according to the trial's final results shown in figure 2. Under the network marketing strategy, clients' brand sensitivity reaches 53% at the same time.

articleTitle: Facial Emotion Recognition for Virtual Customer Service Agents
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Due to the rapidly changing customer support environment, firms are using virtual agents to improve customer interactions, reduce response times, and deliver better solutions to customer questions, concerns, and issues. Virtual agents must understand and respond to user emotions to enable more human-like interactions. Face recognition, or Facial Expression Recognition (FER) holds significant importance in the field of computer vision and artificial intelligence to understand the emotions of the eyes. Deep learning is used to classify face expressions into emotion categories in this study. We train and test our models on the CK+ dataset for high accuracy. We also offer an interactive online interface for real-time emotion recognition using the Streamlet library. FER improves virtual customer care agents' emotional intelligence and user experience, as shown by our studies.

articleTitle: Non-EEG-Based Seizure Detection: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This paper presents a review of non-electroencephalogram (EEG) modalities for seizure detection. Seizure detection is crucial for individuals with epilepsy, however traditional EEG-based methods pose limitations in terms of accessibility and usability. This study explores alternative signals, such as heart rate variability (HRV), electrocardiogram (ECG), accelerometry, and others, for robust and non-invasive seizure detection. The Paper focuses on various non-EEG-based modalities for seizure detection, including wearable devices, biosensors, smartphone applications, and machine learning algorithms. Each modality is evaluated based on its potential advantages, such as portability, continuous monitoring capabilities, and real-time alerts. This work also investigates recent advancements in non-EEG-based seizure detection, including the integration of multiple physiological signals, such as heart rate variability, skin conductance, and motion on patterns, to improve detection accuracy and reliability. Previously reported results are compared based on the technologies utilized, including wearable multimodal convulsive seizure detectors incorporating electrodermal activity, accelerometry biosensors, and heart rate variability measured using ECG. These results are evaluated on different performance metrics like sensitivity, false alarm rate (FAR), specificity and accuracy. It is found that automated HRV algorithm with matching pursuit (MP) and wigner–ville distribution (WVD) algorithm, has 100% sensitivity and 99.91% Specificity for detecting seizures, while FAR was low 0.2 events/day for wearable multimodal convulsive seizure detectors.

articleTitle: Exploring the Evolution of Music and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) and music production have transformed music production and ushered in a new era of creativity. This comprehensive review examines an area of research— blending music with AI and AI-driven music mixes—highlighting the significant impact of AI on music. This approach uses deep learning and neural networks to improve musical blends by analysing complex sound patterns, resulting in sophisticated combinations This study showcase how artificial intelligence (AI) is changing the concept of music to provide a new artistic platform broadcast. It also examines the further use of AI in music, explores this new research, and demonstrates AI's ability to transform music and inspire a new generation of musicians.

articleTitle: Predicting India's High Export Goods Trade: A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The export of leather goods has a pivotal role in bolstering the Indian economy, with India emerging as the world's 4th ranked exporter in this domain. Notably, India's footwear exports, encompassing both leather and non-leather categories, constitute approximately 51% of the total export share within the Indian leather and footwear industry for the fiscal year 2022-23. Recognizing the significance of forecasting export performance as a catalyst for economic growth, this study focuses on five key leather footwear commodities with a rich history of trade. Employing an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) model driven by data-driven and deep-learning processes, rooted in a machine learning approach, the research endeavours to unveil trade patterns. Evaluation of the model's efficacy is conducted through various metrics, including Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE). The results highlight the superiority of the ANN model leveraging the Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) optimizer over alternative approaches in accurately predicting India's trade dynamics in the leather commodity sector.

articleTitle: Tracing the Progression: Networking Applications From Conventional Methods to Incremental AI/ML Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The swift progression of networking technologies and the escalating intricacy of contemporary network environments have stimulated a burgeoning interest in utilizing advanced techniques to tackle various networking hurdles. This paper offers an overview of the evolution of applications within networking, tracing the progression of fundamental technologies, methodologies, and approaches over time. Through an examination of existing literature, we scrutinize pivotal works, recent progressions, and emerging patterns in the field, encompassing areas such as network optimization, anomaly detection, security, and automation. Our observations underscore the profound impact of these techniques on networking, facilitating more effective utilization of resources, improved security measures, and heightened adaptability to fluctuating network dynamics. By exploring ongoing trends and deliberating on future avenues of research, this paper furnishes insights into the current landscape of applications within networking and provides guidance for researchers and professionals endeavouring to navigate the complexities of contemporary networking environments.

articleTitle: Enhancing Independence: Intelligent Assistance for Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: To aid individuals with visual impairments, this study employs Deep Learning (DL) to develop a comprehensive system capable of describing its surroundings and responding to questions about them. The system comprises two main models: Visual Question Answering (VQA) and Image Captioning (IC). In the IC model, convolutional and recurrent neural network architectures are combined to integrate attention mechanisms for improved captioning. Furthermore, the study introduces two VQA models, one based on Multi-Layer Perceptron and the other on Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). Notably, the LSTM-based VQA model achieves an overall accuracy of 47%, while the IC model achieves an average BLEU-1 score of 0.46.

articleTitle: Improving Tree-Based Machine Learning (ML) Classifier Techniques for Web Mining: An Empirical Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: In order to better recognize and categorize consumer behaviour in internet-based applications, this look at gives an intensive analysis of using tree-based machine learning category strategies in web mining. Web mining is an essential subset of records mining that examines user browsing styles and conduct through taking useful facts out of net server logs. The paper examines and assesses the performance of three classifiers which are tree based type algorithms: TreeJ48, Random Tree, and REP Tree, within the classification of web utilization patterns. Our method contains an intensive experiment conducted on one-of-a-kind dataset percentage splits (60, 70%, 80%, and 90%) to evaluate each algorithm's accuracy and error quotes. The outcomes display that, for all splits, the TreeJ48 method plays better than the others in phrases of classification accuracy and the lowest rates of misclassification.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Diagnosis of Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD) Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Liver disease is one of the leading cause of deaths in the world. It could be reversed if detected at early stage and many lives could be saved thereby. Therefore, it is crucial to detect the liver disease at an early stage. The primary goal of this review is to present a thorough summary of recent research, which have been carried out using machine learning (ML) techniques. These techniques have been developed by researchers to help healthcare professionals to detect non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD). In this study, several ML techniques viz., supervised, unsupervised, and semi-supervised reinforcement learning are covered, whose performance is compared in terms of sensitivity, accuracy, and precision. The prime objective of this study is to present a comparative analysis of different ML methods for the diagnosis and early prediction of liver disease in the medical images.

articleTitle: Changing Aspects of Employee Satisfaction in Digital Era with Flexible Work Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The rise in hybrid work models places a strong emphasis on flexible scheduling, which gives workers autonomy over their work hours. However, it's still unknown how this will affect productivity and well-being. This study investigates the connection between work-life balance, employee happiness, and flexible scheduling in hybrid work settings. It seeks to determine, the impact of flexible scheduling on employee satisfaction and engagement using data analysis and surveys. Flexible scheduling affects the harmony between work and life and negative aspects like cohesiveness, communication, and teamwork. Additionally, the purpose of this research is to educate people and organizations so that flexible scheduling can be used effectively. We can assist organizations in customizing HR policies for a flourishing hybrid work environment that puts success and well-being first by understanding these dynamics. This study reveals the benefits and drawbacks of flexible scheduling for accomplishing both personal and professional objectives, which advances our understanding of the human experience in the rapidly changing world of hybrid work.

articleTitle: Kidney Disease: Early-Stage Identification and Prevention Using Supervised Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) is a long-term medical condition where the kidneys gradually lose their function over time. The main function of the kidneys is to filter waste products and excess fluids from the blood, which are then excreted from the body as urine. CKD is a featureless disorder of the kidney that continues for years without any major symptoms. When people go through a laboratory test for kidney disease then only its chances of detection is possible. There has been a rapid increase in the number of people who suffer from CKD in India over the past few years. For this reason, early diagnosis and effective treatment is essential. In this research study authors use various machine learning techniques such as K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN), Decision Tree (DT), Naive Bayesian Classifier (NB), and Supreme Boosting Classifier (SB) for timely detection and prediction of CKD. The authors used 400 samples from University of California, Irvine (UCI) dataset having 25 attributes of CKD [18]. The results of the study suggest that Supreme boosting classifiers have 99% accuracy which is the greatest among other classifiers used in study.

articleTitle: Client Segmentation and Customization in E-Commerce: Applications of Machine Learning from a Management Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: A machine learning-based e-commerce personalised recommendation system helps address the issue of information overload that inevitably arises when consumers have more and more options in e-commerce, leading to an increasingly complex structure. Customer segmentation is a crucial component of contemporary marketing strategy since it enables companies to effectively adjust their advertising campaigns and customise their communications with customers. Through the analysis of enormous quantities of consumer behaviour data and the discovery of trends that can be utilised for dividing customers into segments, ML algorithms provide a potent tool for automating the procedure of customer segmentation. We report our research and results for identifying a customer's segment. In order to perform machine learning, we integrate the Python Tensorflow library with Pandas for manipulating data frames. To address any discrepancies or gaps in the collected client data, it is refined. Key features are found, and to find hidden patterns and relationships, an exploratory analysis of the data is done. After that, we decide on a suitable machine learning technique to divide the clientele into various groups. We also experiment with several clustering models, including conventional machine learning techniques.

articleTitle: LightClearNet: Lightweight Encoder-Decoder Architecture for Single Image Dehazing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Image dehazing is a crucial low-level vision task that recovers clear images from hazy ones. In recent years, immense progress has been made in recovering the original image as accurately as possible, without any consideration for efficiency and performance on low-end hardware, making it a mere relic for image beautification. Image dehazing could be very critical for enhanced visibility during indoor emergencies like fire hazards, utilization in surveillance and security cameras and in autonomous vehicles, and hence should be quick and easy to compute in order to be accessible. Therefore, we propose LightClearNet, a lightweight yet just as effective model for single image dehazing based around batch normalization and skip connections. The model has been trained on RESIDE-6K dataset and our lightweight model delivers comparable results to DehazeFormer while being twice as performant as the lightest variant of DehazeFormer.

articleTitle: An Evaluation of AI-Enhanced Collaborative Learning Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence in Education is rapidly reshaping learning methodologies and educational dynamics. While AI technologies like intelligent tutoring systems and automated assessment tools enhance personalized learning experiences, concerns about overreliance on AI and the diminishing role of human interaction in education have emerged. In response, few platforms are emerging to bridge the gap between AI-driven recommendations and human collaboration, fostering peer-to-peer learning experiences. This paper proposes a noble platform aimed at facilitating collaborative learning and skill-sharing among learners. The envisioned platform prioritizes community building and inclusivity, offering features such as online sessions, chat functionality, and a reward system to incentivize active participation. Leveraging AI-driven recommendation systems, the platform aims to connect learners with complementary skills, fostering meaningful collaborations and knowledge exchange. Additionally, initiatives like the Noble Recognition Program aim to acknowledge and celebrate positive contributions from community members. By emphasizing community engagement, personalized learning experiences, and a balance between AI-driven recommendations and human interaction, the proposed platform seeks to revolutionize online education and empower learners in the digital age.

articleTitle: Enhancing Syndicate Lending Through AI-Powered Fine-Tuning: Leveraging LLAMA2 for Dynamic Decision Support
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This electronic document describes the involvement of finance agencies and various types of corporate industries through “syndicated loans” that simplify financial transactions for both agencies and corporations. This will be a revolutionary step towards the ‘fintech’ sector as it is all about decentralization and how it changes the whole game during the lending process. This paper describes a proposed process of lending, monitoring, evaluation, and development in the lending process between borrowers (enterprises) and lenders using Large Language Model.
