After highlighting the difficulties in implementing this proposal, the paper also discusses its impact on the transition process and outlines what has already been done. The proposal increases the transparency of the entire process among stakeholders, simplifies manual work, reduces operational costs, and provides data to support the analysis and summarization of benefits derived from the lending process. A secure system offers the ease of use and dexterity of the technology that makes the agenda highly reliable in all aspects of test cases. The study includes the experimentation of proposed system that how it reduces the failure rate of startups by 70% by providing financial aids to startups and suggesting a better business model if needed.

articleTitle: Assessment and Analysis of Seismic Retrofitting Techniques for Performance-based Design of Steel Framed Building in Earthquake-prone Region
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Steel bracing emerges as a good and notable approach for retrofitting, effectively reducing building displacement and strengthening the building. The bracing type used consist the Inverted V, X-Bracing and Diagonal bracing system. The study examines how earthquakes affect buildings, particularly the lateral forces they generate. Various bracing sections, such as Angle, Box, and Pipe sections, are employed to analyse and evaluate the forces in which the building initially fail to meet the required industry standard. A 7-storey steel building structure is used as the subject for retrofitting, the aim is to enhance its ability to withstand earthquakes. The retrofitting involves the use of three bracing systems: the Inverted V, X bracing, and Diagonal bracing. It includes a total of nine different models which are analysed, each with varied sections and bracing systems. Additionally, a model without any bracing is created for comparison. These models are analysed using Linear static analysis in ETABS software. After the comparison between the number of models, it becomes evident that the Box section outstands and performs better than the pipe section and the angle sections in tackling the lateral forces that occurred in the seismic region. It also assesses the effectiveness of the bracings in reducing storey displacement and demonstrating its effectiveness in enhancing the structural resilience.

articleTitle: Enhancing New Hire Onboarding Through Immersive Augmented Reality Training: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Absolutely, effective onboarding plays a pivotal part in the succession and retention of new hires within organizations. It sets the tone for their experience, helping them acclimate to the company culture, understand their roles and responsibilities, and establish connections with colleagues. A well-planned onboarding process can importantly increase job satisfaction, productivity, and long-term commitment among new employees. Traditional onboarding methods often struggle to provide immersive and engaging training experiences that effectively convey job tasks and procedures. Augmented reality (AR) technology offers a promising solution by providing interactive and immersive training experiences that overlay digital information onto the real-world environment. This comparative study seeks to assess the efficiency of immersive Augmented Reality (AR) training in new hire onboarding, comparing it to conventional onboarding approaches. Through a randomized controlled trial, new hires will undergo either AR-based training or traditional training, and their learning outcomes, engagement levels, and retention of job-related knowledge and skills will be assessed. Qualitative interviews will also be conducted to gather insights into participants' experiences with AR-based onboarding. The results of this study will offer valuable insights into both the potential advantages and obstacles associated with integrating Augmented Reality (AR) technology to improve the onboarding procedures for new hires.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Sentiment Analysis for Mining Consumer Opinion in Online Product Rating
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This study conducts a comprehensive analysis contrasting two distinct sentiment analysis models: VADER and Roberta, a sophisticated pre-trained deep learning model integrated via the Transformers library pipeline. Emphasizing their performance in predicting sentiment from product ratings and reviews, this research aims to provide a nuanced understanding of their respective methodologies. Initially, an extensive review of VADER's rule-based approach and Roberta's advanced pre-trained architecture is presented, highlighting unique strengths and limitations inherent in each model. Subsequently, both models undergo rigorous training and evaluation using a rich dataset of product ratings and reviews, consisting of 500 readings carefully selected from the larger dataset of 568,454 readings. Rigorous assessment metrics, including accuracy, precision, and recall, are employed to gauge their proficiency in sentiment classification. The study's outcomes shed light on the applicability and efficiency of NLTK-anchored VADER and Roberta within the e-commerce sphere, contributing valuable insights into leveraging distinct models for extracting actionable customer insights. Specifically, VADER achieved an accuracy of 82%, precision of 78%, and recall of 85%, while Roberta demonstrated higher performance with an accuracy of 88%, precision of 85%, and recall of 90%. By exploring product rating sentiment analysis, this research facilitates informed, data-driven decisions for businesses, ultimately enhancing customer satisfaction and refining product development strategies for sustainable growth. The findings underscore the importance of leveraging advanced deep learning techniques for robust sentiment analysis in modern e-commerce ecosystems.

articleTitle: Influence of AI and MAS in Enhancing Energy Efficiency of 6G Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Next-generation Internet of Things (IoT) is progressing rapidly due to the introduction of beyond 5G (B5G) and the approaching arrival of 6G, which have improved the dependability, productivity, and profitability of both industrial and personal operations. Nevertheless, data overload is frequently caused by the abundance of wireless sensors in commercial 6G devices. Data mining gathers useful information in order to solve this. Meanwhile, in the 6G architecture, edge computing enables automated equipment operations and intelligent decision-making in real-time. Even so, despite the drawbacks of sensor-based energy sources, the integration of many technologies has led to an increase in energy. Using a multi-agent system (MAS) approach, a system model for industrial wireless sensor networks in 6G applications has been presented in order to combat this. Sensor node clustering locates and forecasts the locations of principal nodes by employing distributed artificial intelligence (DAI). Convolutional neural networks (CNN) and back-propagation neural networks (BPNN) are used in optimisation. Allocating resources to individual nodes efficiently is made possible by the analysis of inter-cluster correlations. The outcomes of the simulation show how well the approach works to reduce resource waste, increase overall energy efficiency, and protect important data. This strategy improves network performance in industrial 6G applications while simultaneously addressing concerns about energy consumption.

articleTitle: Optimization of 4 × 10 Gbps WDM-FSO System Incorporating Gain Flattening Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Rapidly expanding internet information traffic currently has exhilarated rising demand for high user access transmission bandwidth. With respected existing bandwidth accessible for future optical network, a significant problem to resolve is growing modern techniques for effective utilization of system bandwidth resources. A 4 × 10Gbps wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) and free space optics (FSO) system utilizing gain flattening filter is realized. The maximum range of 100km is obtained at aggregate 40Gbps throughput via simulation analysis. Also, received power of −24dBm is obtained w.r.t. input power of 7.13dBm. The proposed system illustrates wide open eye pattern compared to existing ones.

articleTitle: Applications of Deep Learning in Marketing Analytics: Predictive Modeling and Segmenting Customers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: These days, modelling techniques for forecasting consumer behaviour based on historical datasets are built utilising machine learning and deep learning, which are considered important tools for successful E-commerce. Advertisers aim to target particular people or groups with their messaging in today's fiercely competitive market, frequently ignoring their most important customers in the process. At this point, estimating customer lifetime value (CLV) becomes essential for helping businesses use their resources wisely. In order to accomplish this, businesses can use analytical tools and predictive models to target particular customers with customised campaigns, allowing for educated choices regarding advertising expenditures. Organisations can gain an edge over others by implementing the concepts discussed in this research to identify and retain their most valuable clients. When advertising strategies are modified in response to changes in customer categories, there is enormous potential for growth and client retention. In order to help marketers optimise their advertising campaigns, this work offers a thorough approach, tools, and insights that help anticipate changes in consumer segmentation and CLV.

articleTitle: Algorithmic Trading: Financial Markets Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This research study gives an in - depth view of the recent developments in the fields of Machine Learning (ML) and Reinforced Learning (RL) techniques as they are related to various models for forecasting and systems for financial trading. The practical usage of deep learning models, that incorporates Neural Networks such as Recurrent, Convolutional along with hybrid models integrating genetic algorithms with LSTM networks, for forecasting the stock market patterns as well as bank failures, and fluctuations in exchange rate which is addressed in this study in an in - depth review analysis of the latest literature. In addition to this it also investigates how trading algorithm performance as well as risk management can be enhanced by applying techniques of deep reinforcement learning. This study also demonstrates the enhanced, efficacy, precision and the profitability achieved by using these artificial intelligence methods as compared with conventional economic modelling and detailed technical study models by analysing a number of stock markets and different kinds of assets.

articleTitle: Advancements in Automated Tumor Detection Screening: A Comprehensive Review and Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This paper offers a thorough examination and comparative assessment of recent advancements in automated tumor detection methodologies. Covering a range of aspects related to tumor detection, such as image capture, preprocessing, feature extraction, classification methods, and performance assessment measures, the review delves into the application of multiple medical imaging modalities, including computed tomography (CT), magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), and histopathological photography. Additionally, it looks at how deep learning and machine learning algorithms— specifically, support vector machines (SVMs), convolutional neural networks (CNNs), and ensemble learning techniques—achieve accurate tumor categorization. Moreover, the paper addresses challenges and limitations inherent in automated tumor detection systems, including data imbalance, interpretability of machine learning models, and integration with clinical workflows. By conducting a comparative analysis of existing automated tumor detection approaches, this paper aims to provide researchers and clinicians with valuable insights into current state-of-the-art techniques, their strengths, and limitations. Furthermore, it identifies promising avenues for future research to advance the field of automated tumor detection screening and ultimately improve patient outcomes in oncology.

articleTitle: Optimization of Sentiment Analysis using BERT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This study presents a comprehensive exploration of a sentiment analysis algorithm enhanced by the BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) model. The BERT model's integration into our sentiment analysis algorithm has resulted in performance that surpasses traditional methods, including Support Vector Machines (SVM), Logistic Regression (LR), and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) networks. The findings of this research are poised to contribute significantly to the field of sentiment analysis, providing a robust framework for future applications in understanding customer feedback.

articleTitle: Smart Cities Using GPS to Find the Location of Smart Dustbin
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Mission of swachh Bharat and Digital India are more focused for Smart cities and Clean Cities. The people of India are now moving towards smart cities and more opted automated system. There are some problems that are still needed to be solved. Like, there are toilets at public places and no proper drainage system on the other hand; there is garbage and no dustbin for it. On contrary, there is dustbin most of the time it is difficult to find them. This paper proposes, “to find the location using GPS of smart dustbin in Smart cities through mobile or wearable device” to get the exact location of dustbins. GPS Tracking Device is used to implement this idea as it is having an ability to detect the nearby objects without any physical connection.

articleTitle: Development of Language Model on Biomedical Domain to Pretrain Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Large neural language model like BERT can be pre trained to get extraordinary profits through multiple natural language processing task. Though, General Domain Corpora including web and news wire are focused on pre training efforts. The main specific pre training are benefited from general domain language models is considered as a prevailing assumption. The study focusses on the domain specific language model with abundance of unlabeled text like biomedical natural language processing and pre training from its scratch that results in more gains over the general domain language model. The investigation can be facilitated by compiling of biomedical NLP data sets that are publicly available. The experiment shows the pre training of domain specific model that act as a solid foundation in performing biomedical NLP task in wide range. the model is evaluated for modelling choices including task specific fine tuning and pre training. BERT models have some common practises involving named entity recognition using complex tagging schemes. The research can be accelerated with biomedical NLP for pre training and task specific model for the biomedical community and the leader board is created for biomedical language understanding and reasoning benchmark (BLURB).

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Techniques for Congestion Avoidance & Control in Wireless Body Area Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: In past few years, considerable amount of research has been done in wireless sensor networks which have helped to discover the potential of wireless sensor networks (WSN) in many areas such as military, environment, communication, healthcare etc. Major improvements have been noted in healthcare having prominent discoveries in wireless body area networks (WBAN). WBANs help in monitoring the health of the patients remotely and prove to be a very economical solution for healthcare providers as well as patients by gathering biological data and transmitting it to the base station or the healthcare providers. Along with benefits, come various limitations of WBANs like coverage area, data security, congestion, scalability etc. Congestion has become one of the major issues in healthcare and if not addressed in time, can lead to critical packets not being sent and delay in receiving critical information which can prove harmful for the patient. In this paper, an extensive study has been done to study about various protocols developed to detect, avoid and mitigate congestion in order to provide seamless and timely delivery of services.

articleTitle: EEG-EmoNet: A Deep Learning Framework for Emotion Recognition from EEG Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Emotion recognition is a basic aspect of human interaction and understanding In recent years, there has been a growing interest in developing automated systems capable of accurately detecting and classifying human emotions using electroencephalography (EEG) data. EEG, a non-invasive technique for measuring electrical activity in the brain, offers valuable insights into the neural correlates of emotional states. This paper aims to explore and develop a robust emotion recognition system utilizing EEG data. An EEG dataset comprising recordings from individuals experiencing different emotional stimuli is collected, ensuring diversity and representativeness of emotions. The collected data is then pre-processed to remove noise, artifacts, and other unwanted signals, enhancing the quality and reliability of the EEG signals. The paper also explores the potential for real-time emotion recognition from EEG data, aiming to develop an efficient system that can provide timely and accurate emotion detection. We start by providing an overview of EEG and its use in emotion detection. We then review various machine learning algorithms that have been used for emotion detection using EEG data, including Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), Attention Model etc, thus giving a test accuracy of 97.50 percent

articleTitle: Exploring Neural Network Approaches for Alzheimer's Disease Detection: an Analysis of RNN and CNN Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease is a degenerative neurological ailment marked by memory loss, cognitive decline, and behavioral disturbances. It is the most common type of dementia, affecting millions of people globally, primarily the elderly. The disease is characterized by the formation of plaques and tangles in the brain, which disrupt neuronal communication and eventually lead to cell death. In this study, we analyze the use of machine learning models in the context of Alzheimer's disease, which were CNN and RNN. The RNN is a deep learning model that has been trained to interpret and transform sequential data inputs into particular sequential data outputs. However, CNNs are deep learning models that excel at identifying spatial correlations in data, which makes them a good fit for image analysis tasks like analyzing MRI scans, which are frequently utilized in AD research. We used datasets from the OASIS, which offers publicly available brain imaging datasets for Alzheimer's disease research, and from Kaggle, a well-known platform for data science competitions and cooperation, to train and assess these models. Our experimental results demonstrate the promising performance of the models on both datasets. During our work, On the OASIS dataset, CNN achieved 100% accuracy, whereas RNN achieved 73.15%. On the Kaggle dataset, the CNN model achieved 97.33% accuracy, while the RNN model achieved 80.67%.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Organizational Culture Evolution: A Critical Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Businesses are embracing technological innovations in today's constantly evolving digital ecosystem with the objective to encourage innovation, improve productivity, and maintain viability. Artificial Intelligence initiatives within an organisation will unavoidably impact the underlying culture, posing both advantages and disadvantages. This study explores the ways that artificial intelligence and digital technology affects culture and looks at how digital transformation initiatives affect organisational norms, beliefs, and behaviours. The findings show that digital technology can encourage adaptability in society, collaboration, and flexibility in a complicated and sometimes in contradiction approach, but they also show the significant impact these technologies may have in this area. This study contributes to our comprehension of the complex interaction between organisational culture and digital technology. It facilitates modern firms in their efforts to undergo digital transformation by offering helpful data that may guide strategic decisions.

articleTitle: Gain Enhancement of CPW Fed Microstrip Patch Antenna Using Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This study investigates the use of meta surface to increase gain in CPW-fed microstrip patch antennas. The meta surface is made up of a 4×4 grid of square pieces that measure 18.8×18.8 mm2 at height 2.25. There is a radiation box measuring 60×60×30 mm3 that is filled with air and a ground plane measuring 20×20 mm2. Within the radiation box is a 1.5 mm layer of foam with relative permittivity and permeability of 1.06 and 1, respectively. The substrate is 0.75 mm thick and composed of FR-4 epoxy resin. Its relative permeability is 1 and its relative permittivity is 4.4. This study examines the effect of these parameters on the antenna system's gain improvement through simulations and analysis, offering insightful information for enhancing antenna performance.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Semiconductor Technology: A Comprehensive Review of FinFET
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Theneedfor 3-Dimensional multiple-gate “MOSFETs”, such as “FinFETs”, has risen in recent years. FinFET is a Double Gated (DG) MOS device that provides good performance since it is less vulnerable to short channel impacts and can be manufactured using normal bulk planar CMOS techniques. FinFETs are generally simple to manufacture and do not suffer from the alignment issues that plague many other transistors. “Microcontrollers, integrated chips, signal processors, amplifiers, and sensors (such as temperature, motion, pressure, shock, proximity, sound, gas, and infrared)” that use FinFET technology provide improved technology for internet of things (IoT) applications. The primary goal of this review paper is to provide a well understanding of FinFET technology and its applications.

articleTitle: Personalized Collaborative Search Engine for Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Web search engines are used for retrieving information but still there exists ambiguity in their retrieval process. It is so because traditional search engines laid emphasis on matching of keywords rather than maintaining semantic relations among terms lack of ability to produce precise results, presence of ambiguous keywords and verifying needs of users are few hindrances that are acting as scenario for web search engines. The paper focuses on improving search quality of users by collecting user experiences through creating hierarchical user profile it leads to collaborative search engine that helps in reaching at particular decision then the collected user's data are uploaded to recommendation server which are than displayed a search engines like Google/Yahoo.

articleTitle: Enhanced Fake News Detection With Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The ubiquitous use of social media impacts the social life of humans. Fake news negatively affects a person's behavior. Fake news detection in social media has been a challenging problem for the last decade. Researchers are searching for accurate methods to detect fake news as early as possible. This paper discusses two NLP methods, LSTM, and bi-directional LSTM, that detect fake news. This paper uses a fake news challenge dataset, categorized into four stance labels: agree, disagree, discussed, and unrelated. Experimental results showed LSTM model received 92% accuracy in testing time and 95% accuracy in training time. On the extension of the method, Bi- directional LSTM achieved 95% accuracy in testing time and 98% accuracy in training time.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Unified Payment Interface (UPI) in Tamil Nadu Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Nowadays, the process of transferring money in physical mode is eradicated and moved to the next level based on online UPI payments. The proposed system will integrate machine learning techniques to identify the impact on UPI transactions. The transaction details are classified based on the patterns by utilizing advanced machine learning techniques and produce the accurate output. The user behavior, timestamp of the transaction and the size of the transaction are considered as important factors in the proposed system. The proposed approach deploys an effective framework for classification which will help the stakeholders to respond based on the constantly changing market needs. This approach is effectively used for predicting the implications of UPI transactions based on the changes in the market needs in an effective way.

articleTitle: HDL Environment for the Synthesis of 2-Dimensional and 3- Dimensional Network on Chip Mesh Router Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Application specific Network on Chip (NoC) designs are quickly becoming the technology of choice for solving the problem of multiprocessor system architecture. Broadband, interposes communication, deadlock avoidance, port bandwidth, router architecture, and bespoke NoCs may all be improved by modelling and simulation of multilayer network structures and synthesis. Topology-based organization of 2D and 3D routers allows for the construction and laDyout of NoCs. The articles compare and contrast the design and analysis of two-dimensional and three-dimensional network-on-chip routers for setting up mesh topological nodes in a network. Xilinx 14.2 is used to execute the code. The most recent version of modalism, 10.0 student edition, is used to functionally mimic the program and modules. The experimental work and thorough testing on the Virtex-5 FPGA confirm the chip design.

articleTitle: Q-Learning-Based Approach to Detect Tumor in Human –Brain
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The brain's own aberrant and unregulated cell division is what causes brain tumors. In the tumor growth exceeds 50%, the patient will not be able to recover. As a result, rapid and precise brain tumor identification is required. Brain image processing research started to focus heavily on brain tumors. Hence, a novel methodology of image processing is proposed for fast and accurate brain tumor detection. Reinforcement-based Q-learning technique is proposed for classifying brain tumor MRI images. Every MRI image is divided into 8 × 8 blocks and the features like mean, variance, skew ness, kurtosis, entropy, contrast, correlation, energy, and homogeneity are extracted. Ground truth matrix is generated by using discrete wavelet transform with which MRI image divided blocks are classified as 0 and 1 where 1 is the tumored block and 0 is the normal block. Reward mechanism in Q-learning is used to further classify the tumored and normal brain images. The efficiency of the classification is compared with other existing algorithms like Dense Net, ensemble methods, and SVM and CNN in accordance with performance parameters like accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity. The accuracy of the proposed algorithm is 97%, sensitivity is 96% and specificity is 97% proving that the proposed algorithm is highly efficient in classifying brain tumor MRI images.

articleTitle: Beyond Automation: Understanding the Transformational Capabilities of AI in Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The investigation explores at the various ways that artificial intelligence (AI) is affecting management techniques. The study highlights the dichotomy between automation and augmentation, highlighting how artificial intelligence (AI) can replace human work through automation, but its ultimate use in augmenting human capabilities (augmentation) leads to better organisational performance. This analysis reveals how AI-driven tactics enhance operational efficiency, decision-making, and productivity by synthesising research findings from a variety of domains, including manufacturing, banking, municipal sectors, and remote work environments. It also looks at how AI may change management through big data and data analytics, recommending a shift to an integrated strategy that combines automation and human understanding to promote creativity and long-term growth.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Explainable AI-NLP Framework for Text Categorization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Although there has been a decrease in interpretability, significant progress has lately been achieved in developing state-of-the-art models. This assessment provides a thorough analysis of Explainable AI (XAI) within the framework of Natural Language Processing (NLP). This study examines the fundamental classification of descriptions in addition to the many techniques for producing and displaying explanations. The purpose of the survey is to provide a comprehensive study of the many approaches and strategies used to clarify the models' predictions, making it a helpful tool for people who develop NLP models. Additionally, we draw attention to the gaps in the current literature and urge further investigation into potential avenues for this crucial field of study. An experiment is also conducted and the results are discussed in this article.

articleTitle: Enhancing Radio Frequency Performance of InGaAs-SOI-FinFET Through Optimized Channel Doping Density
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: In this work, we investigate the impact of channel doping density variation on the radio frequency (RF) performance of Indium Gallium Arsenide (InGaAs) SOI-FinFETs. The FinFET architecture offers unique advantages for RF applications due to its superior electrostatic control and reduced short-channel effects. By modulating the doping density in the channel region, we aim to optimize device performance for RF applications. Through extensive simulations, we demonstrate significant improvements in key RF metrics such as cutoff frequency <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(f_{\mathrm{T}})$</tex>, transconductance frequency product (TFP), maximum oscillation frequency <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(f_{\mathrm{M}\mathrm{A}\mathrm{X}})$</tex>, gain transconductance frequency product (GTFP) and gain frequency product (GFP). Thus, emerging trends and challenges in leveraging InGaAs-SOI-FinFET for RF applications, include considerations for circuit design, process integration, and reliability. Our findings also reveal the critical role of channel doping density in achieving enhanced RF performance in InGaAs-SOI-FinFETs, offering valuable insights for the design and optimization of future high-frequency electronic devices..

articleTitle: Monitoring and Prediction of Supervision System for Industrial and Manufacturing Sectors Using Cloud Computing and Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The evolution of the Industry 4.0 is initialized through block chain technology with cloud computing techniques. This includes the integration of digital environment with internet of things (IoT) and cyber security systems. Thus the amalgamation of advanced technologies paved way for the rise of Industry 4.0. This helps in providing security and privacy without any consequences. This helps to save and interchange the information within the network without any centralized organizations. It plays a prominent role in the production and manufacturing sectors by trusting built in the supply chain management system. They adopt numerous advantages in adopting secure financial transactions. This helps to maintain the end-user sustenance. The monitoring and prediction of the supervision system is performed by SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) system that employs various intelligent systems in manufacturing and production sectors. This supports in accumulating and processing the real time data in the industries. The supervisory organization shows an essential character in the performance efficiency of the industrial sectors.

articleTitle: Examining the Impacts and Obstacles of AI-Driven Management in Present-Day Business Contexts
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This paper explores the growing role of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the management structures of modern business organizations. In order to improve operational effectiveness and overall success, it focuses on the integration and effects of AI within Management Information Systems (MIS). The study finds the many advantages artificial intelligence (AI) offers to knowledge management, resource management systems, and organizational effectiveness through a thorough analysis. The paper uses a wide range of scholarly references to explain different aspects of AI-powered management, such as strategic planning, decision-making, and sustainable marketing tactics. The study highlights a notable void in the all-encompassing comprehension of artificial intelligence's concrete contribution to business improvement, thereby promoting a deeper and more empirical investigation of AI's incorporation into business operations.

articleTitle: Identifying Early Signs of Bipolar Disorder Risk by Food Habit Analysis in Forensic Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The recent study of the forensic science explains that there are several reasons for the person involving into the criminal acts. One the reason for the person involving in the criminal acts is bipolar disorder. The proposed strategy makes it simpler to pre-process and improves data interpretation by using descriptive statistics and visualization approaches to acquire insights into the dataset characteristics from datasets gathered from Kaggle with various mental health information. The model's primary technique is the use of regression techniques, such as conventional high-dimensional modelling for predictive analysis. The comparison study shows that the high-dimensional model of regression performed better, showing reduced error rates and higher scores for R2, which enhanced prediction. Research on the connection between eating habits and the eventual outcome of bipolar illness not only demonstrates validity but also suggests a possible link between eating habits and depressed outcomes.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Classification of MRI Scans using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Classification is essential for accurate brain cancer treatment and diagnosis management. A variety of neurological conditions can be brought on by brain tumours, which are abnormal expansions of brain tissue. Tumours may be cancerous, or they could be benign. However, precise classification is quite challenging due to the intricacy of tumour shape and imaging heterogeneity. This effort aims to improve the classification reliability for brain tumours by employing models trained with deep learning such as VGG16, ResNet, along with EfficientNet. Building such models on a dataset of MRI scans of the brain is the process used to classify tumours into discrete categories. Beyond additional performance expectations, the results indicate that EfficientNet outperforms VGG16 and ResNet with respect to accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity. The more precise cancer classification becomes attainable by EfficientNet's enhanced efficiency, which shows how effectively it can retrieve complicated information from brain MRI data. In conclusion, EfficientNet has the potential to improve healthcare and therapeutic options by increasing the reliability of brain tumour classification through the specialized use of algorithms based on deep learning.

articleTitle: Utilizing Imaging Steganographic Improvement using LSB & Image Decoder
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Hidden data in images, often at the expense of visual quality degradation, are concealed by image steganography. To improve the quality of stego images, this study looks at integrating image decoders and special loss function. Deep learning-based image decoders aid in minimizing distortions caused by embedding, while perceptual loss functions replace traditional metrics to better align with human visual perception. Our goal is to develop a steganographic framework that prioritizes the carrier image's visual integrity while maintaining the hidden data's undetectability. Evaluation will focus on imperceptibility and the objective and subjective quality of the decoded images.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Mental Health Prediction Using Machine Learning: A Study on Meditators and Non-Meditators
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: A day-by-day world evolving problems related to human beings are also increasing continuously. Among these issues, health-related concerns stand out as particularly significant. According to the World Health Organization in 2019, 1 in every 8 people, or 970 million people around the world were living with a mental disorder, with depression and anxiety disorder being the most common. As a result of the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, there was a significant increase in the number of people suffering from anxiety and depression. According to early projections, major depressive disorders and anxiety disorders will both rise by 26% and 28% in just one year, respectively. The early prediction of Mental health is very important to take Medicine This research article examines how effective machine learning algorithms are in predicting psychological symptoms in those who practice meditation compared to those who do not. Given the rising popularity of meditation as a self-care treatment, it is essential to understand its possible effects on psychological well-being. The research uses psychological symptom ratings and demographic data from both those who practice meditation and those who do not. Several machine learning algorithms are used to forecast psychiatric symptoms using variables like meditation habits, demographics, and other pertinent characteristics. Among the various algorithms, SVM and logistic regression performed very well and meditators showed high resilience towards anxiety, depression, and stress as compared to those who are not.

articleTitle: Development of a Novel Quality of Service Aware Video Streaming on Demand System for the Internet of Thing Enabled MANET
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: A mobile ad hoc network (MANET) uses mobile devices and wireless networking to stream video. Several methods have been developed to address the challenges associated with video streaming over MANETs. This paper designed a new protocol for Mobile Video of Demand (MVOD) system architecture over the MANET environment. The proposed MVOD Model is used to improve the QoS parameters of the video system in wireless ad-hoc networks. The MVOD protocol uses client caching algorithms and a staggered broadcasting method, and it compares its performance with that of an existing traditional protocol for three-tier architecture. When compared to QoS parameters such as service delay and bandwidth utilization, the proposed MVOD model performs better than the traditional approach when compared with various scenarios. Based on the importance and complexity of evaluating the techniques, we conclude that comparability problems exist in research.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling for Breast Cancer Diagnosis and Prognosis: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The number of deaths from breast cancer is rising dramatically every year. It is the most common kind of cancer overall and the leading cause of death for women globally. Any advancement in the identification and prognosis of cancer is crucial to a long and healthy life. Therefore, it's critical to have a high level of accuracy in cancer prognosis in order to update patient survivability standards and treatment aspects. Machine learning approaches have shown to be a powerful method, have become a research hotspot, and can significantly contribute to the process of early detection and prediction of breast cancer. In this study, we used the Breast Cancer dataset from kaggle on four machine learning algorithms: Random Forest, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN).Among four algorithms, the random forest gives the best accuracy of 96percent.

articleTitle: The Disease Prediction System based on Symptom Identification and Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This paper aims to investigate a system that uses various machine-learning algorithms to predict symptoms and deep-learning techniques for image processing that leads to early disease prediction, an essential aspect of today's healthcare industry. The main objective of this system is to enable both the healthcare professionals and the patients to interpret the results at a faster rate. Existing systems provide results based on only symptoms which is not very effective in real-time but our system works well with both symptoms and image-based specifications. This investigation explores several algorithms like Random Forest, Decision tree, XGBoost, Logistic regression, Long-term short memory (LSTM), and Naïve Bayes for symptom-based prediction [14]. CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) deep learning techniques, notably DenseNet121, are used for image processing. The use of image processing bridges the gap between the user who feels symptom-based prediction to be a bit difficult. Furthermore, diverse experiments are done on multiple datasets to establish more accurate results. This system also ensures the safeguarding of sensitive information. The proposed disease prediction system helps empower healthcare professionals and individuals with proactive insights into potential health risks by giving accurate predictions for early intervention of the disease.

articleTitle: Decentralized Storage Based on a Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Current distributed storage solutions often rely on a few centralized cloud servers, posing significant risks such as data loss, leaks, and tampering. To address these vulnerabilities, exploring decentralized storage systems is crucial. Maintaining data consistency in such environments has been a challenge until the advent of blockchain technology, known for its decentralized, tamper-proof, and traceable features, offering a promising solution. In this study, we've devised a decentralized storage framework by merging Hyperledger Fabric and the Inter Planetary File System (IPFS). Our focus extends to enhancing the security and availability of this decentralized storage system. We delve into partitioning techniques and a k-r allocation scheme for stored data. We propose an allocation function for managing stored files and derive a mathematical formula to quantify file security and availability based on this function. Additionally, we explore optimal parameter settings within the allocation function, ensuring robust security and availability of stored files. Our experimental findings indicate that the k- r allocation policy emphasizing the minimum number of nodes (MNN) outperforms the policy based on the minimum slices number (MSN). However, while both policies ensure comparable security and availability, the MNN policy results in a higher number of copies, potentially leading to a relatively inefficient utilization of storage space.

articleTitle: Impact of Model Selection on Pulmonary Effusion Diagnosis Using Prediction Analysis Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Model selection is of utmost significance for accurate analysis and treatment of pulmonary effusion. With the increasing complexity of scientific statistics and the advancement of prediction analysis algorithms in the clinical field, model selection has emerge as a critical step in a hit prediction evaluation. In this text, we have a look at the effect of version choice on pulmonary effusion prognosis the use of a hard and fast of prediction evaluation algorithms. We compare the overall performance of different algorithms in phrases of accuracy, kind-I and sort-II errors, and interpretability. We demonstrate that version selection can have an effect on the accuracy and interpretability of the diagnosis and for this reason the remedy plan installed for the patient. We in addition talk the consequences for practitioners, clinicians, and researchers, who have to don't forget the deserves of model choice whilst the use of prediction analysis algorithms for the analysis of pulmonary effusion. Version choice is a crucial a part of the predictive evaluation pipeline, as the selection of version for given software may have a large effect on accuracy and performance. In the context of pulmonary effusion (PE) analysis, an appropriate choice of a predictive evaluation set of rules can enhance the detection of PE abnormalities and facilitate scientific decision making. Numerous algorithms were carried out to broaden models for PE prognosis, which includes synthetic neural networks, help vector machines, logistic regression, and decision trees.

articleTitle: A Security-Aware Wireless Sensor Network for Utilizing An Energy-Efficient Naïve Bayes Clustering Protocol
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSN) play a major role in the development of a variety of smart systems, including health, medical, and military applications. WSN is made up of small sensor nodes (SNs), which sense data for these applications. It's crucial that the sensor networks maintain the transmission of information for these sensitive applications. The SNs sense the information, process it, and then transmit into the base station (BS). While performing these tasks, a lot of the SN's power gets consumed. However, these SNs are equipped with a limited number of batteries. As a result, after a time, these nodes become dead, due to which the whole network gets compromised. These SN batteries are also non-rechargeable and non-replaceable. As a result, preserving the energy of these SNs becomes more difficult. Security is crucial in energy-efficient routing for Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) due to data confidentiality, integrity, and availability concerns. It prevents unauthorized access, safe guards against attacks, establishes trust among nodes, and ensures authentication and key management. Security-aware routing maintains network resilience and compliance with regulations, enhancing data trustworthiness for applications like healthcare and industrial control. One of the major issues is determining the optimal cluster head (CH). However, this paper uses a Nave Bayes classifier algorithm to provide the solution for the ideal CH node. As a result, we have developed an energy-efficient Nave Bayes-based clustering protocol (EENBCP) for WSN. Extensive simulations have revealed that the suggested approach conserves energy more efficiently and increases the lifespan of the network.

articleTitle: Analysis and Evaluation of Load Shaping Using Different Technique with Reference to Indian Power Sector
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: A greater percentage of electricity was used by homes than by businesses or government agencies, according to studies. Most people in third-world countries either don't have access to the national power system or endure regular blackouts. This implies that people living in these countries may only use power for the barest necessities. This study explores the feasibility of using a nano-scale autonomous wind-PV system to meet the energy demands of people in these countries, with the help of demand-side management strategies that keep the per-person daily cost of energy to a minimum. Depending on renewable energy potential, daily energy prices may be reduced to competitive levels, and producing electricity sustainably for 20-25 years of lifetime is also conceivable for emergency scenarios, according to preliminary data.

articleTitle: RECRIoT-MAC: A Reliable and Energy Efficient Resource Management for Internet of Things Based Cognitive Radio Multi- Channel MAC Protocol
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Currently, the overcrowding of unlicensed spectrum bands is causing severe interference to IoT devices embedded with sensors. CR-IoT networks apply cognitive radio capabilities to the internet of things to solve the spectrum scarcity issue in conventional IoT networks. An CR radio detects available spectrum channels by dynamically modifying its programming and configuration. IoT, smart cities, and 5G all benefit from cognitive radio applications. A cognitive radio application is useful for IoT, smart cities, and 5G. Compared to benchmark Cognitive Radio MAC (CR- MAC) protocols, the proposed protocol is more reliable, intelligent, and smart. CR technology for IoT applications can be advanced by us in order to make IoT more affordable and applicable. It is demonstrated by comparing the proposed RECRIoT-MAC protocol with benchmark CR-MAC protocols that is more energy efficient and consumes less communication time. This paper examines RECRIoT-MAC's energy consumption and throughput.

articleTitle: Analysis of AI Driven Brain Stroke Prediction Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: In today's era, the convergence of modern technology and healthcare has paved the path for novel diseases prediction and prevention technologies. Brain strokes, a major public health concern around the world, necessitate accurate and prompt prediction in order to reduce their devastation. This study provides a comprehensive assessment of the literature on the use of Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) models in predicting of brain strokes. Through the synthesis of existing research, this paper identifies trends, best practices, and gaps in current literature, providing valuable insights for our research. Review encourages in the development of more robust, efficient, and interpretable predictive models for brain stroke prediction, thereby significantly improving patient outcomes and reducing the societal burden of this debilitating condition.

articleTitle: Critical Analysis of the Ethical Consequences of AI Adoption in Human Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has brought about digital workstyles and upended modern workplaces like never before. The promise and actual application of AI in human resource (HR) management differ significantly. HR directors are becoming quite interested in implementing AI in HRM as a result of these technological developments. The use of AI in HRM and the resulting human-machine collaboration is a topic that both researchers and practitioners are eager to explore. The HR department and employees can benefit from AI application in HRM in a number of ways. But these advantages also carry some hazards related to network security and the law. Associations must create information-driven security to filter information itself rather than merely organisation in order to lower the risks associated with network security. This study has discussed the application of AI concepts in numerous possible HRM sectors. The result showed how these elements impact HRM's ability to be flexible. An iterative process of function is made possible by the closed-loop technological effect of HR, also referred to as the digitalization of HR and ONA. An excellent organisational design is necessary to facilitate the implementation and advancement of the components. This study established a new path by connecting two elements that are common in the current Industry 4.0 eras.

articleTitle: Comparative Impact of Wind and Photovoltaic Energy Integration on Isolated Microgrid Self-Sufficiency and Load Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The micro grid structure creates a new distribution network that includes multiple power sources in place of the conventional distribution infrastructure with a radial network and one power source. An autonomous or grid-connected micro grid may be identified based on the degree of connection it has with the main grid. Since there is no link to the main grid in an isolated micro grid, the micro grid must be self-sufficient. This kind of micro grid functions as a miniature power system, complete with generating, transmission, and distribution components. The accessibility of local energy supplies is the primary factor driving isolated micro grids. In order to improve the isolated operating of the micro grid, this research presents a comparative analysis of introducing wind or photovoltaic (PV) energy sources to the micro grid. The research compares adding the same amount of wind or photovoltaic energy to the self-sufficient microgrid. The two primary parameters that are compared are the quantity of energy that is not given to the load and the duration of time that certain loads are shredded. We'll examine in-depth a standard case analysis of the micro grid system in Jaipur, India. We will offer a simulation model that computes the electrical power production for both PV and wind energy systems based on real data collected at the site about variations in environmental conditions. MATLAB was used to develop the model so that it could be used anywhere in the globe. The evolution of the current electrical networks towards an environmentally friendly distribution network system will lead to the incorporation of the micro grid system with renewable energy resources. The final findings are shown, demonstrating how solar or wind energy affects the micro grid's isolated functioning.

articleTitle: Fraud Identification in Financial Transactions: Machine Learning-Based Anomaly Detection Method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Two major financial crimes that have reached epidemic proportions worldwide are credit card holder fraud and financial statement fraud. The efficacy of corporate governance, the calibre of financial reports, and the legitimacy of audit functions have all suffered from the collapse of well-known corporations. Credit card theft and financial statement fraud have grown to be serious problems for organizations worldwide. The predicted accuracy scores of Support Vector Classifiers (SVM) and Logistic Regression were found to be greater than those of the other classifiers employed in the unbalanced training dataset. An experimental model that first applies the class balancing technique to transform the unbalanced dataset into a balanced data set was developed in alignment with the research purpose and to design a model to improve results and reduce False Negative Rate. Using a nonlinear support vector machine model, a classifier was trained on the dataset. The AUC score of the suggested model was higher. By creating a new, selected hybrid class balancing technique and using the Random Forester algorithm to create an optimum classifier and analyse the outcomes, the experimental model of class balancing was further refined. Based on the results of this experiment, it was found that the suggested approach outperforms the prior model, generates a good AUC score, and maximizes false negatives. The approach can be used to address other comparable categorization issues for better results. It is not just restricted to online financial transactions; it also aids in lowering false negatives in credit card fraud transactions.

articleTitle: Predictive Maintenance in Smart Grids with Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTM)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This research explores the application of Long Short-Term Memory Systems (LSTMs) and conventional machine learning calculations for prescient support in shrewd grids. Leveraging a differing dataset, the study compares the execution of these models, uncovering that the LSTM demonstration outperforms conventional partners such as Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, as well as K-Nearest Neighbors. The LSTM's capacity to capture intricate worldly conditions in successive information contributes to its predominant precision, precision, recall, and F1 score in anticipating hardware disappointments and support needs. Comparative examinations highlight the transformative potential of LSTM systems in improving the unwavering quality and proficiency of prescient support in energetic keen framework situations. The study adjusts with current patterns in related writing, emphasizing the developing noticeable quality of profound learning procedures in tending to complex assignments inside the vitality segment. As savvy grids advance, joining progressed data-driven approaches gets to be basic, and this investigation underscores the urgent part of LSTMs in handling the challenges related to prescient maintenance. The discoveries not as it were contribute to the body of information within the field but also offer practical suggestions for the improvement of clever and flexible smart network frameworks.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Dynamic Electric Vehicle Charging: Innovations in Inductive Power Transfer System Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Inductive charging, which is based on transformer theory, transfers energy via an air gap from an electric vehicle's (EV) secondary wiring to the main circuit of the charging station. Since dynamic inductive charging allows an electric vehicle (EV) to wirelessly gather energy while in motion, it seems to be the ideal solution for increasing the limited travel range of EVs. However, the current state of research for dynamic Inductive Power Transfer (IPT) solutions limits the use of this technology when the EV passes over the charging station fast. The aim of this study is to provide a novel optimization technique for the purpose of determining the values for the variables involved in the electrical operation of a dynamic IPT system. The optimization approach takes into consideration limits connected to the operating conditions in the main and secondary side of the IPT system to define the movement section, where the energy delivered to the EV is maximized at a notably high system efficiency. The parameters acquired during the optimization process are used to regulate the secondary side of the IPT system. Furthermore, a control scheme is proposed that effectively eliminates the need for a detection mechanism and continuous data transfer between the primary and secondary sides. To adhere to the suggested management approach, the charging station must run at a low efficiency movement segment without suffering noticeable energy losses in this specific area. The suggested control approach is validated by modelling the dynamic IPT system operation throughout the whole range of EV movement. A circular pad with a diameter of 60 cm serves as an example of how the recommended optimization strategy is put into practice. An experimental setup has been used to study the optimization process and assess how well the system functions.

articleTitle: Towards Autonomy in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle: Taxonomy and Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: From last few years there has been seen tremendous changes in the usage of UAV in various areas including defence, packet delivery, search and rescue operation etc. Autonomy in UAV means the ability to fly safely from source to destination without little or no human intervention. For making the UAV fully automated navigation plays important role. Navigation of autonomous UAV is one of the basics yet unresolved problem in the field of autonomy and control system. In this article, classification of AUAVs (Autonomous Unmanned Aerial Vehicles) is presented using a novel taxonomy. Different communication protocols deployed at various layers during communication of AUAV are explained briefly. Later, a variety of applications are described by using the novel taxonomy. This article will help the new researchers to understand the fundamentals related to AUAV.

articleTitle: Novel Architecture and Comparative Study for Deep Learning-Based Segmentation of 3D Brain MRI Images Using SegNet, V-Net, and U-Net
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Brain tumor detection is an essential undertaking in the fields of neuroimaging and medical image analysis. It detects the abnormal growth of tissues within MRI scans. In the past, manual detection was performed, which was less effective and time-consuming. Then the transition shifted to 2D images, which enhanced the accuracy and efficiency of brain tumor detection compared to manual methods. The integration of artificial intelligence with brain tumor detection processes has completely transformed the field. Modern hardware, like GPUs and deep learning algorithms, particularly CNN, have enabled the use of large datasets for training, reducing processing time and improving scalability. This paper includes 3D brain MRI images of tumor segmentation using different CNN architectures: Seg-Net, V-Net, and U-Net. Implemented a novel architecture of U-Net with the latest methodologies in which a symmetrical encoder-decoder design is formed with Leaky ReLU activation, dropout layers, and batch normalization layers for regularization and GELU activation to preserve spatial information. Medical Segmentation Decathlon datasets are used to train and test models in experimentation. The research evaluates these models based on complexity, training time, and segmentation accuracy. U-Net emerges as the top performer with a Dice Similarity Coefficient of 88.5%, surpassing V-Net (86.4%) and SegNet (84.8%).

articleTitle: Addressing the Rising Challenge of Malware Innovative Detection and Mitigation Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This research talks about Hybrid Anomaly Detection (HAD), a complex technology for finding and stopping malware. There are four different methods to apply the approach. The following are a few examples: EDR, DBA, TIS, and EML. The goal of the ablation specialists is to enhance the HAD structure in whatever way possible. With a success rate of 99.5% and only one false positive, DBA starts monitoring the process the second it starts. EML makes the system more flexible and useful by finding malware using probability estimates and weighted voting. TIS protects against new threats and motivates people to work together by sharing and prioritizing threat information. EDR is all about computer security by evaluating and reducing risks. The ablation study focuses on how well each algorithm can identify things, how flexible it is, how well it can work with others, and how safe it keeps endpoints safe. Since these algorithms work well together, the HAD framework offers a complete answer that performs better than other approaches in many ways. This study suggests a good way for everyone to work together to fight modern computer risks, which will improve cybersecurity.

articleTitle: Brain Tumour Detection Using MRI Images and CNN Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The brain tumour is a phenomenon involving the creation of cells which multiply within the brain and they are different from the normal cells. Among all platforms, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) has the highest level of accuracy in finding these brain cancer cells. Magnetic resonance imaging or MRI has made it possible to visualise tissues closely and then the diagnosis can be made. The result of an MRI scan will help in detecting the presence of a brain tumour or determining that there isn't a tumour. In the past few year's algorithms like deep learning and machine learning driven by AI have improved computer-aided image analysis tools which can now achieve the sensitivity of top radiologists. By modernising the diagnostic systems, the speed of tumour detection and error rate can be boosted which both play an essential role in a successful cancer treatment. This, in turn, lowers the possibility of healthcare providers misdiagnosing the patient and supports them in the right purposeful treatment. Here we have a research application where a convolutional neural network (CNN) discriminates brain tumour images compared to others and its implementation is carefully presented. The primary objective of this research is to employ Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) as a machine learning technique to facilitate the detection and classification of brain tumours. However, the performance of the untrained and pre- trained CNN manifests through a precision of 95% and classification accuracy rate for training and testing respectively. Hence, such data provide the strongest evidence that in the situation of brain tumour prognosis, CNN is the most important instrument.

articleTitle: An Improved Blockchain Based Security Framework for IoT Enabled Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The net of factors (Iota) has opened new opportunities for connecting a diverse range of devices and making them handy over the net. However, it has additionally accelerated the vulnerability of these gadgets to cyberassaults. One capability technique to cope with It trouble is implementing Block chain generation, which offers allotted and relaxed facts storage and transaction validation. It paper advocates a progressed Block chain-based safety framework for Iota-enabled wireless networks. Our framework uses clever contracts, which might be self-executing virtual contracts that implement the agreed-upon policies and conditions among parties. Those clever contracts ease communication among Iota gadgets and the Wi-Fi community, ensuring that the most effective legal and demonstrated devices can access the network. Our framework incorporates a consensus mechanism for validating transactions on the Block chain, ensuring the integrity and immutability of statistics. Our proposed framework contains a dynamic key control gadget, which often updates and rotates keys to prevent unauthorized admission to the community. It selection also permits relaxed communication among devices, even in the case of a compromised key. In conclusion, our improved Block chainbased total protection framework presents a strong answer for securing Iota-enabled Wi-Fi networks.

articleTitle: A Channel and Spatial Attention-Based ResNet Module for EEG-Based Schizophrenia Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: As a severe mental illness that acutely impairs patients’ cognitive flexibility, verbal communication and motor coordination among other facets of their life, schizophrenia must be identified as early as possible. Schizophrenia is very complex in nature as its symptoms fairly coincide with that of other illnesses, thus making sophisticated diagnostic equipment a requirement to have a better understanding and possibly better treatment results. As a substitute for this, the EEG technology has become very significant, offering an economical and noninvasive way of determining the neuropsychological origins of SZ. This study seeks to improve the classification accuracy of individuals with schizophrenia by identifying a better feature set to describe electroencephalography (EEG) signals. We offer an Attention based Resnet101 model based on Recurrence Plots (RP) to classify EEG signals of schizophrenic (SZ) patients from that of Healthy Control (HC) patients. A nonlinear technique for examining the periodicity, chaos, and non-stationarity of time series is the recurrence plot. It works well for processing short time series data. The proposed method is trained on two EEG datasets, one from the Institute of Psychiatry and Neurology in Warsaw, Poland and the other from https://www.kaggle.com/broach/button-tone-sz. The model achieved an accuracy of 99.37% and 95% respectively on both datasets. Further, the proposed work is compared with seven SOTA techniques and achieved a better performance, proving its effectiveness in medical applications.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey of Abstractive Text Summarization Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Abstractive text summarization [16] leverages advanced machine learning and deep neural networks to generate entirely new text that encapsulates the essence of the input text. It differs from extractive summarization [20], which mechanically concatenates text segments. Abstractive summarization is needed to address information overload and enhance content creation. However, it faces challenges such as maintaining consistency, capturing subtle nuances, and striking a balance between conciseness and comprehensiveness. Various approaches to abstractive summarization are presented, including the seq2seq model [17], attention mechanism [18], pointer-generator network [10], and copy mechanism. These approaches have different strengths and weaknesses depending on the application. Abstractive summarization finds practical applications in news summarization, research paper summarization, legal document summarization, customer support, and e-commerce product descriptions.

articleTitle: An Empirical Comparison of Machine Learning Techniques for Bank Loan Approval Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Using predictive analytics and machine learning, autonomous eligibility for loans prediction is a game-changing technology that is revolutionizing the lending industry. These technologies expedite loan processing, cutting waiting times and enhancing customer satisfaction by rapidly evaluating application data. Cutting-edge algorithms provide impartial and precise credit assessments, reducing the possibility of human prejudices. Lenders can evaluate a larger pool of applicants thanks to automated technologies, which further advance financial inclusion. In addition to providing enhanced fraud detection, cost savings, and customized loan options, this technology is crucial for contemporary lending organizations looking to streamline operations and meet a wide range of client demands. Over the past 10 years (2014-2024), algorithms based on machine learning have drawn a lot of attention for their ability to automate and improve loan approval procedures. This study compares and contrasts many machine learning approaches used in loan approval, looking at their advantages, disadvantages, and performance indicators. To forecast and categorize the target variable, the study uses three well-liked models: Random Forest, K Nearest neighbour, Decision Tree, and Logistic Regression. Finding the model that is most suited for the task is the primary goal. The study concludes that, after a thorough investigation, In this case, the Random Forest Classifier and Logistic Regression model perform somewhat better than the other models.

articleTitle: Behavioral Biometrics Authentication Systems: Leveraging Machine Learning for Enhanced Cybersecurity
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This study focuses on behavioral biometrics and machine learning procedure that is employed vigorous in the verification frameworks to improve cybersecurity. Elaborating interesting designs in client behaviour, such as keystroke flow and mouse developments along with advanced machine learning algorithms we propose to generate verification components capable of accurately identifying a person's identity while adapting themselves all the fast live changes associated either. The experiments carried out on real-life datasets demonstrate LSTM models pervasive implementation in contrast to traditional machine learning algorithms (SVM, KNN and Random Forest). Thus, LSTM achieved an accuracy of 95.6%, outperforming SVM (88.7%), KNN (84.5%) and Random Forest (923). Additionally, LSTM proved great flexibility and competitive performance despite longer training times. The abovementioned results have demonstrated that LSTM is effective in learning the complicated real world conditions in sequential data and could be used for improvement of behavioral biometric recognition systems.

articleTitle: Examination of Phishing Attempts on Web-Based Business Applications and Their Preventions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Because of developments in the online sector, the occurrence of data breaches in web-based business systems is rising quickly. The attackers employ a range of different methods, including Distributed-Denial-of-Service attacks, Hacking Current Sessions, Reusing of Usernames and Passwords, Injections of Structured Query Language, and Phishing Attacks. Phishing attacks are widely used in the modern age. Phishing attacks are frauds attempt for tricking users into giving up sensitive information. Based on the intruder's intended target, such digital threats can damage specific people or whole industries. Researchers in this field offer a variety of phishing identification methods to stop such threats. Throughout this review paper, we categorize modern phishing identification methods into five main groups, which includes framework based on deep learning algorithms and artificial intelligence methodology based on search engines, methodology based on scanned URLs, methodology based on Whitelisting-Blacklisting Using Pictorial Resemblance as a Basis. Additionally, a statistical assessment of every individual category, giving its advantages and disadvantages. Additionally, this article offers users advice on how to prevent cyber-attacks.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Customer Segmentation and Personalised Marketing in Financial Services
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Customer segmentation is a way of dividing a clientele into groups, or “the consumer segments,” with the intention of assembling customers with similar characteristics in each section. Gender, age, interests, and different spending patterns are just a few of the marketing-relevant characteristics that serve as the foundation for segmentation. Segmentation solutions enable banks to provide more individualized products and services. Marketers can select the best channels of advertising for their intended consumer base, establish profitable new market niches, launch novel products and services, and decide what promotional content to offer by getting a deeper grasp of the characteristics of their target audience. Machine learning can help people make more informed choices in the future is used in this situation. Different algorithms are used to uncover concealed trends in the data. Applying segmentation makes it clear which of the eluded segments to target. Machine learning can help people make more informed choices in the future is used in this situation. Different algorithms are used to uncover undetected trends in the data. Applying segmentation makes it clear which of the eluded segments to target.
