This study segmented the data regarding cardholders of different banks using silhouette approaches, elbow approaches, and K-means cluster analysis.

articleTitle: Statistical Models for Bacterial Propagation in Human Respiratory Tract
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Diffusive Molecular Communication (DMC) enabled bacterial propagation within biological systems is employed in different medical applications. In the other words, DMC is being used to study the propagation of bacteria inside the human body. However, DMC and thus the bacterial propagation model depend on the type of deployment used. Various deployment geometries including Rectangular, Spherical and Cylindrical. In this research, a DMC system within a cylindrical biological deployment is developed for the human respiratory tract. It is expected that the information molecules diffusing across the fluid medium would degrade and be influenced by flow. Further, the Cylindrical Biological Deployments (CBDs) offer versatility in representing different tissues or organs. Therefore, in this research paper different statistical models are derived and analyzed under CBD deployment using bacterial concentration f(y) In particular, statistical models for bacterial propagation in terms of probability (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${{\mathrm{P}}_{\mathrm{b}}}$</tex>), non-binding probability (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${{\mathrm{P}}_{\text{nb}}}$</tex>), evade probability (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${{\mathrm{P}}_{\mathrm{e}}}(\mathrm{y})$</tex>), and the probability of binding rate (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${{\mathrm{P}}_{\mathrm{b}}}$</tex>(y)) are presented. Also, presented models are analyzed numerically using simulation. The numerical simulation demonstrates excellent agreement with the theoretical foundation. The result has been simulated in MATLAB-20.

articleTitle: Empowering Twitter Sentiment Analysis With BERT: Exploring the Role of Pre-Training Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Social networks are widely used, and as a result, a tonne of user-generated data is readily accessible to the general public. This data can be analyzed to understand more about people's perspectives. In this study, we analyzed the use of BERT, a bidirectional encoder representation from transformers, for the sentiment analysis of a million tweets from different Twitter users. We constructed a classifier and used the real-world dataset of tweets to assess the effectiveness of the model that was created for the purpose of sentiment analysis of tweets. The studies conducted have shown that the modified model was able to acquire an accuracy rating of 0.97 for sentiment analysis.

articleTitle: Facial Recognition Unlocking Potential Facing Challenges in Face and Gender Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The integration of face and gender recognition technologies into the digital landscape stems from an urgent demand for heightened security, operational efficiency, and personalized user interactions. In response to the accelerating pace of digitization, these technologies have become imperative, offering solutions that transcend traditional identification methods. The motivation behind their adoption lies in addressing the limitations of conventional authentication processes, which are often susceptible to forgery and human error. Leveraging sophisticated algorithms and machine learning models, these technologies provide swift and precise identification, reshaping the dynamics of user interactions in a digital society. Deep learning, mainly through implementing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), explains the challenges associated with facial complexity, lighting variations, and dynamic expressions. As face and gender recognition technologies using advance Deep Learning models, have the potential to fortify security measures and redefine digital interactions, presenting efficient, secure, and personalized experiences across a spectrum of applications in our increasingly interconnected and digitalized world. The limitations of traditional verification methods which are prone to errors and fraud, our research give insight survey of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to improve the accuracy and efficiency of facial gender recognition technology. Paper explains deep learning models to ensure adaptability and sustainability in digital environments to overcome the challenges to detect age and gender using face recognition. The paper also explores facial recognition technologies and integrating artificial intelligence to address security challenges and enhance user experience in digital communications in future.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning for Control System Optimization in Electrical Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This research investigates the use of reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms for optimal control systems in electrical engineering. The article discusses four popular RL algorithms – Q-learning, Deep Q Network (DQN), as well as Policy Gradient Methods (PGM) and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) density. A simulation in an electric control system was performed to assess these strategies. The proposed research was designed and made with the intention of improving adaptivity, delays in responding to time actions on adopting circumstances such as UAV placement navigation paradigm, wave energy conversions, there is an aspect of HVAC systems around water circulation networks control. The results demonstrated the robustness of DQN and PPO, with system efficiency values of 0.92 and 0.91, response times of 0.08s and 0.09s, respectively, and in that case they were specific circumstances showcasing stable behavior system compared to training on an experience replay memory basis Comparative analysis with relative work highlighted the competitive performance of RL algorithms as compared to other methods, which further validated their practical application. Sensitivity analysis demonstrated the DQN and PPO adaptation to a change in influential factors, proving that they are capable of functioning under changing conditions. The computational efficiency analysis showed that DQN and PPO had faster convergence speeds compared to Q-learning and Policy Gradient Methods. According to this research, RL offers vital bits of knowledge into the transformative potential that these algorithms can bring to electrical engineering and in this way make them successful instruments for versatile networks.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Stochastic Optimization Models for Hybrid AC/DC Microgrid Energy Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This study aims to create advanced stochastic optimization models for the strategic energy management of hybrid AC/DC microgrids. The primary focus is on optimizing energy costs, environmental sustainability, and system reliability, considering the uncertain behaviour of renewable energy sources and load demands. The research focuses on the modelling and analysis of these models using MATLAB. By incorporating sophisticated forecasting of renewable energy production and demand projections into a strong optimization framework, the models effectively manage the inherent uncertainties in the energy system. The multi-objective method provides a means to optimize the operations of hybrid AC/DC microgrids by considering and balancing important factors like cost, sustainability, and dependability. The efficacy of the suggested models is verified showcasing significant improvements in operational efficiency, cost reduction, and environmental sustainability. This study offers significant insights for the development and functioning of upcoming energy systems, providing a strong foundation for academics, engineers, and politicians involved in microgrid energy management.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Early Detection of Breast Cancer: Improving Accuracy and Efficiency in Diagnosis for Enhanced Patient Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: In Todays era breast cancer is a main reason of deaths among women across the world. If detected at early stage it increases the survival rates of the patients. In the last few years, deep learning techniques have been used in medical imaging in the early detection of disease. This research focuses on the development of a deep learning-based mechanism for the early detection of breast cancer by ultrasound scan images. The proposed technique in this paper presents the usage of CNNs to extract relevant features from ultrasound images. A large dataset of annotated ultrasound scans is used for training the deep learning model. To measure the effect of the developed system, extensive experiments and validations are conducted using independent test datasets. In our work, CNN models have been trained to identify the three cases of breast tissues such as normal, benign, and malignant, and were optimized using Recursive Feature Elimination Optimizer and divide it into 80% for the training set and 20% for the testing set. VGG-19, ResNet-101 and ResNeXt architectures optimized by Recursive Feature Elimination optimizer are used for training and validation of the breast cancer dataset and get the accuracy of 98.5% for the optimized VGG-19 model.

articleTitle: My Assistant SRSTC: Speech Recognition and Speech to Text Conversion
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: ‘My Assistant,’ a speech-enabled virtual assistant created to promote smooth human-machine interaction, is presented in this research study. By utilizing cutting-edge speech recognition and natural language processing technologies, My Assistant can translate spoken words into text, carry out user commands, and provide contextually appropriate answers. The study highlights the significance of interacting with other systems and APIs while discussing the fundamental methods of voice recognition, task execution, and answer generation [1]. Metrics for assessing speech recognition precision and user contentment are suggested, accompanied with comparisons with current personal assistants. The results show how effective and promising My Assistant is for raising user convenience and productivity [2].

articleTitle: A Computer Vision Based Framework for Posture Analysis and Performance Prediction in Athletes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: In the previous several decades, there have been tremendous improvements in the analysis of human movement in the field of sports biomechanics and rehabilitation. Driven by the demand for faster and more complex ways to capture movement across a variety of situations, ranging from clinical gait analysis to video game animation, motion analysis techniques have undergone significant development. This research explores the previous work done on the sports performance analytics systems based on computer vision and how they affect the development of athletic performance but the prior work lacks in accuracy and versatility. Therefore, in this research, a framework has been proposed which uses 3D pose estimation technique and parameters like distance offset and inclination between neck and torso to analyse athletes' postures and motions during any sporting activity in order to predict the correctness of an athlete's posture. In this work, an analysis has been carried out with the help of machine learning models on the sports videos having a frame rate of 25 fps. To improve the robustness of the model, variations in blur, illumination, and clarity are incorporated into the dataset. This dataset has been trained on various machine learning models like Random Forest, MLP, and SVM, and procured the accuracy rates of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$85.03{{\% }},71.42{{\% }}$</tex>, and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$63.26{{\% }}$</tex>, and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$F1$</tex>-scores of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$84.99{{\% }}$</tex>, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$71.57{{\% }}$</tex>, and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$61.80{{\% }}$</tex>, respectively. Our results show how well these technologies work to provide coaches and athletes with performance information and real-time feedback.

articleTitle: Adopting Big Data Analytics in Innovative B2B Marketing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: In B2B connections, the article investigates the application of big data to innovation and market leadership. With the use of current case studies, it offers a framework for analysing the effects of big data. This study offers a framework for analysing the effects of big data in B2B marketing specially for Customer relationship management. The literature study that is now accessible shows how important customer satisfaction is to the global retail sector and how important it is to continuously monitor consumer feedback. Many research has been done on the many strategies for leveraging technology to enhance customer relationship management. Since the idea of combining Big Data and other analytical tools for CRM is still relatively new, not much research has been done on how Big Data Analytics might help modern Indian retail enterprises. The retail industry adds value to its products and services for customers, hence transforming businesses through its global business activities. Through a combination of disposal, significance, availability, and positive experience, it's a method of continuously offering high-quality lifelines. newline, newline Merchandising's purpose is to facilitate the uptake of goods and services. The product is made available in-store for organized retail newline. Retail establishments classified as unorganized include traditional Kirana stores, newline corner shops, and general stores, whereas organized retail includes department stores, supermarkets, and newline hypermarkets. Historically, single newline employees have managed retail businesses in a variety of areas. especially the Big Data Analytics SMAC framework, which combines social media, Mobility, Analytics, and Cloud newline. The impact of computing as a seamless component on retail business CRM techniques. In their innovation endeavours, B2B companies that function in markets during which their own offerings significantly influence how their B2B clients' products and services offer value to end users (B2C) ought to actively participate in the end-user B2C market alongside their B2B clients. This affects every aspect of life, including strategy and human resources.

articleTitle: Human Resource Management Assisted by Fuzzy Logic System to Solve Problems in Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The study proposes a fuzzy logic system and its utilization to enhance the supply chain management using human resource management by addressing the challenges. Conventional approaches in supply chain management are important with some complexities that are difficult for efficient navigation. Fuzzy logic system is incorporated from the ability to handle uncertain and imprecise data of human resource management within the management of supply chain which is considered to be the powerful tool in problem solving and decision-making process. The study focusses on the integration of fuzzy logic for effective management of human resources in the scenario of supply chain to enhance adaptability improvement in decision making process and contribution for optimizing the supply chain operations. Fuzzy logic is applied on HRM practices for addressing unpredictable and dynamic nature of supply chain in the present competitive business environment. The findings shows that fuzzy logic helps in solving the problem by integration of HRM in SCM.

articleTitle: Performance Assessment of Various Deep Learning Based Models for Multiclass Classification of Tomato Leaf Diseases
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Tomatoes are widely grown food crop that faces several challenges during production, including diseases that affect leaves. These diseases are influenced by various factors such as climate, soil, pests, and pathogens, and they can drastically lower the amount and quality of tomatoes produced. A research study has been conducted to combat these diseases using advanced methods for identifying and classifying tomato leaf diseases, such as deep learning and image processing. The primary objective of this approach is to increase crop yields and reduce losses, thereby contributing to food security. To assess deep learning models effectiveness in disease detection tasks, this study employed five models MobileNet, Res-Net50V2, Xception, InceptionV3 and VGG19 that were trained using 83,568 images of tomato leaves. The models vali-dation accuracy is analyzed, and the results show varying lev-els of validation accuracy. The highest accuracy was achieved by MobileNet of 91%, followed by ResNet50V2, Xception, InceptionV3, and VGG19. These results offer insightful contributions about the ongoing discourse on deep learning. The main body of the paper presents further details and discusses the study.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Classification Using Customized Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Cancer involves the unreviewed proliferation of each bodily cell, capable of quickly spreading to any part of the body. Breast cancer remains a concern, in health and it requires for the development of effective methods to detect it early. This study used TensorFlow 2.15 along with a CNN to improve the accurate identification of breast cancer detection. By analyzing dataset which is Breast Cancer Wisconsin dataset, proposed CNN model, which incorporates Conv1D layers, batch normalization and dropout techniques achieved an accuracy rate of 96% in classifying tumors as either malignant or benign. In the research analysis section, proposed work analyzes the epochs for this model with visualizations which is accuracy and loss graph for training and validation, it shows training accuracy is rising at end of the 50 epoch with 98.02% accuracy and validation accuracy is also rising after 10 epochs with 91.23% to 50 epoch with 97.37% accuracy, it shows the high accuracy of this proposed model. In the Loss Graph training loss is decreasing from 10 epochs with 0.0981 MSE to 50 epoch with 0.0522 MSE and validation loss is decreased at 50 epoch with 0.1497 MSE. This research the possibility to acquire knowledge in medical image analysis and its ability to enhance diagnosis accuracy for breast cancer cases. The outcome emphasize the efficiency of the proposed strategy and pave the way for advancements, in utilizing CNNs for critical healthcare applications.

articleTitle: AI-Based Agriculture Application for Crop Recommendation and Guidance System for Farmers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Agriculture plays a crucial role in safeguarding food security and economic stability, especially in countries where a significant population relies on farming. However, traditional farming practices are often marred by challenges such as suboptimal crop selection, inefficient fertilizer management, disease outbreaks, and market price uncertainties. This paper compares different algorithms like Gaussian Naive Bayes, SVM, Decision tree regression, XGBoost, random forest, logistic regression, etc., and based on the result generated the best algorithm will be used. The proposed smart agriculture system includes applications for crop recommendation, fertilizer guidance, plant disease prediction, and crop price forecasting and will incorporate these applications into a single website which later can also be developed and connected through the servers. This research provides the farmers with new and advanced information regarding their soil and field data. Through binding the power of data-driven decision-making, this project aims to enhance agricultural productivity, encourage sustainability, and empower farming communities. Continuous improvement, user feedback, and interdisciplinary collaboration are integral to the project's success.

articleTitle: Employee Attrition Analysis Using XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: In today's time, employee attrition is a major problem faced by organisations. The most precious resource for a firm is its workforce. They are the ones that bring values both quantitatively and qualitatively. A steady decline in the workforce due to resignation, death or retirement is referred to as attrition. It is a matter of concern when employees leave their jobs of better opportunities, but this leads the company to face its consequences. Employee turnover and attrition are equivalent. Leaders can avoid it by implementing better retention techniques by mastering this concept. In this paper, we use dataset to analyse attrition and determine the root cause of employee resignation. We did analysis of the training dataset for effective data exploration. Machine Learning algorithms, such as Random Forest Classifier, Logistic Regression, XGBoost and ensemble stacking technique were used. On data exploration and enabling algorithm we discovered that XGBoost classifier with an accuracy of 88. % and precision 89% was the most appropriate algorithm for this dataset. We may also conclude that monthly income, age, distance from home can be a reason behind employees leaving their job and finding better opportunities.

articleTitle: Progress in Automated Cancer Detection with Recursive Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Detecting cancer is a crucial step in the prognosis and treatment of most cancers and consequently, there has been significant progress in the development of automatic strategies for detecting cancer. One approach that has shown promising results in this area is the usage of Recursive Neural Networks (RNNs). RNNs are a sort of artificial neural network that has the capacity to method sequential statistics, making them appropriate for reading clinical pictures, which include those used in cancer detection. Using RNNs in cancer detection has advanced extensively in recent years, with several researches demonstrating their potential to appropriately detect most cancers with various sorts of clinical images. One observer applied RNNs to research breast tissue images and completed an accuracy of 98.6%, outperforming conventional gadget learning algorithms. Some other examiner used RNNs to research colonoscopy pictures and detected most cancers with an accuracy of 96.6%, surpassing the performance of each human and traditional gadget mastering tactics. One of the key benefits of the use of RNNs in cancer detection is their capability to analyze from statistics and make selections based on patterns and relationships in the records, without the need for characteristic engineering or manual annotation. This makes them nicely-applicable for analyzing complicated scientific photographs wherein traditional methods may lag. In most cancers detection, short and accurate diagnosis is critical for timely treatment and enhancing effects. Therefore, the performance of RNN-based models is a vital aspect in their overall performance analysis.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Driven Approaches for Early Detection of Lung Cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Detecting lung cancer sooner is very much essential for improving the survival rates and reducing the mortality rate as well. This study offers an extensive approach for detecting stages of lung cancer as early as possible from CT scan images using Deep learning. Data set used in this research consists of CT scans of healthy individuals as well as of those diagnosed with various stages of lung cancer. Elastic transformation is used as preprocessing to address class imbalance. Data augmentation is applied to improve model generalization after splitting the data into training, testing and validation. Three pre-trained convolutional neural network architecture (DenseNet201, VGG16, EfficientNetB7) are employed, with transfer learning utilized to fine-tune the models for lung cancer multi-class classification. In the end, weighted CNN ensemble is implemented to combine the predictions of individual models. Popular deep learning metrics such as accuracy, recall, f1-score and precision is used to access the models performance. Final result showcases effectiveness of proposed deep learning model, with the weighted ensemble method achieving an accuracy of 98.19% on the test data. Future work includes exploring different hyper parameter tuning, incorporating additional CNN architectures, and further preprocessing techniques to enhance model accuracy.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Exploration of Cognitive Tourism: AI and Psychological Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to provide a cognitive tourism investigation that will examine the implications of artificial intelligence and psychological viewpoints on tourists' experiences. To address the research gaps identified in the literature review, it is necessary to employ a systematic approach in order to comprehensively study and improve tourist cognition. The suggested approach employs AI concepts to enhance the emotional and psychological components of tourism. This paradigm explores the practical use of artificial intelligence in the tourism industry and its impact on cognitive processes, emotions, and motivation. The framework combines visitor behavior and satisfaction to offer a comprehensive overview. Artificial intelligence has the ability to improve both the practical and emotional aspects of a tourist's experience. Notwithstanding the optimistic perspective, the essay examines the difficulties associated with implementing the framework and proposes avenues for future investigation. This study enhances the existing body of knowledge on intelligent tourism by shedding light on the field of travel psychology.

articleTitle: Advancing Healthcare IoT: Blockchain and Federated Learning Integration for Enhanced Security and Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Fast-growing IoT devices in healthcare have ushered in a new era of data-driven patient care and treatment. These gadgets capture too much sensitive medical data, a major issue. We need to boost data analysis, security, and privacy. This research uses cutting-edge concepts like federated learning and blockchain technology to improve Healthcare IoT analytics and security. This study examines blockchain and federated learning's numerous integration aspects. It begins with data security, employing blockchain's immutability and decentralization to prevent manipulation. Federation learning was utilized to solve privacy concerns while adhering to tight healthcare data security regulations, providing strong data analysis without releasing raw, patient-specific information. This study examines how federated learning and blockchain technologies enhance healthcare IoT systems' analytics. This connection allows safe, collaborative analysis among healthcare professionals and devices, offering more insights for research, diagnostics, and tailored patient care. How to integrate these cutting-edge technologies into healthcare IoT networks is also explored.

articleTitle: Advancing Intrusion Detection Systems Innovative Approaches for Prevention and Response
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: A group intruder detection system built on K-Nearest Neighbors, Decision Trees, Neural Networks, Support Vector Machines, and Random Forests is shown in this study. A thorough study on ablation shows how the algorithms work together to make breach detection better. We compare how well the suggested method works in terms of memory, F1 score, false negative rate, accuracy, and detection time. Bar charts, line graphs, pie charts, stacked bar graphs, area plots, and scatter plots all show that the new way is better than the old ones. Tables are also used to organize data. An ensemble takes the best features of Random Forests, Support Vector Machines, Neural Networks, Decision Trees, and K-Nearest Neighbors and puts them all together in a single package. Broad powers make the suggested method better at solving cybersecurity problems across a range of review factors. The ablation study shows why each method is important and how they work together to make an adaptive intruder detection system. In a world where safety is always changing, the proposed answer is scalable, flexible, easy to set up, and cheap.

articleTitle: Classification of Psychiatric Disorders Using QEEG Data Through Convolution Neural Networks and Gated Recurrent Units
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Psychiatric disorders present a significant challenge for diagnosis and treatment. Utilizing electroencephalogram (EEG) data, deep learning (DL) classifiers offer a promising avenue for discerning between healthy individuals and those with psychiatric disorders. While previous studies have explored DL applications in EEG analysis, few have focused on comprehensive classification across a range of psychiatric disorders using quantitative EEG (QEEG) data. This research aims to engineer a DL classifier capable of accurately distinguishing EEG signatures of individuals with major psychiatric disorders from healthy controls, utilizing resting-state QEEG data. A dataset comprising 850 patients with various psychiatric disorders and 95 healthy controls was analysed. QEEG parameters, including power spectrum density (PSD) and functional connectivity (FC) at different frequency bands, were used to establish classification models. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) were employed, and validation accuracies were compared. The study identified optimal feature combinations and achieved high classification accuracies: anxiety disorder (93% accuracy, high-beta FC), addictive disorder (93% accuracy, gamma FC), trauma and stress-related disorder (93% accuracy, gamma PSD), mood disorder (96% accuracy, delta FC), obsessive-compulsive disorder (90% accuracy, beta FC), and schizophrenia (93% accuracy, high-beta FC). These findings suggest the potential of DL in EEG analysis for predicting psychiatric disorders and providing an objective index for diagnosis. Such advancements may significantly contribute to improved clinical assessment and treatment strategies.

articleTitle: Applications of AI to Optimize Operations in the Management of Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Two key factors in manufacturing organisations are cost savings and productivity. Technology reduces workloads, boosts productivity, and lessens financial strain. High levels of automation and technology-driven processes define modern production. We examined the role of artificial intelligence in industries, the main challenges associated with implementing AI in manufacturing facilities, potential solutions to these challenges, and the various tasks that can be readily dealt with with AI implementation in manufacturing facilities in order to gain a better understanding of this stage of transformation in the manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Influence of Blockchain Technology Adoption on the Supply Chain Management of the Logistics Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Blockchain technology (BCT) has evolved as a revolutionary means for upgrade of supply chain management (SCM) operations in the logistic industry. This paper aims to evaluate BCT adoption impact on logistics industry supply chain management. The study evaluates on a general basis all the advantages and disadvantages that come with the implementation of BCT in the logistics industry by reviewing the existing literature. The results show that there is a positive connection between the utilization of digital technologies and the level of supply chain transparency and flexibility. For those businesses that integrate BCT into their supply chain, this could result in better openness and responsiveness which can in turn be translated into high performance and operational responsiveness. Also, the study proves the considerable impact of BCT on both SCP (supply chain performance) and integration. On the other hand, the more technology companies implement BCT, they face improvement of SCP and integration, leading to better overall industry performance and market position. The paper finishes with the call for universities, industry practitioners and policymakers to conduct research and use the opportunities offered by BCT in SCM including investing in educational programs, collaboration with tech providers and development of clear regulatory guidelines.

articleTitle: Skin Cancer Identification Using Deep Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The most common diseases in the world are skin problems because of hereditary features and environmental factors. It frequently suffers from both common and uncommon ailments. Skin cancer presents in various forms, including squamous cell carcinoma, basal cell carcinoma, and the highly aggressive melanoma, which accounts for the majority of fatalities associated with this condition. Dermatology poses unique diagnostic challenges due to its intricate nature, often necessitating thorough testing to accurately determine the specific type of skin disorder afflicting patients. It can be very challenging to distinguish between different skin illnesses and their different types. The person's personal knowledge of the subject also matters. It is essential to use a technique that is unrestricted by these limitations in order to detect skin diseases. Due to the complexity of human skin complexion and the visual proximity effect on the illnesses, it can be quite difficult to pinpoint the exact type of disease. Therefore, it's crucial to recognize and classify skin problems as soon as they are found. The identification of human skin diseases is thus the most complex and difficult area of research. This work presents an automated deep learning-based image-based system for recognizing and categorizing skin problems along with the implementation of new approach called federated learning for the same. In the biomedical sector, Ml & DL techniques are extensively used for segmentation and augmentation, feature extraction and classification diagnosis and detection. Advanced techniques like Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) can be employed to extract characteristics from a picture, classify the image using the EfficientNet algorithm with fairness evaluation was used to detect the two primary types of tumours, malignant and benign, using the HAM10000 dataset and using federated learning approach using different datasets, and generate a diagnostic report. Since this research will provide results more quickly and accurately than the previous procedure, it will be a more reliable and effective strategy than the conventional method for identifying dermatological problems. The necessity for a lot of manual diagnosis work might potentially be eliminated by a system that can analyze images and alert physicians to the presence of a certain type of skin cancer.

articleTitle: Privacy-Preserving Techniques for Data Sharing in the Era of IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The rapid expansion of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has revolutionized data generation and sharing but simultaneously introduced profound privacy concerns for both individuals and organizations. To mitigate these risks, this paper evaluates cutting-edge privacy-preserving techniques specifically designed for data exchange within the IoT framework. These techniques are categorized into cryptographic, anonymization, and differential privacy approaches, with each offering distinct advantages and limitations across diverse IoT scenarios. Cryptographic techniques, including homomorphic encryption, attribute-based encryption, secure multiparty computation, and zero-knowledge proofs, offer robust privacy protection by encrypting data during transmission and computation. However, they may incur considerable computational overhead and require sophisticated key management mechanisms. Anonymization techniques such as k-anonymity, l-diversity, t-closeness, and differential privacy-based anonymization aim to conceal sensitive information by aggregating or perturbing data. While effective in safeguarding privacy, these methods may struggle to balance privacy and data utility, leading to potential information loss or re-identification risks.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Object Recognition Utilizing Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Machine learning is an essential discipline in artificial intelligence & image processing because it affects item/object or asset recognition or identification processes. It employs datasets, evaluation measures, and both traditional and deep learning techniques. Applications demonstrate the impact of machine learning in a variety of sectors, including medical image processing and driver-less cars. There is a scarcity of rigorous assessments of all the latest technologies utilized in the fields of Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning. This study demonstrates the variety of object detection algorithms available in this field. This publication will be useful for scholars researching in this area because it provides comprehensive information regarding future directions.

articleTitle: Automated Knowledge Transfer for Medical Image Segmentation Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The usage of deep trends for scientific photograph segmentation has seen a speedy increase in recognition in recent years of today's capability to generate accurate photo segmentation fashions. However, the development and deployment of these fashions may be time-eating and highly-priced state-of-the-art to engineer features and architectures for each project manually. Automatic knowledge transfer (AKT) can address this difficulty by presenting a manner to switch knowledge throughout distinct duties while requiring minimal guide attempts. AKT can obtain better effects than guide engineering procedures by extracting the most pertinent knowledge from present fashions and applying it to the goal project. It leads to a generalizable and fee-effective answer. These paper overviews the AKT and talk capability programs for medical picture segmentation. We survey the latest publications on the subject and discuss modern trends and challenges inside the place. We provide a top-level view of the latest three unique processes to AKT- transfer latest, meta-today, and self-supervised modern-day - and highlight how they can be used to obtain successful medical photo segmentation. Finally, we discuss future guidelines for research in this discipline.

articleTitle: Enhanced QoS Optimization of Opportunistic Networks using Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Opportunistic networks are a type of dynamic wireless network that lack a fixed infrastructure and rely on intermittent connections between nodes to facilitate communication. Quality of Service (QoS) is an essential factor for the efficient operation of opportunistic networks, as it ensures that data is delivered in a timely and reliable manner. This paper proposes an enhanced QoS optimization approach for opportunistic networks using a Decision Tree algorithm. The algorithm considers various network parameters such as node mobility, data transmission rate, and available storage capacity to predict the optimal routing path for data transmission. The Decision Tree algorithm uses a classification technique to build a model based on historical data to identify the most suitable routing path for each data transmission. This approach allows for dynamic adaptation to changing network conditions, improving the overall performance and QoS of the opportunistic network. By incorporating the Decision Tree algorithm into the routing decisions of the opportunistic network, we can achieve better QoS optimization than traditional routing protocols. Our experimental results show that the proposed approach outperforms existing routing protocols regarding data delivery ratio, end-to-end delay, and energy consumption, making it a promising solution for enhancing QoS in opportunistic networks.

articleTitle: Sound Responsive Light Systems in Different Signal Frequencies for Commercial Implementation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The modern lighting environment brings sound-responsive LED (Light Emitting Diode) technology, which is an clever art and technology that has begun to reshape experiential spaces. In this essay I analyze how the LED lighting technology that responds to various signal frequencies can be used in the commercial settings. The heart of this research is the development and testing of a prototype that employs Arduino Nano with a sound sensor and addressable RGB LED strips. We are presenting a new framework of real-time audio processing, in which sound signals are turned into dynamic light displays with the help of a custom-made algorithm, which is demonstrated in the code documentation. These findings show that with suitable integrations the aesthetics and atmosphere of the cafe improve, and the customer engagement and retention are increased too. We address the issues of providing accurate, instant, and power-efficient lighting here. The purpose of this research is to fill the void in market which is not yet being met by commercial lighting solutions that are scalable and adjustable to fit different commercial environments such as retail and entertainment. The study emphasizes a possibility of sound-responsive LED systems to build the unique and personalized atmosphere, which represents the promising trend in innovative, interactive, and adaptive commercial lighting solutions.

articleTitle: The Potential Applications of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in India's Legal System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The legal field is only one of several that may be radically altered by the widespread use of algorithms that combine AI with ML. There is hope for the Indian court system's backlog of cases, inefficiency, and access to justice with the use of artificial intelligence and machine learning. This article explores the possible uses of artificial intelligence and machine learning in India's justice system, looking at how these technologies might fix current problems while making the system more accessible, accurate, and efficient. Case law analysis and precedent identification may be made much easier with the use of legal research tools powered by AI. To help attorneys and judges get the information they need quickly, Natural Language Processing (NLP) algorithms can sort through mountains of legal paperwork. In addition to speeding up the legal process, this also raises the bar for the quality of arguments and rulings. Legal transactions may be completed more quickly and at lower cost with the help of AI-enabled document screening and contract analysis technologies. By quickly spotting problematic language, dangers, and outliers in contracts, ML systems may help businesses save money and avoid legal trouble.

articleTitle: Exploring the Classification of Crystal Structure of Perovskite Oxide Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Classification of crystal structures of perovskite oxides (ABO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>) has been done using various machine learning algorithms. This paper identifies various features, like valance, ionic radius, and electronegativity from the dataset, and the respective features crucial for classification of the perovskites have been used to classify structures of perovskite oxides. We classified the oxides into cubic, tetragonal, orthorhombic, and rhombohedral crystal structures using machine learning and deep learning models. Amongst these, the Kernel SVM model proved to be the best model showing an accuracy of 94%. The GridSerachCV method was implemented for hyperparameter tuning. KernelSVM uses kernel trick to handle nonlinear data and thus allows an SVM to find a better hyperplane to classify. Therefore, KernelSVM proves to be a robust and reliable model for the classification of perovskite materials. Further, data augmentation improved the accuracy of all models except Logistic Regression. We also proposed a novel Deep Learning approach, Encoder-Decoder Kernel SVM (EDKSVM) which expands the feature matrix to an expanded dimension, outperforming the existing Machine Learning approaches.

articleTitle: Internet of Things (IoT) & Health Care Sector: A Techno-Legal Challenges in India
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is a network of interconnected devices that can detect, perform actions, and exchange information with each other and the surrounding environment. These items are generally known as smart devices or intelligent gadgets. The primary goal of integrating intelligent technology is to improve the overall quality of life for individuals. In the healthcare sector, the Internet of Things (IoT) plays a key role in improving the quality of healthcare infrastructure, diagnostic processes, and creating intelligent environments. However, smart healthcare systems have considerable challenges in terms of data security and privacy. Unfortunately, the system is affected by security vulnerabilities in both the medical device software and the hardware. A variety of techniques are used to ensure, get access to, and efficiently manage IoT devices with the highest level of security. Furthermore, the system requires the utilization of sensors, surveillance, strong key confidentiality management, data integrity, and regulated access to sensitive information. This study examines the synergistic effects of combining Internet of Things (IoT) with Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology to streamline operations in the healthcare business. This article addresses the emerging privacy problems and examines the current state of Indian legislation in response to these challenges. India must overhaul its present structure to align with the increasingly adopted new technology in the healthcare sector.

articleTitle: Technological Insights into Yoga Posture Recognition: A State-of-the-Art Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: In the contemporary world, the ancient practice of yoga has gained immense popularity for its holistic approach to well-being. However, with the rise of self-guided yoga practice facilitated by digital platforms, practitioners face challenges in achieving precise alignment and correctness in postures. This paper delves into the intersection of traditional yoga and modern technology, presenting a comprehensive analysis of existing literature and innovative methodologies to address these challenges. Through the integration of deep learning techniques such as PoseNet, OpenPose, and LSTM, our research aims to provide real-time feedback and guidance for self-practitioners. We review studies exploring the significance of yoga in modern life, the surge in self-practice, challenges encountered, and the role of technology in enhancing the yoga experience. Additionally, we present a detailed methodology encompassing data collection, preprocessing, augmentation techniques, and the development of a Yoga Pose Recognition and Correction System. Our approach integrates advanced machine learning models with traditional algorithms, offering a multi-faceted framework for accurate pose identification. Technological innovations such as real-time feedback mechanisms and user-centric interfaces further enhance the system's usability and effectiveness. We discuss diverse applications ranging from yoga education to healthcare and propose future research directions to address challenges such as dataset variability and real-time processing. In conclusion, this research contributes to the evolving landscape of technology-enabled wellness applications, paving the way for accessible and personalized yoga guidance in the digital age.

articleTitle: Support Vector Machines for Fault Detection and Classification in Electrical Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The investigation examines the application of Support Vector Machines (SVMs) for blame location and classification in electrical frameworks, pointing to an upgrade of the reliability of critical foundations. Four SVM-based algorithms—Linear SVM (LSVM), Polynomial SVM (PSVM), Radial Basis Function SVM (RSVM), and Sigmoid SVM (SSVM)—were utilized and assessed for their viability in capturing differing blame scenarios. Among these, the RSVM show utilizing Radial Basis Function parts illustrated prevalent execution, accomplishing an accuracy of 96%, precision of 95%, recall of 97%, and an F1-score of 96%. The study contributes to the field by highlighting the versatility and strength of SVMs in tending to complex blame patterns within electrical frameworks. Comparisons with related work emphasize the predominance of the proposed SVM-based approach, outperforming modern strategies in terms of exactness, exactness, review, and F1 score. Also, the outline of related work emphasizes the broader scene of blame discovery strategies, exhibiting differing procedures such as Kernel Principal Component Analysis, Long Short-Term Memory Neural Networks, gathering learning, and edge computing. In conclusion, the research implies the noteworthiness of leveraging progressed machine learning strategies, especially SVMs, for proficient and accurate fault discovery and classification in electrical frameworks. The discoveries offer important experiences for professionals and analysts, giving an establishment for assist headways in blame location techniques and contributing to the proceeded improvement of electrical framework unwavering quality.

articleTitle: Vertex Partitions Based Approach to Solve the Graph Colouring Problem
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The graph colouring problem is a NP- class problem explored in the literature due to its numerous applications in real world Engineering problems. Graph colouring problem involves to assign colours in such a fashion that neighbouring nodes have distinct colours. In this paper our objective is to find the number of distinct colours that can be used to colour the vertices in the graph. During the colouring process the objective is to use the least number of colours corresponding to considered graph. In this work we devise a new colouring algorithm using greedy technique by exploring the adjacent vertices which is simple and effective and can be used to compute the graph colouring problem in more enhanced way. The algorithm starts with the calculation of links of each vertex in the graph and then unexplored highest degree vertex will be selected for computation of adjacent nodes for colouring. Finally, we examined the presented algorithm on standard DIMACS graph colouring instances to evaluate the success of the devised algorithm. The result obtained after running the proposed algorithm for several categories of graphs like myciel, mugg, mulsol, david, huck, jean in terms of number of colours is equal to the chromatic number of the graph instances.

articleTitle: Enforcing Trademark Rights in the Digital Age: International Complications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Intellectual property means any property intangible in nature which is a product of your intellect, including creativity, innovation, technology, and digital advancements such as Digital Rights Management (DRM) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Trademark Infringement Detection. Intellectual property rights include trademarks, patents, copyrights and other such allied rights. Trademarks are those signs, logos, designs and visual identity of some good or services which can be registered by the user. All these rights are protected by various legislations in India and around the World. However, the internet has adversely affected intellectual property. There are no tangible foundations in cyberspace like there are in the actual world. The most active phase of trademark infringement claims concerns domain name disputes in cyberspace. Domain names are visual identifiers of the business over virtual world and work similar to trademarks. Use of domain names on the internet transcends territorial jurisdiction which makes it necessary to mitigate the losses arising out of unregulated cyberspace. For successful filing and adjudication of the claim there need to be proper laws as to where the jurisdiction lies. There are various factors which determine the jurisdiction but lack of uniform applicability of legislation brings its own set of challenges to the disputed claims. The researchers have attempted to analyse the protection provided by law of trademark to domain names. Also, discussion has been made as to determination of jurisdiction in Indian as well as Foreign Courts regarding disputes of domain name infringement since cyberspace has no defined territorial limits and needs clarity for the businesses to flourish and rights to stay preserved.

articleTitle: Sensor-driven Smart Environments: Enabling Technologies for IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The Internet of Things is a technology that connects devices and sensors to exchange data and automate tasks across various domains. It combines centric detector networks (ICSN) and Wireless Sensor and Actuator Network (WSAN). Now a days this IoT has become even smarter when smart sensors are being used. An integral part of IoT technology are sensors. IoT enables communication between people and machines using any path in the network, providing numerous applications. Sensors play a crucial role in IoT systems as they are the primary data acquisition units. They are used in various applications such Wireless and single-sensor networks provide structural health, traffic management, smart parking, lighting, smart water and agriculture, military, and smart buildings. The article provides a full analysis of sensors, their types and significance in IoT, and how they detect and retrieve data from anywhere at any time.

articleTitle: Novel Deep Learning Approaches to Environmental Management with Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The application of Earth observation data to Deep Learning (DL) has increased dramatically over the last ten years, with ground-breaking initiatives made possible by the creation of foundational models. Environmental concerns have been addressed with the use of these technologies, which have been used to detect air quality, enhance precision agriculture, and provide alerts about deforestation in near real time. The objective of this research is to present cutting-edge studies and uses of these technologies in areas with limited data. The objective is to tackle the problems associated with environmental development while advancing cloud computing, data democracy, open data access, and capacity-building initiatives. This research concludes by analysing the most current breakthroughs and uses of DL and AI in order to encourage sustainability in a range of domains, such as, renewable energy, smart building energy management, environmental health and accomplishing the sustainable developments Goals(SDGs).

articleTitle: Internet Governance Viz-A-Viz Artificial Intelligence Smart System in India - A Critical Analysis of Indian Regulatory Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Nowadays, with the development in technologies, new forms of systems are coming up with a feature of automation that makes things easy a lot. One of the important technology which plays an important role in the background of all other technologies in order to get an expected output is Artificial Intelligence (AI). By combining the technologies (Machine Learning, Internet of Things) with Artificial Intelligence formulate a new term which is “smart”/”intelligent”, means that the systems perform so smartly or intelligently by adopting the knowledge from their surroundings and producing an output that is expected by the user or more than an expectation. However, the term intelligent smart system jointly not being defined anywhere, but the smart system or intelligent system has been defined. It can be used in various fields of industry ranging from government to health sectors and proved to be a greater benefit for society. As these systems are all connected to the internet it is important to gather information from the surroundings and perform on the same to produce an output. Hence, governance is required in terms of privacy and security so that no one misuse the same to risk the data of user. Apart from internet governance, legal implications must be there to regulate these systems. In this paper, the authors have discussed the concept of an Intelligent Smart system, its architecture and challenges, Legal Aspects of an Intelligent smart system; the Relation of Internet Governance to Intelligent Smart Systems in India and the Analysis of Internet of Things Policy.

articleTitle: Prediction of Breast Cancer Using Ensemble Learning and Boosting Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: An extremely serious illness, breast cancer, is a pathological state characterized by uncontrolled proliferation of cells in the breast. Failure to address the issue could potentially result in death going forward. Therefore, it is crucial to accurately forecast breast cancer incidence in an individual and promptly administer treatment during the most favourable stage. This work utilized machine learning techniques to forecast the occurrence of breast cancer. This study made use of a dataset that was sourced from Kaggle. In order to find the best machine learning approach, their effectiveness was tested. In addition to supervised learning algorithms such as Random Forest, SVM, and Naive Bayes, Linear Discriminant Analysis, Quadratic Discriminant Analysis, ensemble learning approaches utilized. Out of the several machine learning models used, the Ensemble learning model XGBoost shown superior performance compared to the other models. This study's data analysis leads to the conclusion that XGBoost is the best model.

articleTitle: Synergistic Fusion of Multi-Contrast Imaging and Computational Image Synthesis for Quadruple Contrast-Enhanced Images and Multi-Map Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Accurate tissue maps and a wide range of imaging modalities are required for medical imaging assessments and therapies. Our exclusive technology employs multi-contrast imaging and cutting-edge computer image synthesis to produce high-quality multi-maps and pictures of body regions and disorders. This approach uses deep learning fusion and computational image synthesis to construct multi-maps of disease markers and tissue features from several imaging modalities. Quality inspection and validation assure the correctness of the images and multi-maps. In terms of memory, accuracy, precision, and other performance measures, our strategy surpassed all other approaches. Reliable data gathering and visualization of physiological structures may enhance patient outcomes and medical imaging technologies. Applying the research results to other clinical contexts necessitates confirming the findings with real clinical data. The technology available might help medical practitioners comprehend and analyse complicated biological systems. There may be personalized treatment regimens and diagnostic imaging.

articleTitle: Fake Review Identification Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The use of false opinions, sometimes known as fake reviews, to mislead customers has become more common in recent times. This is due to the fast growth of online marketing initiatives such as purchasing and selling. Customers can leave comments and evaluations regarding the goods or services they have purchased when they shop online. Prior to making a purchase, prospective buyers typically read the reviews and comments that have been left on the website. The present difficulty, meanwhile, is getting newcomers to discern genuine evaluations from fraudulent ones, which go on to deceive consumers, create losses, and harm the image of companies. This research objective is to create a trained model that can point out fraudulent feedback on e-commerce sites by utilizing sentiment ratings and n-grams of the review text provided by the reviewer. When the outcomes were compared to previous studies that employed the same dataset, proposed methods performed better in terms of accuracy than the equivalent approaches.

articleTitle: Swarm Intelligence-Based Clustering Algorithms for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This work studies the use of swarm intelligence-based clustering algorithms such as Ant Colony Optimization (ACO), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) Bee Algorithm (BA), and Firefly Algorithm (FA), to optimize Wireless Sensor Networks. (WSNs). It evaluated their performance by strict simulations on energy consumption level, network lifetime, and clustering quality. It is observed that ACO and PSO consistently showed better results with moderate energy consumption by achieving long network lifetimes as well as precise clustering. However, BA and FA have been competitive but had lower efficiency when looking at certain metrics. The comparative analysis highlights the need for algorithmic selection according to specific demands in WSN deployments. The study complements related research on the application of swarm intelligence in WSN by focusing on routing challenges, energy-aware protocols, and centralized clustering solutions. The results give useful information to practitioners who are looking for the best algorithms, especially in real WSN situations.

articleTitle: A Study on Smart Machine Learning (ML) Tools for Crime Detection and Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Crime, a grave menace to society, not only disrupts the lives of individuals, whether they are victims or perpetrators but also reverberates throughout families and communities. Presently, law enforcement agencies face the daunting task of thwarting criminal activities. This study delves into various machine learning algorithms employed in the detection and prevention of crime. This research paper surveys recent literature examining the application of various Machine Learning algorithms in forecasting and mitigating future criminal activities. It investigates the computational challenges and opportunities presented by historical trends in predicting crime—the study endeavours to analyse and discuss the predominant parameters explored across multiple studies. Through a review of past literature, it becomes apparent that while numerous parameters have been utilized, the primary focus remains on crime patterns concerning time and crime hotspots. This paper conducts a comprehensive inquiry into Machine Learning techniques for uncovering and forecasting future crimes. It reveals that researchers predominantly rely on supervised ML approaches in their investigations, largely due to their superior accuracy.

articleTitle: The Nexus of Fog Computing and Wireless Sensor Systems Opportunities and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Remember also that enhancing real-time apps relies heavily on the efficient and dynamic allocation of computer resources in fog computing and WSS. Because these two technologies are foundational to the development of real-time applications, this is the case. This is due, in part, to the fact that these technologies make optimal use of the resources at their disposal. The increasing significance of these instruments may have contributed to the emergence of this issue. Attempting to do so will bring the reader up to speed on the Dynamic Fog-Edge Resource Allocation (DFERA) technique. The objectives of maximizing fog and edge resources, decreasing latency, conserving energy, and guaranteeing Quality of Service (QoS) were the driving forces for the development of this approach. In order for the greatest possible outcome to occur, these objectives were set. The structure of DFERA is based on three primary approaches. The foundation of DFERA is these formulae. Methods like Quality-Aware Resource Scaling (QARS) for controlling service quality, Edge-Based Data Preprocessing (EDP) for optimizing data, and Dynamic Workload Distribution (DWD) for load balancing are all part of this set of approaches. In this category you will find all of these jobs. These strategies are proven to function using performance metrics derived from actual data. In mathematics, these algorithms rely on equations, and the equations aid in the implementation of the algorithms.

articleTitle: Implementation and Evaluation of Various Deep Learning Models for the Diagnosis of Cotton Leaf Diseases
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Cotton, a vital cash crop, suffers significant yield losses due to various leaf diseases. Early and accurate detection of the diseases is crucial for implementing control measures. This research explores the potential of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for cotton leaf disease classification. We have evaluated five pre-trained CNN architectures: DenseNet, MobileNet, ResNet, VGGNet, and GoogleNet. A publicly available cotton leaf disease dataset is used for training and testing. GoogleNet achieved the highest accuracy (95%). Detecting diseases in cotton leaves involves various key steps, first comes image preprocessing followed by segmentation then feature extraction and finally classification. The accuracy of these steps profoundly affects the reliability of the disease classification algorithms. Recent studies have assessed cutting-edge techniques in this area, showing promise for improving the crop yield and reducing losses as much as possible. Early disease detection allows timely interventions to control spread which in turn results in preventing any significant damage. This research compares the latest advancements, evaluating their practicality in the real time scenarios.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cloud IoT Security With Blockchain and SDN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: In the fast changing world of cloud based internet of things (IoT) eco-systems, secure connectivity between devices and cloud services is vital. On the other hand, the rising Man-in-the- Middle (MitM) attacks present serious threats to data integrity and confidentiality. In this regard, through a combination of Software Defined Networking (SDN) and Blockchain technology, this study proposes an innovative technique for improving security architecture in cloud IoT settings against MitM attacks. The solution put forward relies on blockchain to provide immutable transactions that are used as tamper-proof ledgers for device authentication and secure data sharing. Smart contracts create unchangeable transactions that also maintain the anonymity of devices and their communication processes. Additionally, SDN technology segments traffic, implements dynamic network policies, and therefore reduces MitM attack vectors through traffic inspection and access control. The testing process has shown that the approach effectively prevents MitM attacks while ensuring safe communication channels in cloud-based IoT systems. This implementation demonstrates improved data integrity, confidentiality, and security against unwanted intrusion attempts. This research paper contributes to the development of the cloud-based IoT security paradigm and highlights the synergistic potential of Blockchain and SDN in dealing with common security issues and improving the trustworthiness of networked devices for the Internet of Things.

articleTitle: Integrative Approaches to Environmental Footprints Computing: A Systematic Review of Multidimensional Sustainability Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: In light of the increasing complexity of the world's environmental difficulties, it is necessary to create sustainability strategies that combine varied environmental factors, including carbon emissions, water utilization, energy usage, and environmental problems. the pivotal role of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Environmental Footprint Computing, aiming to delineate its contributions, methodologies, and implications within sustainability paradigms. Environmental Footprint Computing encompasses the quantification and analysis of environmental impacts across various domains, ranging from industrial processes to individual consumption patterns. AI interventions in this domain offer unprecedented opportunities for enhancing accuracy, scalability, and efficiency in environmental impact assessments. The purpose of this systematic review, integrative approaches to environmental footprints: a systematic review of multidimensional sustainability strategies is to review existing studies on the integration of footprints to address connected global sustainability issues. The present research specifically screened peer-reviewed publications published between January 2010 and December 2023, including comprehensive assessments, case studies, or empirical data about the integration of multiple environmental footprints. The researchers used different databases for the given study including Web of Science, Scopus, and Google Scholar. Integrated footprint assessments may contribute to a deeper comprehension of environmental impacts, incorporation to sustainability setups on numerous levels, resource management, policy development, and Sustainable Development Goals. The present findings are based on a total of fifty research studies. The present research recommends that further effort be devoted to improving the methodological approaches for integrated footprint assessments to back equitable and just proportionate sustainability efforts in diverse areas and populations. It is recommended that future study continues how to further develop these measures, specifically on socio-economic effects.

articleTitle: Advances and Challenges in Mobile Phone Forensics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Numerous illegal actions have an effect on the lives of hundreds of millions of people who rely on their smartphones to get them through the day. As the popularity of smartphones continues to rise, so does the possibility that they may be exploited for criminal purposes. There is a wealth of applications, cutting-edge hardware, and operating systems built into today's smartphones. Due to advancements in semiconductor technology and enhanced computing capabilities, mobile phones have experienced notable advances in their effectiveness, all while maintaining a compact form factor suitable for pocket portability. As a result, Forensic investigators faces difficulties when trying to investigate a mobile phone to analyze evidence. The data stored on mobile devices has become a crucial piece of evidence in forensic investigations. Knowledge of forensic instruments and their capabilities is essential for gathering meaningful information from the digital devices. In this study, we analyze the features of certain cutting-edge data formats that might be presented as mobile device evidence for Forensic investigations. Some of the newest technology for mobile phone evidence collection are also discussed, along with their efficacy. This review examines the features of mobile devices, the procedures of mobile forensic investigations, the different mobile forensic technologies, and their present and future uses.

articleTitle: Trend Tracking Artificial Intelligence Predictive Models for New and Highly Advanced Financial Markets
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Investment is a significant key which helps in boosting the economy of the country. There is a wide variety of financial tools available to assist individuals in the process of investing their money. One example of this kind of financial instrument is the equity share, which offers returns that are far higher than those offered by any other fixed income product. Stock markets provide the infrastructure necessary for engaging in the buying and selling of equity shares. Every nation has a stock market where companies may list their stocks, which draws in investors. However, there is a possibility of loss associated with the usage of this instrument due to the fact that the returns are determined by a number of different circumstances. Hence forecasting the returns on the stocks and going ahead for investment attracts every individual. In the future, we are going to investigate the directional trend of the SMI (Stochastic Momentum Index), and we are also going to estimate the one-day CP of the SMI by using ‘Machine Learning’ (ML) and ‘Deep Learning’ (DL) models. The aforementioned issue statement serves as the inspiration for the study's aims, which are stated below.

articleTitle: The State-of-the-Art Review on the Sensors used in the Automotive Sector
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This research paper explores the extensive role of sensors in various engineering applications, particularly focusing on their significance in automotive systems. Beginning with an introduction to automated systems enabled by sensors, the paper delves into the diverse types of sensors and their applications. It highlights the pivotal role of sensors in modern automobiles, where they contribute to performance enhancement, efficiency, and safety. The paper discusses the evolution of sensor technology, emphasizing the significance of materials such as semiconductors, metals, ceramics, polymers, and piezoelectric materials in sensor fabrication. It further examines the key characteristics of these materials and their relevance to sensor performance. Additionally, the paper discusses emerging sensor technologies, including IoT-enabled sensors, power sensors, wearable sensors, AI-enabled sensors, biometric sensors, and augmented reality sensors, and their potential impact on various industries. Finally, it addresses the challenges and future directions in sensor technology, particularly in the context of autonomous vehicles. Overall, this paper provides comprehensive insights into the role of sensors in modern engineering applications and highlights the importance of materials in sensor design and functionality.

articleTitle: A Detailed Comparative Study of AI-Based Intrusion Detection System for Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The proliferation of Internet of Things (IoT) devices poses potential challenges in the fast-developing field of smart cities, especially in cybersecurity. This work is an attempt to present an extensive comparative analysis of AI-based intrusion detection systems (IDS) designed for smart cities. The necessity of robust intrusion detection systems is highlighted early on in discussing the security threats associated with IoT and its importance in enhancing urban life.
