The study looks at current datasets that are frequently utilized to train IDS models, emphasizing both their shortcomings and the growing need for more diverse and representative datasets. This work explores the use of deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML) approaches for intrusion detection in smart city environments, it looks at different classifiers and how well they identify cyber threats. This paper presents simulation methods and experimental results for demonstrating the accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score performance of many classifiers using the complex datasets NF_BoT_IoT and IoTID20. This paper also touches upon the significance of continuing research in utilizing cutting-edge algorithms and novel datasets to improve smart cities' cybersecurity posture and, eventually, aid in creating more complex intrusion detection systems that can successfully handle the ever-changing threat landscape. It also emphasizes the necessity of ongoing innovation in this field and the potential for deep learning algorithms to improve cyberattack detection skills.

articleTitle: Optimizing Vehicle-to-Grid Integration With Novel Energy Management Strategies and Battery Cost Considerations for Enhanced Microgrid Operations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Electric vehicles that can connect to the grid are becoming more important in today's power networks as a means of balancing the grid's supply and demand in different situations. The utility operators and regulators have a number of issues in this changing paradigm, one of which is the development of energy management methods for the practical and economical use of V2G. To make the most of the vehicle-to-grid (V2G) capability of plug-in electric vehicles (PEVs) and manage power outages in microgrids that are linked to the grid, this article suggests two energy management practices. There are two main points made by the article. To begin, it suggests a new way to bid on PEVs that provide V2G by factoring in the expected cost of battery deterioration when incorporating them into microgrid operations. Secondly, considering the reliability of energy demand and supply forecasts as well as market pricing, two energy management methodologies are suggested for integrating V2G into microgrid operations. A multi-agent system built in the Apache Agent expansion framework is used to implement the suggested V2G integration techniques. This system is then deployed to a microgrid case study. If there is a large fluctuation in energy prices and the cost of PEV batteries is low, the simulation results and their analysis demonstrate that V2G may be used to achieve maximum depths of discharge.

articleTitle: Exploring Deception Techniques in Safeguarding IoT Networks from Intruders
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The expansion of Internet of Things devices and its network is not only transforming across industries but also has been playing an important role in our day-to-day life. Though, this increase in the number of connected IOT devices brings the concern of different cyber threats and vulnerabilities. Gradually, attacks are getting matured day by day which compromises the security and intruders are getting easy access into the IOT environment due to traditional security mechanism. Deception technology has been an effective technique has improved security in IOT devices. Deception technology implements the deployment of honeypots, deceptive elements, breadcrumbs in required IOT environment as defence mechanism. In this study, we discuss different deceptive methods along with synthetic data generation that can be applied in multiple IOT environments to enhance the security by not only identifying anomalous behaviour but also prevent intruder to perform malicious activities.

articleTitle: Advances in Crime Identification: A Machine Learning Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Crime profoundly impacts individuals, communities, and families. Technological advancements have provided perpetrators with new opportunities for criminal activities. The primary objective of the police department is to resolve crimes, ensuring justice for the victims. Additionally, preventing such incidents is crucial for creating a safer world. The landscape of criminal justice has undergone a significant shift with the integration of machine learning techniques, unlocking unparalleled potential for accuracy and efficiency. This study thoroughly examines the concept of various applications of machine learning in crime detection, prediction, and prevention. We examine the evolution of these technologies, from early developments to state- of-the-art methodologies, conducting a thorough analysis of their strengths, limitations, and ethical considerations. Moreover, the paper sheds light on crimes discussed in academic circles, serving as a repository for scholars and researchers. This facilitates informed discussions and guides future research endeavours.

articleTitle: High-Dimensional Data Processing Using Quantum-Inspired Evolutionary Algorithms for Homeland Security Imaging Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This research study explores the emerging area of quantum-inspired evolutionary algorithms (QIEAs) applied to high-dimensional data processing, with a focus on homeland security imaging systems. This work attempts to close the paradigm gap in image processing methodologies caused by the growing complexity of security threats. By combining the adaptive processes of evolutionary algorithms with the probabilistic reasoning inherent in quantum computing, the proposed technique creates a potent tool for managing the inherent difficulties of high-dimensional data. The main contribution of this study is the creation of a brand-new QIEA framework that is specifically designed for image analysis in security contexts and exhibits higher accuracy and efficiency than traditional techniques. The quantum bit representation and quantum gate operations, which have been cleverly tailored to the evolutionary algorithm structure, provide the methodological basis, and improve the search capacity in multidimensional data fields. An unparalleled degree of clarity and detail in security photography is made possible by this fusion, which is essential for threat identification and prevention. Experiments conducted on a variety of difficult datasets show that the suggested method is reliable for identifying important characteristics in complicated photos, which is a crucial component of homeland security applications. Beyond only addressing short-term security issues, this study establishes a standard for next investigations into quantum-inspired computing for image processing.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Testing Strategies for Water Purity by Assessing and Eliminating Viruses and Bacteria using Machine Learning algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Water, essential for life, is often contaminated with bacteria and viruses, depriving many accesses towards purified drinking and irrigation water. The presence of pathogens in unpurified water puts human health at risk and contaminates crops, leading to waterborne illnesses. Detecting indicator bacteria and viruses in water is crucial for assessing microbiological quality. Despite efforts by regulatory authorities, disease outbreaks linked to drinking water persist globally. The World Health Organization released some threshold values based on some water parameters. The metrics are named as The Water Purity by Assessing and Eliminating Viruses and Bacteria (WPAEVB) and Irrigation WQI (IWQI) which can measure the water quality. This paper proposed a network architecture to analyze all the parameters by using machine learning tools (ML) tools which will determine the drinking water and irrigation water based on virus and bacteria microbiological values. The model is developed based on LoRa and land topology. Here we used three models SVM, logistic regression (LR), and random forest (RF) to know whether irrigation water is being used for drinking water by detecting the percentage and levels of bacteria and virus. The dataset was developed based on the ML models due to the lower availability of datasets related to irrigation and drinking water and bacteria and virus percentage is also calculated by using three models. Following the application of every model, SVM produced the greatest results for irrigation water, while LR produced the best performance for drinking water. The three ML models were applied in order to complete the iterative feature elimination.

articleTitle: Risk Management in Financial Institutions with Applied Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: In today's business world, technological applications are becoming more important in management. Among the most prevalent influencers in business applications are machine learning, artificial intelligence, and other algorithmic applications. They offer a wide range of fixes for issues with business management, risk management in banking included. In the past ten years, risk management has become more important in the financial services industry. Banks used to concentrate on risk assessment, measurement, and reporting. Nevertheless, they are now using machine learning to improve management's efficiency and precision. It determined the areas of risk management that needed attention and investigated several solutions. The need for funding fluctuates depending on the loan provider and is cyclical. Financing must consider the asset's supply and demand in order to guarantee the asset's success. One type of switch-over exercise that entails fast exchanges for cash loans is finance. This study looked into how ML might affect a bank's risk management practices. Essentially, the study showed how machine learning techniques increased the forecast accuracy of risk management models. articleTitle: Overcoming Quantum Hardware Challenges: Navigating the Landscape of Quantum Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Quantum computing has surfaced as a revolutionary idea with the potential to transform industries ranging from cryptography to drug discovery. However, alongside its promise, quantum computing faces formidable challenges, particularly in the realm of hardware development and scalability. One of the central challenges lies in the creation and scaling of dependable hardware infrastructure. At present, quantum computers can only manipulate a limited number of qubits for brief periods before succumbing to noise-induced disruptions. This constraint severely curtails their ability to execute complex computations and address real-world problems with efficiency. Furthermore, the relentless march towards miniaturization presents a significant hurdle. As transistors shrink in size, quantum effects increasingly interfere with their behavior, posing a barrier to further hardware miniaturization and scalability. Moreover, the quest to increase qubit counts stands as a pivotal milestone in advancing quantum computing capabilities. However, achieving higher qubit counts is fraught with challenges. These include the maintenance of qubit coherence and stability, the mitigation of unwanted inter-qubit interactions, and overcoming logistical hurdles in fabrication and control systems. Each of these challenges presents a significant roadblock on the path to realizing the full potential of quantum computing. Despite these formidable obstacles, researchers and scientists are actively engaged in the pursuit of solutions. Through innovative approaches and rigorous experimentation, they are striving to overcome the barriers impeding hardware development and scalability. By addressing these challenges, quantum computing stands poised to unlock unprecedented computational power and drive breakthroughs in fields ranging from optimization and machine learning to materials science and beyond. Thus, while the road ahead may be fraught with challenges, the transformative potential of quantum computing compels us to persevere in our quest to harness the power of the quantum realm.

articleTitle: Propagation Dynamics and Connectivity Assurance in Sensor Radio Networks

abstract: This piece talks about research that has been done on sending signals over sensor radio networks and making sure that links are safe. The second method, called the Disturbance Mitigation technique (IMA), changes the broadcast power and channel selection on the fly to stop close devices from interfering. In busy WiFi networks, this makes sure that joining is effective. Algorithm 3: ARPC changes route paths based on how the network is working right now. It consistently links, even when the network changes. Using all three of these methods together helps us consider differences in propagation, get the most out of transmission power, and choose communication lines on the fly. This makes the network work better and be more reliable. Mathematical models help us figure out things like throughput, packet loss rate, end-to-end latency, network life, energy saves, and the dependability of connections.

Furthermore, ML models are subsequently deployed to identify specific DoS attack types, including “Blackhole.”, “Grayhole.”, “TDMA (Scheduling).”, and “Flooding.”. These networks are decentralized dynamic networks that are in motion every time and need fast and secure communication among the vehicles. VANET is more vulnerable to attacks. Attacks include various DoS, Warm hole, and Blackhole attacks. Many algorithms have been proposed in the past to investigate various attacks and to provide solutions to prevent these attacks. This document investigates various attacks over VANET and gives an analysis of various algorithms proposed in the past. A study of AODV and its applicability to detect various types of attacks has been presented. In this algorithm, the source node prepares the look-up table to store the route reply packets from all the nodes. It stores the route reply in ascending order. The priority of route replies is taken from the recent sequence numbers. The high sequence number route replies are discarded assuming these routes are obsolete now. This newly submitted algorithm to remove the various attacks has been designed and simulated using Network Simulator 2. It is also being compared with the existing algorithms. It proves the improvement in the detection and prevention of Blackhole attacks. NS2 simulator has been used for simulating this work.

articleTitle: Prediction Analysis of AI Adoption in Various Domain Using Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Client churn is still a problem in this industry even though the telecom sector was among the first to use information mining along with machine learning techniques to extract meaningful insights from massive data sets. This proposal offers an innovative approach to reducing customer attrition in the telecom industry, along with the application of a technique known as “strategically pitching” or “market container investigation,” which is often used in retail contexts. For a considerable amount of time, administration administrators in the media communications industry have been dealing with client churn, a common yet incredibly harmful phenomenon. Successfully reducing client churn can be achieved by separating clients who are prone to churning in the early stages and taking precautions. As a result, the focus of this research is developing the churn prediction model; also, this analysis is divided into two distinct sections. Since the beginning, we have introduced a model known as MRF (Modified Random Forest), which helps to both prevent backslide issues and increase accuracy. We tested our framework using the orange datasets that were provided. Two scenarios—stir and upselling—are compared between the existing and predicted approaches in order to assess our calculation. The results demonstrate that our model beats the current method for recollecting typical unexpected woods in regards to AUC and gathering precision after comparing it to a number of currently available stir figure models.

articleTitle: Drug Discovery with Machine Learning: Target Identification using Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The abstract presents a see into our inquiry about on-target distinguishing proof in sedate disclosure utilizing Random Forest, displaying the transformative effect of machine learning. Leveraging different natural datasets, we utilized Random Forest nearby other calculations to foresee potential medicate targets. Our comprehensive assessment measurements, counting accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score, emphasize the prevalent execution of Random Forest in comparison to Decision Trees, Support Vector Machines, and k-Nearest Neighbors. The results demonstrate a precision of 85%, accuracy of 86%, review of 84%, and an F1 score of 85% for Irregular Forest, certifying its viability in precisely recognizing promising sedate targets. The study contributes to the advancing scene of machine learning applications in biomedical research, emphasizing the potential of gathering learning procedures, especially Irregular Woodland, to streamline and improve the target identification stage of sedate improvement. This research adjusts with broader patterns in healthcare and pharmaceutical examinations, highlighting the flexibility of machine learning in tending to complex challenges and quickening the disclosure of novel restorative arrangements.

articleTitle: Identifying Spam Accounts on Instagram: An Analysis of User Activity Data Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Instances of the spam bots involving social networks such as Instagram pose a huge threat to the functionality and authenticity of such platforms. This study analyses the detection accuracy of accepted methods when dealing with spam accounts. Through this analysis, authors focused on compare the pros and cons of each method and select the approach that suits their needs. The purpose of this study is the assessment of the efficacy of an ensemble learning method for the detection of spam accounts on Instagram. At the next stage, a novel approach is discussed that unite some features of the highly functioning methods. With the help of user activity data, which will be used to train and test the machine learning approach, we strive to achieve significantly better results in spam account detection compared to existing methods. Our approach focusses on conducting the research details i.e. how the data collection and tabulation for analysis will take place. However, this involves making data clean, filling in missing information, and possibly even balancing lopsided datasets. Discovery of features is a very crucial step which will help us identify worthful details from user activity data including how often user posts, how users content perform and account characteristics. The evaluation metrics focus on precision, recall, and F1-score to assess the model's ability and accurately classify both spam and genuine accounts. The results demonstrate that the ensemble model achieves a high degree of accuracy, with precision exceeding 0.96 and recall exceeding 0.95.

articleTitle: Efficient Load Balancing Algorithms for Edge Computing in IoT Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This study investigates the accuracy of load balancing calculations in terms of edge computing for IoT. The paper compared four main calculations, namely Round Robin (RR), Weighted Round Robin (WRR), Least Connections (LC) and Ant Colony Optimization ratings in an reproduced edge computing atmosphere. As for the study, it focused on efficiency improvements of asset utilization as well as reducing inactivity and enhancing reasonableness. Weighted Round Robin showed that the predominant execution came about with an astonishing 25% decrease in idleness as compared to a depiction of noncapacity aware task load distribution. The Slightest Associations also showed extraordinary outcomes, achieving 20% decrease in idle period and demonstrated that it could be flexible with workloads. While flexible, Ant Colony Optimization demonstrated an inability to achieve steady variation improvements related with parameter tuning ranging from 15% toward 30%. The discoveries emphasize the significance of calculation choice based on the particular prerequisites of IoT edge situations.

articleTitle: Advancing Power System Evolution with the Energy Internet for Renewable Integration and Grid Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The integration of renewable power has emerged as a global issue impeding power system growth. The emergence of the energy network will provide an innovative approach to resolving this issue. This essay examined the fundamental meaning of the term “energy internet” as well as the major variables affecting the acceptance of renewable power in our nation. A few renewable energy-friendly technologies that are focused on the energy internet are also covered, including integrated energy systems, market utilization, and optimum dispatch. These technologies will serve as a guide for future power grid operations that optimize power grid performance and accommodate renewable energy.

articleTitle: Alzheimer's Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The field of medicine has experienced a significant shift due to advancements in machine learning, which holds immense potential for early prediction of Alzheimer's disease. By leveraging data from brain scans, physical examinations, and medical histories, machine learning algorithms offer a streamlined and efficient means of identifying individuals displaying initial symptoms of Alzheimer's. This early detection is crucial for patients, as it facilitates prompt intervention and management of the condition. Consequently, this study underscores the superiority of employing machine learning models for accurate classification of Alzheimer's disease. Logistic regression, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Decision Trees, and Tensor Flow are compared in this research endeavor. The results reveal that Decision Trees outshine other models, achieving an impressive accuracy rate of 96.97%. Hence, Decision Trees emerge as the optimal machine learning approach for effectively categorizing patients with Alzheimer's disease.

articleTitle: Enhancing Internet Security: A Machine Learning-Based Browser Extension to Prevent Phishing Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Phishing attacks continue to pose a significant threat to internet users, targeting individuals across various online platforms. In response to this pervasive issue, we present a novel approach aimed at bolstering internet security through the development of a browser extension. Leveraging machine learning algorithms, our extension provides real-time analysis of URLs to determine their susceptibility to phishing attacks. By empowering users with the ability to identify potentially harmful websites, our solution aims to mitigate the risks associated with falling victim to phishing scams. Furthermore, our extension offers a proactive feature allowing users to contribute to a vulnerable site list, enhancing collective defence against emerging threats. Through the implementation of our browser extension, we strive to provide a robust layer of protection for users, thereby fostering a safer online environment.

articleTitle: Realization of 4 × 10 Gbps FSO-WDM System Incorporating Flattening Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The free space optics (FSO) and wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) based system supports and contributes to the various services provided by big data, AI, online gaming, and 5G+ mobile networks. Additionally, the WDM access system may provide extended and long-reach coverage, high channel capacity, and high flexibility. Thus, a 40Gbps FSO-WDM system incorporating gain flattening filter is realized as well as investigated. It is shown that 500-1600m range at bit error rate of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> is obtained at 10Gbps throughput. The −40dBm received power is achieved w.r.t. −20dBm launch power for distinct wavelengths after 100m range. Also, the system gain of −32 to 0dBm & noise figure of 32dB are obtained successfully and indicates superiority over other existing designs.

articleTitle: Development a Novel Hybrid Deep Learning-Model for Brain Tumor Classification and Automated Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Tumors of the brain are among the deadliest diseases of the century. Artificial intelligence (AI) and neuroscience are used to identify, identify, and categorize brain tumors. A large amount of MRI scans must be manually segmented and categorized. An effective computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) system is essential for the timely analysis of brain tumors. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is used to segment, extract, and classify brain tumors. All systems have achieved a superior level of performance. We used deep learning-based models to predict brain tumor disease with 99.10% accuracy. By analyzing huge amounts of data and extracting significant features accurately and efficiently, these models can offer improved patient outcomes and timely treatment in the healthcare sector in a short timeframe compared to existing approaches.

articleTitle: Automated Semantic Interpretations in Web Applications via Cloud Computing Aspects
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The creation and execution of applications in several disciplines have been greatly aided by the integration of cloud computing and semantic web technologies. Although they are independent entities, they may also be combined in many ways to provide answers—a subject that has been thoroughly researched lately. The number of “new cloud providers, applications, facilities, management systems, and data” has significantly increased in recent years. The complexity that has resulted from this expansion emphasises the need for new technology in order to efficiently manage and support these varied and many services and resources. As a result, difficulties with “cloud services and resources” transferability, compatibility, security, choice, negotiation, identity, and specification might arise. Semantic Technologies are a vital tool for reassessing these issues because of their enormous “cloud computing” capacity. This study uses a variety of sources to examine and evaluate the impact of “Semantic-Web Technology” in the cloud. Moreover, a cloud-based engagement strategy shows how we may leverage the features and advantages of cloud computing to build the semantic web and provide automatic semantic annotations to online applications on a large scale.

articleTitle: Ethical Implications of AI-Powered Communication Tool
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Everyday life and technology have been profoundly affected by artificial intelligence (AI), which has brought about revolutions in both. Topics covered include algorithmic prejudice, privacy issues, and the effects on jobs, as well as AI's dual role as an ally and an opponent. Data privacy and artificial intelligence ethical laws are two areas where India is exerting strong influence. The impact of Indian culture and society on these ethical dilemmas caused by AI is the primary subject of this study. Privacy, prejudice, and social standards are among of the topics covered, along with the pros and cons of AI. A comparison of the regulatory frameworks in India shows that different approaches face similar problems, such as the need for flexible and inclusive rules.

articleTitle: Model Order Reduction of Linear Time Invarient System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This study proposes a new technique for reducing the order of higher order linear time-invariant (LTI) systems to their lower order models. The proposed approach combines two model order reduction schemes: Routh Approximation (RA) and Arithmetic Optimization Algorithm (AOA). To validate the effectiveness of this approach, numerous numerical examples of low and high order systems are used. The outcomes demonstrate that the lowered order models obtained by the proposed approach preserve both the transient and steady state conditions of the original system. Furthermore, the performance of the proposed method is compared with several other existing model order reduction approaches. The comparison shows that the proposed method outperforms these techniques, resulting in significantly lower Integral Square Error (ISE).

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Automatic Speed Control of Ceiling Fan Through PWM Technique with Optocoupler to Reduce Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The evolution of automation and innovations helps in diverse field. This helps to create human lives much easier. It tend to produce various automatic devices. These devices must include the control system to improve the automation in the equipment. The important equipment used in our day to day life is the ceiling fan. This is the largely used equipment. The conventional system includes manual speed control. To enhance automation in the system, the proposed system is implemented to replace the conventional system with automatic speed control system. This helps to automatically control the speed of the fan based upon the surrounding temperature. This is sensed through the use of sensors. This includes pulse width modulation techniques with brushless permanent magnet DC motors and microcontroller. Here PIC microcontrollers are used for controlling and processing. Thus these techniques are employed for the automatic detection of ceiling fan. This leads in the reduction of energy consumption and reduced cost.

articleTitle: Improved Adaptive Ranking-Based Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: In Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs), sensor nodes autonomously configure themselves to meet application-specific requiremnts, capable of self-calibration, synchronization, and localization. Data from these nodes is directed towards a central sink or base station. Since, the selection of a Cluster Head (CH) is critical, hence, in this paper it is proposed that CH is to be selected based on its proximity to the base station and its remaining energy, ensuring it functions optimally. Nodes not chosen as CHs serve as leader nodes, elected for their high energy levels to manage data transmissions effectively. Furthermore, gateway nodes facilitate data flow within the network. Sensor data is relayed through a hierarchy from sensor nodes to CHs, then to leader nodes, and finally to gateway nodes, which transmit it to the base station. This network model, simulated in MATLAB, is analysed for performance metrics such as the number of operational nodes, energy-depleted nodes, and the volume of data packets transmitted, providing insights into the network's efficiency and robustness.

articleTitle: Integrated Life Saving Solution for Free Movement of Ambulance in Heavy Traffic Using YOLOV8
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Ambulance Service is considered to be the fastest service that is to be reached to every citizen in this existing world. This Vehicles serves in the Medical Emergencies of a person. At the traffic signals when the red signal is given a large number of vehicles will be stopped and waits for green signal. When an Ambulance is coming through that way then this waiting vehicle will be a great issue to the Ambulance motion forward in that way. In order to resolve this issue, we will make software consisting of different audio, cam sensors and Hardware components with micro controllers that will detect the Ambulance a little before reaching the signal junction. After detecting the required vehicles, it will send a signal to the Hardware components. Then the software present in Hardware will give the yellow signal first and then green signal to the way through which the Ambulance is coming. By this way we can clear route to emergency vehicles in traffic jam. As the traffic is clear, it will be very easy for the Ambulance diver to reach the patient in the vehicle to Hospital on time.

Author Keywords: image processing through deep learning frame works techniques

articleTitle: Influence of Crumb Rubber on Temperature Susceptibility and Activations Energy of Crumb Rubber Modified Bitumen
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This study investigates the temperature susceptibility properties of crumb rubber modified bitumen. The various approaches like assessing viscosity temperature susceptibility & A (regression intercept) parameters, activation energy and penetration index are utilized to evaluate bitumen's response to temperature changes. As the crumb rubber modifier (CRM) content increases, the viscosity of the modified bitumen increases, due to enhanced intermolecular forces resulting from crumb rubber modifier addition. Moreover, an increase in crumb rubber modifier percentage notably decreases both A and viscosity temperature susceptibility values, indicating improved temperature susceptibility. Addition of crumb rubber modifier reduces the activation energy of crumb rubber modified bitumen compared to the base bitumen. A linear relationship between crumb rubber modifier percentage and activation energy is evident. Furthermore, increasing crumb rubber modifier content in base bitumen results in a higher penetration index value, signifying enhanced temperature susceptibility of crumb rubber modified bitumen.

articleTitle: Utilizing of Different Types Waste Materials Used in Concrete Production in Civil Construction: A Sustainable and Environmentally Responsible Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The current study intends to evaluate the possibility of employing industrial and agricultural waste, such as fly ash, bottom ash, eggshell powder, rice husk ash powder, and bagasse ash, to increase the efficiency and sustainability of concrete manufacturing. By including these waste products into the concrete production processes, the aim is to promote resource conservation, environmental sustainability, and the development of innovative, eco-friendly construction materials. The primary objective of this study is to shed light on recent developments in the field of research on the utilization of waste materials in the production of concrete. The goal of the research is to facilitate the development of innovative and sustainable concrete manufacturing solutions by identifying knowledge gaps and areas in need of more investigation.

articleTitle: A Framework on Positioning of Medical Sensors in Healthcare Domain
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: In the last several years, the incorporation of sensor technology into our everyday routines has resulted in improved comfort, convenience, and overall wellbeing. The size and cost of medical sensors have decreased as a consequence of technical improvements that have improved their use. Medical sensors make “remote health monitoring, surgical procedures, therapy, and rehabilitation” more efficient and practical. We provide an in-depth historical overview of medical sensors during the last fifty years, emphasising their use in clinical settings. The evaluation also examines the impact of IoT on the advancement of sensor technologies and the uses of such technologies in healthcare. We also examine the benefits and drawbacks of several integrated architectures that have been recently proposed for the smooth integration of different medical sensors with novel paradigms and technologies, including those that are located at the edge, in the cloud, in the middle (mobile cloud computing), and in the sky (fog computing) of the network. We conclude by outlining the next challenges that must be overcome in order to fully actualize the best potential and benefits of medical sensor technologies and, in the end, build a robust, scalable, reliable, and affordable healthcare system.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Approaches for Livestock Symptoms and Diseases Prediction and Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Farm animals farmed for financial gain are referred to as livestock. The majority of livestock animals are found in isolated locations with little access to medical care. Rapid and precise disease diagnosis is generally a challenging task. To prevent the disease from spreading among the cattle, it is essential to identify the disease's consequence and take appropriate precautions. Therefore, a system that can assist in forecasting cattle diseases based on symptoms and recommend preventive actions in relation to the projected disease is required. In this work, we analyze a dataset of livestock animal health issues using automated monitoring systems using eight machine learning methods. The variables that the machine learning algorithms examine are the age, symptoms, variations in temperature, disease type. Using a dataset, we have implemented machine learning algorithms for the purpose of early diagnosis and prediction of disease in livestock animals. Machine learning techniques like logistic regression, XGBoost, Catboost, light gradient boost, Random Forests and Support Vector Machines were integrated with feature selection algorithms to predict diseases. After analyzing the data for each classifier, the Catboost and Random Forest classifiers had the greatest and most reliable accuracy of 83.7% and 83.5% respectively.

articleTitle: IoT-Enhanced Seaside Monitoring for Early Flood Warning Systems using Intelligent Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The research on IoT-enhanced seaside monitoring for early flood warning systems using intelligent techniques has demonstrated promising results in enhancing coastal resilience against flooding events. The system exhibited high levels of accuracy, reliability, sensitivity, and specificity, ranging from 87% to 93%, 81% to 87%, 86% to 91%, and 86% to 92%, respectively, across the 10 experiment trials. Additionally, the system-maintained prompt response times ranging from 4 to 6 minutes, ensuring timely issuance of flood warnings. These results underscore the effectiveness of integrating Internet of Things (IoT) technology with intelligent techniques for improving early flood warning systems in coastal areas. By leveraging advanced sensor technology and data analytics methods, the monitoring system can proactively detect potential flood risks, provide accurate alerts, and facilitate timely response actions to mitigate flood-related risks. The findings highlight the importance of investing in innovative solutions that enhance disaster preparedness and response capabilities in vulnerable coastal regions.

articleTitle: Enhancing Heart Disease Prediction and Analysis: An Efficient Voting Ensemble model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The prediction of heart disease is of significant importance in the domain of healthcare, where accurate diagnosis can save lives. In this paper, we propose a proficient model for prediction of heart disease using a Voting Ensemble technique. We employ a integration of Logistic Regression, Decision Tree classifier, and Random Forest classifiers to create a robust predictive model. This ensemble method has shown encouraging results in terms of accuracy and performance. In our experimental analysis, we demonstrate the advantages of our method and offers a comprehensive assessment of its performance on a real-world heart disease dataset. The results highlight the need of ensemble techniques in improving diagnostic accuracy. Our Voting Ensemble model attained an outstanding accuracy of 98% on the test dataset, outperforming individual classifiers. This paper contributes to the advancement of forecasting models for predicting heart disease and provides insights for future investigations in the field of healthcare analytics.

articleTitle: Combining Sentiment Analysis with Crypto: Enhancing Machine Learning Models for Price Forecasting with Social Media Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: For stakeholders and investors, precise price forecasting is becoming more and more important as the market for digital currencies continues to exhibit dynamic and often unpredictable behavior. To improve bit coin price forecasts, this study combines machine learning techniques with data from social media sites. Using the vast and current datasets available through these sites, this research aims to identify patterns, sentiments, and indicators that improve the accuracy of Bitcoin price forecasts. We found that adding the sentiment feature consistently led to superior results when evaluating the models' performance with and without the Twitter sentiment data, with Twitter-RoBERTa-based sentiment generating an average F1 score of 95.3. With an F1 score of 97.3, the most accurate model was an optimized Multi Modal Fusion predictor utilizing sentiment based on Twitter-RoBERTa. By enhancing the precision and resilience of machine learning (ML) methods for anticipating market movements, this work advances the area of financial forecasting and it gives traders, brokers, and investors a useful tool for making well-informed decisions. It accomplishes this by incorporating on-chain data, showcasing the possibilities of sentiment analysis in social media, and practically applying a multimodal fusion model.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Performance of Hybrid Power System Using SMES-UPFC and Tunned with Genetic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: In this paper two areas interconnected hybrid power system is investigated under the deregulated environment. The two-area system consists of thermal-hydro-gas-nuclear and diesel power generating unit. The PID tuner is used to minimize error in tie line power and area control error (ACE). To improve the reactive power unified Power flow controller (UPFC) is used. To manage surplus power or instant load exchange the super magnetic energy storage (SMES). Various combinations of test using SMES and UPFC is applied to the two-area system. The frequency response of the system is analyzed in terms of settling time, rise time, peak overshoot, and undershoot. To get the best possible state of the system the Genetic Algorithm (GA) optimization technique is used to get gain and time constant of SMES, UPFC and PIDF tuner. The minimum settling time of 12.47Sec is obtained using UPFC for frequency of area-1 whereas 11.3Sec is obtained for frequency of area-2. The settling time for tie line power is reached up to 15.9Sec. The whole two-area system is designed to in MATLAB SIMULINK 2018a.

articleTitle: ECG Signal Classification using Machine Learning for Heart Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Ectopic (abnormal) heartbeats, or arrhythmias, are a because of irregular cardiac pumping. The early diagnosis of arrhythmias can support cardiologists in determining to assist sufferers with medical aid. Analysis of Electrocardiogram (ECG) signal is employed in this work to classify abrupt heart rhythms, sometimes referred to as ectopic heart beats, from normal cardiac rhythms. Premature supraventricular (psvc) and premature ventricular contractions are the two major types of ectopic beats; arrhythmia is another term for ectopic (abnormal) heartbeats. The heartbeats are represented graphically using ECG signals. There are three types of waves in it: 1) T waves, 2) P waves, and 3) QRS complex. Classification using LDA classifier has been done to discriminate ECG signals abnormalities and it yielded the specificity, accuracy, and sensitivity of 98.57 %, 98.7 %, and 98.2 %, respectively. The MIT-BIH Arrhythmia benchmark dataset was used to test the proposed approach. Lastly, using the same database, the results of the present method were compared to the state of the art.

articleTitle: Monitoring of Fire within Forest Using Advanced Digital Differential Based Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Analysis of forest fires True video surveillance is a challenging task. The same is due to differences in appearance, changes in lighting, and variations in speeds. This study suggested a mechanism for effectively monitoring fires in forests that can instantly identify the movement of traffic. Our research generally contributes to the development of technologically based solutions for mitigating the consequences of forest fires and defending our environment and communities. Due to their rapid spread and destruction, forest fires represent a significant threat to both natural ecosystems and human societies. In order to address this urgent issue, this study explores how cutting-edge digital differential-based neural networks (DDNNs) might be utilized to monitor and manage forest fires. This method is made up of three different parts, one of which is a background subtraction-based evaluation of vehicle density. The second component uses an optical flow mechanism to estimate the pace of the fire within the forest flow. The last component involves assessing the number of Area using a better differential approach. With the help of the obtained fundamental data, our system can predict a wide range of events, such as substantial fire activity in forest zones, area over speeding, and more. The simulation is done using the Kaggle data set that depicts a forest fire.

articleTitle: A Framework for Breast Cancer Prediction Using Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Breast cancer is one of the most widespread types of cancers that usually appear in women worldwide, and early diagnosis is of great importance to survival improvement. As the breast cancer prediction study trial, we are looking forward to working with support vector machines (SVM), a strong machine learning algorithm that is well-known for its good performance in classification tasks. This architecture integrates the features extracted from the data of medical imaging, such as mammograms or MRI, with the data of patients, including patient demographics, family history, and previous health records. We depict the steps of data pre-processing, feature extraction, and model training, and we conduct its evaluation by utilizing the correct performance metrics. Alongside that, we delve into the possible methods for selecting features and optimizing parameters aiming at the improvement of the accuracy of the SVM model. A number of experiments are conducted on a unified dataset of the proposed method demonstrability of accurate diagnosis of the breast cancer presence. This gives healthcare professionals preoperative decision-making support.

articleTitle: Enhancing Customer Experience in Tourism and Hospitality With Machine Learning Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Even without taking into account its environmental component, tourism industry is a crucial area of economic and social growth due to its economic and regional relevance. Customers frequently use the increasing amount of online reviews to inform their purchasing decisions. On the other hand, nothing is known about how managers react to internet reviews of hotels. One of the main sectors of the tourist and hospitality industries is the hotel sector. The paper discusses classifying and forecasting customer attitudes. The paper presented a novel paradigm for classifying and forecasting customer attitudes. The client testimonials came from a hotel in India. The customer reviews were processed in the following stage and fed into different machine learning algorithms. The RF, LR, NB, and BRDT algorithms were employed in this work. The BRDT algorithm outperformed the others in terms of output. Additionally, the BRDT was used to extract the key elements driving the excellent customer experience. Ultimately, a number of intriguing findings about the impact of feature count on machine learning algorithm performance were noted.

articleTitle: Predicting Heart Disease Holistically: A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This study presents a novel approach to predicting heart disease using holistic data through machine learning algorithms. We integrate multiple dimensions of patient data including lifestyle factors, clinical history, genetic predispositions, and routine biochemical parameters to train predictive models. Utilizing datasets comprising of patient records from multiple healthcare databases, we apply a combination of feature engineering and advanced machine learning techniques, including Random Forests, Ensemble model and Neural Networks. Our results show a significant improvement in predictive accuracy compared to traditional models that primarily focus on clinical data alone. The holistic model achieves an accuracy of 92% in cross-validated test sets. This research demonstrates the potential of machine learning in enhancing predictive models for heart disease by incorporating a wide range of health determinants, suggesting a shift towards more comprehensive, data-driven healthcare strategies.

articleTitle: 4 Element Snake Shaped Array Antenna for 5G Millimeter Wave Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This paper suggests a multi-band, higher gain snake-shaped patch antenna designed for 5G mm-wave applications. The suggested antenna features a hybrid geometry and is built from driven patches that are both rectangular and circular, joined perpendicularly to one another, and coupled to a microstrip line with stepped impedance. It is possible to install this designed radiator into multi-layered housing systems or to integrate it with electronic printed circuit board components. Additionally, a modified corporate feed array configuration with four elements is built, the gain performances and multi-band contrasted with those of single and double-element radiators. This radiating element is pivotal for future 5G technology, supporting mm-wave networks, controlling base stations, and enabling wideband CDMA.

articleTitle: Assessment of Seismic Performance for Multi Storey Steel Frame Building on Sloped Terrain with Setbacks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The study presents a comprehensive analysis of the seismic performance of various structural configurations, particularly focusing on buildings constructed on sloped terrains and those incorporating setbacks. A total of eight distinct models were Examined, each differing in the degree of slope at the base and the positioning of setbacks. Using the advanced capabilities of Etabs Software, the research conducted seismic simulations to evaluate how these structures would respond under seismic loading conditions. The analytical process was precise, concentrating on key performance indicators such as displacement, the forces generated by earthquakes, and Storey drift. These metrics are crucial in understanding the resilience of a structure during seismic events. The study meticulously documented how incremental changes in the slope of the terrain and the introduction of setbacks at various levels can significantly impact a building's structural integrity during an earthquake. One of the pivotal findings of this research was the observation that buildings situated on sloping grounds tend to exhibit poor seismic behavior. This is attributed to the uneven distribution of seismic forces due to the irregularity of the ground. Conversely, structures that featured setbacks, particularly those located at higher storeys, demonstrated superior seismic performance. The strategic placement of these setbacks contributes to a more favorable distribution of seismic forces, thereby enhancing the building's overall stability and safety. The insights gained from this study could be instrumental in guiding future construction practices, ensuring that buildings are not only aesthetically pleasing but also structurally sound and capable of withstanding the rigors of seismic activity. The implications of these findings are particularly significant for regions prone to earthquakes, where the adoption of such design considerations could mean the difference between devastation and resilience.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-Based Enterprise Management Model for Consumer Psychology: Marching Towards Digital
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence is implemented with more possibilities with existence of management procedures and organizational structures using significant transformations. Decision making process and organizational structures in the companies completely depend on AI. Based on AI digitization technology Backpropagation Neural Network used to construct the salary prediction model that are subjected to Nadam approach (Nesterov and Adaptive Moment Estimation) is used for enhancing the accuracy of consumer psychology. The present study focusses on the novel artificial intelligence-based enterprise management for understanding digital technologies and consumer psychology. AI capabilities are utilized businesses are concentrated more for consumer emotions, preferences and consumer behaviour optimized using algorithm for enhanced customer satisfaction and marketing strategies. Digital technology is integrated with effective enterprise management by the companies for adapting market dynamics evolved rapidly. The study explores the AI driven model for consumer psychology by contributing advancements in management practices of enterprises in the digital era.

articleTitle: Fake News Detection Using Evolutionary Ensemble Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: In today's era, the digital consumer base is increasing exponentially around the globe every year. This has created a surge of information containing fake and real information throughout the network and enabled easy and seamless dissemination. The fake news creates an illusory scene aimed at the personal, political, social, or monetary gains of a person or organization. Thus, detecting false or misleading information from the plethora of information is a substantial task. Using the Evolutionary Algorithm and an ensemble deep learning model over the dataset Gossipcop, we have used a hybrid model for the classification of real and fake news. Four popular deep learning models, namely LSTM, BiLSTM, CNNLSTM, and CNNBiLSTM, have been ensembled, powered by a novel version of an Evolutionary Genetic Algorithm called Batch Genetic Algorithm. The proposed model provides an overwhelming accuracy of 0.8599. Also, to substantiate the proposed model, it has been compared with twelve models based on different a technique which affirms the supremacy of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Storage Solution and Security Transmission in Image Sensing Using Blockchain Technology in Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The number of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has grown dramatically with the technology's rapid development. Higher security standards have so been proposed for the administration, transfer, and archiving of vast amounts of IoT data. But security problems like data theft and forgeries are likely to happen while IoT data is being transmitted. Furthermore, the majority of data storage options now in use are centralized, meaning that a centralized server handles both data maintenance and storage. The confidentiality of IoT data would be seriously jeopardized once a hostile assault targets the server. Given the aforementioned security concerns, a secure transmission as well as storage solution for blockchain sensing images in the Internet of Things is put forth. Therefore, to enable effective secure data storage in Internet of Things-related smart computing systems, develop and build a novel blockchain-based artificial intelligence model. We also demonstrated the operation of the system framework. Upon conducting a thorough security study, we have determined that our suggested solution possesses a strong potential to address the majority of security issues that conventional systems encounter. Furthermore, our suggested method can be used for any file-changing wireless Internet of things network that requires the exchange of multimedia data, including traffic data from smart cities, wearable device data, healthcare data, etc.

articleTitle: A Robust DL Approach for Detection of Invasive Ductal Carcinoma in Whole Slide Images using DenseNet169
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: The present research introduces a deep learning method for automatically recognizing and evaluating tissue areas that correspond to invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC) in whole slide images (WSI) of breast cancer (BCa). Learn-from-data techniques which utilize computational simulations of the learning process are called deep learning approaches. It has been demonstrated that these methodologies outperform conventional methods in resolving the challenging issues in a number of domains, particularly object and speech recognition. The main reason why making an invasive breast cancer evaluation is an exhausting and laborious process is that, it necessitates a pathologist to scan a huge number of benign regions with the aim to determine the spots that are malignant. Effectively characterizing IDC in WSI is a prerequisite for evaluating the severity of tumors and predicting patient prognosis. In order to support diagnosis, the DL approach in this study draws out many convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for perceptible semantic examination of tumor locations. A WSI database of 162 patients with IDC diagnoses is exploited to assess the technique, and 170 slides were chosen for training. The objective of the experimental analysis was to assess the accuracy of the classifier in identifying IDC tissue areas in WSI. A fusion of optimization techniques namely Best First and Evolutionary Search has been employed for feature reduction and improvement. When using DenseNet169, our approach produced the highest quantitative outcomes for the computerized identification of IDC sections in WSI with regard to accuracy 87.46% in comparison with an approach using EfficientNetB0 and ML classifiers for invasive tumor categorization employing Random Forest, BayesNet, SVM, Naïve Bayes and Decision Tree with accuracy of 80.65%.

articleTitle: Clinical Text Analysis with Natural Language Processing: A BERT-based Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This research investigates the transformative potential of Natural Language Processing (NLP) procedures, especially utilizing a BERT-based approach, for the comprehensive investigation of unstructured clinical content. The ponder centres on three key assignments: Named Entity Recognition (NER), Clinical Content Classification, and Subject Modeling, each contributing to an all-encompassing understanding of accounts inside electronic health records. The BERT-based algorithm illustrates predominant execution, accomplishing exactness, review, and F1-score values of 0.87, 0.89, and 0.88, individually, near an amazing AUC-ROC score of 0.94. The NER calculation shows accuracy and review values of 0.92 and 0.88, highlighting its adequacy in recognizing and classifying substances in clinical content. The Clinical Content Classification algorithm, fine-tuned with BERT, achieves precision, recall, and F1-score values of 0.85, 0.87, and 0.86, with an AUC-ROC score of 0.92. The Subject Modeling calculation, based on Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA), accomplishes a coherence score of 0.75, advertising profitable bits of knowledge into latent themes inside clinical accounts. This research contributes to the headway of data-driven healthcare by displaying the flexibility and viability of NLP strategies in extracting significant data from complex clinical content information.

articleTitle: Automatic Detection and Classification of Sleep Disorders Using AI-Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Sleep disorders are very common and throw a bad impact on a health of person as well as quality of his day-to-day life. For successful treatment and intervention, sleep disorders must be found and categorised quickly and correctly. Traditional diagnostic methods rely heavily on human assessments that take a lot of time and cost a lot of money. The main objective of the research is to find out how artificial intelligence-based learning models such as machine learning and deep learning will be used to automatically find and classify sleep disorders. Apart from this, a comparative analysis has been also done to analyse the work of the researchers on the basis of their outcomes and challenges that still persist. Moreover, a framework has been also proposed that can be used in future to detect as well as classify multiple sleep disorder diseases using various machine as well as deep learning models.

articleTitle: Roadscape AutoEncoder: Redefining Road Detection with Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Road detection from high-resolution satellite images (HRSI) is critical for various applications such as urban planning and emergency response, yet manual approaches are labour-intensive and prone to errors. Existing methods employ supervised and unsupervised learning techniques, but challenges persist due to image complexity and noise. In this study, we propose a novel approach that combines semantic segmentation with autoencoder neural networks to generate precise road segmentation masks. Leveraging the Deep Globe Road Extraction Dataset and an independent dataset from Google Maps satellite imagery, we validate our method's effectiveness. Our CNN-based autoencoder architecture extracts hierarchical features using convolutional layers and optimizes model parameters with optimization algorithms. Through extensive training, the autoencoder learns to produce accurate road segmentation masks by minimizing reconstruction loss. Experimental results demonstrate remarkable accuracies of 95.39% in training and 95.17% in validation, showcasing the model's robustness. Evaluation on diverse scenarios from the “Satellite-Google maps-Masks” dataset further validates the practical utility of our method in urban development and road infrastructure research.

articleTitle: Advancing Distributed Energy Systems through Power Electronic Interfaces Integration and Benefits
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: As distributed energy (DE) systems continue to be used and technology advances have a growing influence on business, it is becoming more and more important to understand how DE systems interface with electric power systems. New markets and benefits for DE applications include ancillary service offering, energy efficiency, power system stability, and consumer choice. Distributed energy generation (DER) systems can support higher loads, minimize fault contributions, collaborate more easily with other DE sources, enhance power quality, support voltage/ampere reactive (VAR) more effectively, and lower interconnection costs with the aid of contemporary power electronic (PE) interfaces. This article will examine the issues surrounding DE system integration and show how PE interfaces might be able to address them.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Healthcare Management, Analysis, and Future Trends
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Data-driven approaches are revolutionizing healthcare management and analysis, offering insights into patient care, operational efficiency, and future trends. The sum of information Big data’ is, can do miracles. In the last 20 years, it has become a topic of interest because the potential lies within is enormous. Big Data is produced, stored and examined by several industries of public and private domain with the main aim to enhance their services. Big Data comes from variety of resources in medical industry such as medical patient records, test reports, and IOT medical devices. The large amount of data is generated by medical research which is vital to public healthcare. The data must be appropriately organised and analysed to obtain useful information. Else, finding solution through big data analysis will be like looking for needle in haystack. Set of difficulties frequently occur at every phase of managing Big Data which can only be overcome by installing advanced computer systems for its analysis. This paper examines the relationship between data science and healthcare with an intent to use complex metrics to make intelligent and accurate decisions. Important areas are data-driven approaches for enhancing medical administration, recognizing new developments influencing healthcare evolution, and the methods for evaluating large sets of medical data. By incorporating the data-driven techniques, the medical industry might able to improve the patient health, optimize operations and adjust to current as well as to continuously evolving situations.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Networks for Intrusion Detection in IoT Networks with Limited Resources
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: In this research, we explore the adequacy of Convolutional Neural Systems (CNNs) for interruption location in resource-constrained IoT systems. Leveraging two freely accessible datasets, we compare the execution of CNNs with conventional machine learning calculations such as Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Random Forests (RF). Particularly, on Dataset A, CNNs accomplish an accuracy of 0.92, a review of 0.88, and an F1-score of 0.90, whereas, on Dataset B, they accomplish an accuracy of 0.86, a review of 0.84, and an F1-score of 0.85. Moving forward, the selection of CNNs can upgrade the versatility and security of IoT systems, clearing the way for more strong and effective interruption location frameworks.

articleTitle: Cross-Domain Ontology Synthesis for Semantic Web Integration: A Neural Network Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Semantic Web Integration is a significant challenge in the domain of data mining and web technology due to the diverse and dynamic nature of web resources. The objective of this research is to propose a novel approach for Cross-Domain Ontology Synthesis employing neural network models to enhance semantic web integration. This paper introduces a scalable and efficient framework that combines the robustness of deep learning techniques with the semantic richness of ontologies, facilitating a seamless integration of heterogeneous data sources. The methodology encompasses a systematic extraction of domain-specific features and relationships through convolutional neural networks and recurrent neural networks, ensuring the adaptability and accuracy of ontology synthesis. The proposed model is validated against various benchmarks and datasets, demonstrating its superiority in terms of precision, recall, and semantic coherence compared to traditional methods. This research contributes to the field by addressing the semantic gap and promoting interoperability among disparate web entities, leading to a more coherent and interconnected semantic web. The findings indicate that leveraging neural network architectures in ontology synthesis significantly improves the integration process, paving the way for advanced applications in web technology, data mining, and beyond.

articleTitle: Enhancing Electric Vehicle Charging with Dynamic Adaptation: A Machine Learning Approach to Improving Grid Alignment Precision
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: This study introduces an advancement in the Grid Alignment Assistant System (GAAS) by integrating machine learning to dynamically adapt to varying road conditions, vehicle speeds, and charging grid configurations. This upgrade enables the system to learn from its environment and past alignment experiences, significantly improving its precision over time. By leveraging real-time data and predictive analytics, the system can adjust its algorithms to optimize alignment accuracy, ensuring efficient wireless charging for electric vehicles under diverse operational conditions. This novel approach not only enhances the GAAS's adaptability and performance but also paves the way for more autonomous and intelligent charging solutions in the evolving landscape of electric mobility.

articleTitle: Alzheimer Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Alzheimer disease is the one amongst neurodegenerative disorders. Though the symptoms are benign initially, they become more severe over time. Alzheimer's disease is a prevalent sort of dementia. This disease is challenging one because there is no treatment for the disease. Diagnosis of the disease is done but that too at the later stage only. Thus if the disease is predicted earlier, the progression or the symptoms of the disease can be slow down. Alzheimer Disease is a neurogenerative disorder that leads to memory loss and also leads to the malfunctioning of the whole neural system this paper uses the technique of machine learning for the detection of this chronic disease with minimal symptoms. The main objective of this paper is to list out some machine learning algorithms which can be used for the classification and prediction of the Alzheimer disease. The algorithms include Support Vector Machines (SVM), Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA), Principal Component Analysis (PCA), VGG16 (CNN) and these algorithms will also be compared based on its accuracy.

articleTitle: Recent Trends in Brain Tumor Detection Using Deep Learning Based Diagnostic Models Assisted with Medical Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Detection of brain tumors is a crucial aspect of processing biomedical images. These tumors are one of the prime reasons for death and disability, and effective treatment requires early identification. Varied types of medical images like Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), CT Scan images, X-ray are frequently used to detect tumors in brain. Most of the time, these images are examined by the radiologists manually which is a time taking process and there are chances to have erroneous results. To make the process automatic and accurate, deep learning techniques came to the picture where detection models developed by different researchers are being used to detect brain tumors with reliable and promising performances. This paper examines deep learning methods available for brain tumor detection, assessing their performance on publicly available datasets and identifying research gaps and limitations in existing approaches. It also discusses the potential impact of deep learning and future research directions.

articleTitle: Enhancing Voltage Stability and DG Penetration in Smart Grids Through a Modified Genetic Algorithm Approach for Optimal Reactive Power Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
abstract: Contemporary power networks confront several obstacles, including rising energy consumption, an ageing utility infrastructure, and the negative effects on the environment caused by traditional electric generation's emissions of greenhouse gases. Decentralized intelligence, conversation technologies, and computerized control systems are the driving forces behind the smart grid, which distribution power networks must undergo an evolution to in order to boost renewable energy penetration while simultaneously addressing reliability and security concerns. Optimal design of this smart grid can only be achieved by using intelligent optimization methods in light of this new perspective. To find the best spot for dispersed generators to provide reactive power, this study introduces a generalized optimization framework. When dealing with Reactive Power Management problems with many objectives, evolutionary algorithms are used to identify the best solution. An example of a microgrid provides a more in-depth look at how genetic algorithms evolve.

articleTitle: Analyzing Gray Matter Structural Networks Using Diffusion Tensor Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Communication, Computer Sciences and Engineering (IC3SE)
